title.en: About QuantArenas
title.zh: 关于 QuantArenas

subtitle.en: A bilingual research platform for systematic stock strategies and MQL5 Expert Advisor analysis with backtesting.
subtitle.zh: 一个面向系统化股票策略与 MQL5 EA 分析的双语研究平台，配备回测功能。

paragraphs.en: QuantArenas operates two complementary research modules. The Strategy Arena covers systematic stock strategies scored and ranked across multiple instruments and time windows using a consistent methodology. The EA Arena provides AI-analyzed MQL5 Expert Advisors sourced from the MQL5 CodeBase, each with bilingual descriptions, parameter documentation, and category classification (trading vs. utility).
paragraphs.zh: QuantArenas 运营两个互补的研究模块。策略竞技场覆盖在多种标的与时间窗口下评分排名的系统化股票策略。EA 竞技场提供源自 MQL5 CodeBase 的 AI 分析 MQL5 Expert Advisor，每个 EA 均配备双语描述、参数文档与类别分类（交易型 vs. 工具型）。

paragraphs.en: QuantArenas is not a signal service, brokerage, or automated trading system. It does not issue buy or sell alerts, provide personalized investment recommendations, or promise results. Strategies and EAs here are research models meant to be inspected and stress tested by the reader. The goal is to make strategy behavior visible, not to offer a turnkey product or a performance guarantee.
paragraphs.zh: QuantArenas 不是信号服务、券商平台，也不是自动化交易系统。它不会发布买卖提醒、提供个性化投资建议，或承诺任何结果。这里展示的策略与 EA 均为研究模型，旨在供读者审视、复核并进行压力测试。平台的目标，是让策略行为更加清晰可见，而不是提供开箱即用的产品或业绩保证。

heading.zh: EA 竞技场：MQL5 分析流水线

paragraphs.en: The EA Arena analyzes MQL5 Expert Advisors using an automated pipeline powered by NVIDIA GLM-5.1. Each EA is extracted from the MQL5 CodeBase, parsed for strategy logic, and documented with bilingual (CN/EN) descriptions, parameter explanations, and category tags. Trading EAs are separated from utility indicators, scripts, and panel tools so researchers can focus on actionable strategies.
paragraphs.zh: EA 竞技场使用由 NVIDIA GLM-5.1 驱动的自动化流水线分析 MQL5 Expert Advisor。每个 EA 从 MQL5 CodeBase 提取后，经过策略逻辑解析，并生成双语（中/英）描述、参数说明与类别标签。交易型 EA 与工具型指标、脚本和面板程序分开归类，方便研究者聚焦可执行的策略。

paragraphs.en: For auto-convertible EAs, the platform generates Python backtrader code from the extracted logic, backtests it on one year of hourly data for EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY and gold, and publishes the results on each EA's page. Backtest metrics include total trades, win rate, net P&L, maximum drawdown and recovery factor, and every trading EA gets a blow-up risk label. This LLM-assisted MQ5→Python pipeline makes it possible to evaluate EAs at scale without a live MetaTrader environment.
paragraphs.zh: 对于可自动转换的 EA，平台会从提取的逻辑生成 Python backtrader 代码，在 EUR/USD、GBP/USD、USD/JPY 和黄金一年的小时线数据上回测，并把结果发布到每个 EA 的页面。回测指标包括总交易次数、胜率、净盈亏、最大回撤和恢复因子，每个交易型 EA 还有爆仓风险标签。这种 LLM 辅助的 MQ5→Python 流水线使得无需 MetaTrader 环境即可大规模评估 EA。

heading.zh: 策略竞技场：股票策略评分

paragraphs.en: Stock strategies are scored with the Arena Score (v2, since November 2026). Every strategy is compared with all other strategies on the same market and time window, and five components are turned into percentiles: return quality (Sharpe and Sortino, 30%), drawdown control (Calmar and Ulcer index, 25%), consistency (share of positive months and time under water, 20%), robustness (the worst Sharpe across the 1Y, 3Y, 5Y and full windows, 15%) and statistical significance (the probabilistic Sharpe ratio, 10%). Because each component is a rank, a single extreme value cannot dominate, and strategies no longer tie at the top. Strategies that were in the market less than 5% of the time in a window are not ranked.
paragraphs.zh: 股票策略使用 Arena Score 评分（2026 年 11 月起为第二版）。每个策略都和同一品种、同一时间窗口内的所有策略比较，五个分项分别换算成百分位：收益质量（夏普和索提诺，30%）、回撤控制（卡玛比率和 Ulcer 指数，25%）、稳定性（正收益月份占比和水下时间，20%）、稳健性（1 年、3 年、5 年和全部历史中最差的夏普，15%）、统计可信度（概率夏普比率，10%）。因为每一项都是排名，单个极端值无法主导结果，头部也不会再出现并列。某个窗口内持仓时间不到 5% 的策略不参与排名。

paragraphs.en: The system also compares strategy behavior across multiple time windows. A model that only looks strong in the last few months but collapses on longer windows will rank lower than a steadier approach. Parameters are re-selected every six months by walk-forward optimization, using only data available at the time, and the walk-forward result is the one shown. Until 3 November 2026 the default parameters were kept whenever they scored better over the whole history; because that choice looked at the full sample, it made about one in five results slightly optimistic, so it was dropped.
paragraphs.zh: 系统还会在多个时间窗口下比较策略行为。若某个模型仅在最近几个月表现强劲，却在更长周期中失效，其排名会低于更稳健的策略。参数每六个月用滚动前推优化重新选择，只用当时已有的数据，网站展示的就是滚动前推的结果。2026 年 11 月 3 日之前，如果默认参数在整段历史上得分更高，就保留默认参数；这一步看过了整段样本，让大约五分之一的结果略偏乐观，所以已经取消。

paragraphs.en: Stock strategy data uses historical daily bars from public sources, collected through the yfinance interface with adjusted closes for splits and dividends. EA backtests use the most recent twelve months of hourly (H1) bars for EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY and gold, downloaded from free public sources (yfinance, with Dukascopy as a fallback) and re-run every month. All data sources are documented, and the same instrument set is applied consistently within each module so that rankings reflect strategy differences, not data inconsistencies.
paragraphs.zh: 股票策略数据使用来自公共来源的历史日线数据，通过 yfinance 接口采集，并采用已对拆股与分红进行调整的收盘价。EA 回测使用 EUR/USD、GBP/USD、USD/JPY 和黄金最近 12 个月的小时线（H1），数据来自免费的公共来源（yfinance，备用 Dukascopy），每月重跑一次。所有数据来源均有记录，且每个模块内使用一致的标的集合，确保排名反映策略差异，而非数据不一致。

paragraphs.en: Because the project is static and reproducible, both pipelines prioritize determinism. Missing sessions are left as gaps, and strategies that require data not available in public feeds are excluded. The data is not a substitute for institutional feeds and may include survivorship or proxy biases. These limitations are documented so readers can interpret results as research signals rather than trading grade performance.
paragraphs.zh: 由于该项目强调静态可复现，两条流水线均优先保证确定性。缺失交易日将保留为空缺，而需要公共数据源不支持的数据的策略会被排除。这里的数据不能替代机构级行情源，并且可能包含生存者偏差或代理偏差。我们明确记录这些限制，以便读者将结果理解为研究参考信号，而非可直接用于实盘的业绩表现。

paragraphs.en: QuantArenas is built to support structured research. Stock strategies include readable pseudocode, tags, and suggested comparisons. EA analyses include signal logic breakdowns, parameter descriptions, and backtest performance with equity curves. The platform complements academic papers and practitioner notes by giving a standardized output for exploration and comparison.
paragraphs.zh: QuantArenas 的构建目标是支持结构化研究。股票策略附带可读性强的伪代码、标签以及建议比较对象。EA 分析包含信号逻辑拆解、参数说明以及带有净值曲线的回测表现。平台希望通过提供标准化输出，补充学术论文与实务研究笔记的探索与比较价值。

paragraphs.en: From an engineering perspective, the platform emphasizes deterministic pipelines, limited external dependencies, and open inspection of assumptions. The EA analysis pipeline uses GLM-5.1 for MQL5 parsing and backtrader for execution, both running in a reproducible, script-driven workflow. The site also serves as a log of iterations, showing how strategies and EA analyses evolve as new evidence is added.
paragraphs.zh: 从工程角度看，平台强调确定性流水线、尽量有限的外部依赖，以及对各项假设的开放式检视。EA 分析流水线使用 GLM-5.1 进行 MQL5 解析，使用 backtrader 执行回测，两者均在可复现的脚本驱动工作流中运行。本站同时也是一个迭代记录，展示策略与 EA 分析如何随着新增证据而不断演化。

heading.en: How to use the platform responsibly
heading.zh: 如何负责任地使用本平台

paragraphs.en: Treat the rankings and backtest results as a research index, not a buy list. Use the results to narrow down ideas, then read the strategy description, inspect the chart behavior, and understand what the signal is actually doing. A strong rank or profitable backtest does not replace independent validation, and a weak rank does not mean the idea is useless. The point is to reveal trade offs and to surface questions worth testing.
paragraphs.zh: 请将排名与回测结果视为研究索引，而不是买入清单。你可以先借助结果缩小研究范围，再阅读策略说明、观察图表行为，并理解信号本身究竟在捕捉什么。高排名或盈利回测不能替代独立验证，低排名也不意味着想法毫无价值。平台的意义在于揭示权衡关系，并提出值得进一步检验的问题。

paragraphs.en: If you decide to explore a strategy or EA further, rebuild it with your own data, add realistic costs, and stress test across multiple regimes. Consider position sizing, liquidity, and risk controls that are not modeled here. QuantArenas gives a clean baseline, but responsible use requires additional work and a clear understanding of the risks.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你决定进一步研究某个策略或 EA，请使用自己的数据进行重建，加入更真实的交易成本，并在多种市场环境下进行压力测试。同时也应考虑这里尚未建模的仓位规模、流动性与风险控制因素。QuantArenas 提供的是一个干净的基准起点，但负责任的使用仍然需要额外工作，以及对风险有清晰的理解。

paragraphs.en: Keep notes on why a strategy ranks well or an EA backtest shows profit, and test whether that reason is still plausible today. A simple checklist such as data assumptions, regime fit, and failure mode helps avoid copying strategies blindly. The site is designed to be a starting point for that checklist, not the final answer, and it rewards careful reading over fast decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 请记录某个策略之所以排名较高或某个 EA 回测盈利的原因，并检验这些原因在当下是否仍然成立。一份简单的检查清单——例如数据假设、市场环境适配性与失效模式——有助于避免盲目照搬策略。本站的定位，是为这份清单提供一个起点，而不是给出最终答案；它鼓励的是审慎阅读，而非仓促决策。

paragraphs.en: All information on this site is for educational and research purposes only. It is not financial advice, and it should not be construed as an offer to buy or sell any security, derivative, or cryptocurrency. Past performance does not guarantee future results, and every strategy can experience prolonged losses or underperformance. EA backtests are conducted on limited historical data and do not account for slippage, spread, or commission costs.
paragraphs.zh: 本站所有信息仅用于教育与研究目的。其内容不构成金融建议，也不应被解读为对任何证券、衍生品或加密资产的买卖要约。过往表现并不保证未来结果，任何策略都可能经历长期亏损或表现不及预期。EA 回测基于有限的历史数据，且未计入滑点、点差与佣金成本。

paragraphs.en: Use this material at your own risk. If you act on any idea presented here, you are responsible for evaluating whether it is appropriate for your risk tolerance, time horizon, and regulatory environment. QuantArenas makes no warranties about the accuracy or completeness of the data, and it does not provide tax, legal, or investment guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 使用本站内容所产生的风险由你自行承担。若你基于此处展示的任何想法采取行动，你有责任自行评估其是否适合你的风险承受能力、投资期限与监管环境。QuantArenas 不对数据的准确性或完整性作出任何保证，也不提供税务、法律或投资建议。

title.en: Methodology
title.zh: 方法论

subtitle.en: How QuantArenas evaluates stock strategies and MQL5 Expert Advisors using consistent, reproducible methods.
subtitle.zh: QuantArenas 如何使用一致、可复现的方法评估股票策略与 MQL5 Expert Advisor。

paragraphs.en: The stock strategy pipeline starts with a shared data universe. Daily adjusted close series are pulled for each instrument, aligned to a common start date, and normalized to a base value for comparison across assets. The instruments cover index, commodity, and FX proxies that are widely traded and have long public histories. Only daily frequency is used in the core pipeline to reduce noise and to keep the same sampling for every strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 股票策略流水线始于一个共享的数据池。我们为每个标的提取日度复权收盘价序列，将其对齐到统一起始日期，并归一化至同一基准值，以便进行跨资产比较。所选标的覆盖交易活跃、公开历史较长的指数、商品与外汇代理品种。核心流水线仅使用日频数据，以减少噪声，并确保所有策略采用一致的采样频率。

paragraphs.en: The EA Arena uses an LLM-assisted pipeline to analyze MQL5 Expert Advisors. First, the MQ5 source code is parsed by GLM-5.1 into a structured JSON representation capturing indicators, entry/exit rules, parameters, and strategy type. Second, auto-convertible EAs are translated into Python backtrader strategies using a template-based code generator that maps MQL5 indicator calls to backtrader equivalents. Third, generated strategies are backtested on one year of H1 data for EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY and gold with the same account for every EA: $10,000, 1:100 leverage, the EA's own lot size converted to contract units (100,000 per currency lot, 100 ounces per gold lot), one order at a time, and a broker-style stop-out when equity falls to 10% of the starting balance.
paragraphs.zh: EA 竞技场使用 LLM 辅助流水线分析 MQL5 Expert Advisor。首先，MQ5 源代码由 GLM-5.1 解析为结构化 JSON，捕获指标、入场/出场规则、参数与策略类型。其次，可自动转换的 EA 通过基于模板的代码生成器翻译为 Python backtrader 策略，将 MQL5 指标调用映射为 backtrader 等价物。第三，生成的策略在 EUR/USD、GBP/USD、USD/JPY 和黄金一年的 H1 数据上回测，所有 EA 使用同样的账户：1 万美元、1:100 杠杆、EA 自己的手数（按合约换算：外汇每手 10 万单位，黄金每手 100 盎司）、一次只下一张单，净值跌到初始资金的 10% 时按券商规则强制平仓。

paragraphs.en: EAs that rely on MT5-specific features (custom indicators, DLL calls, or MQL5-only objects) are classified as manual-convert or mt5-only and are documented without backtesting. The convertibility classification ensures that only strategies with a reliable Python translation enter the backtest pipeline, keeping results comparable and interpretable.
paragraphs.zh: 依赖 MT5 专有特性的 EA（自定义指标、DLL 调用或 MQL5 专属对象）被分类为手动转换或仅限 MT5，仅进行文档化而不执行回测。可转换性分类确保只有具备可靠 Python 翻译的策略进入回测流水线，从而保持结果的可比性与可解释性。

paragraphs.en: The daily strategy engine uses synthetic close-to-close accounting: the target decided from bars through close t earns the interval from close t to close t+1. This assumes allocation at the decision close; it is not a recorded next-open or next-day-close fill and may be optimistic about execution. The signal page separately shows the latest target and the previous target that earned the last observed interval. Converted EA simulations instead use next-bar-open execution on H1 bars. Neither timing convention alone proves that every underlying rule is free of look-ahead bias.
paragraphs.zh: 日线策略引擎采用合成的收盘价收益计算：根据截至第 t 日收盘的数据确定目标仓位，并用它计算从第 t 日收盘到第 t+1 日收盘的收益。这假设能在决策当日收盘价配置仓位，并不是实际记录的次日开盘或次日收盘成交，执行假设可能偏乐观。信号页分别显示最新目标仓位，以及获得最后一个已观察区间收益的前一日仓位。转换后的 EA 则在 H1 数据上使用下一根柱开盘成交。单凭这些时间约定不能证明每个底层规则都不存在前视偏差。

paragraphs.en: Transaction costs, slippage, and financing are not modeled in the baseline scores. The purpose is relative comparison across strategies, not a broker ready profit and loss statement. Readers should assume that high turnover models will perform worse in live conditions, and that liquidity constraints may invalidate some signals.
paragraphs.zh: 基准评分并未纳入交易成本、滑点与融资成本。评分的目的是进行策略之间的相对比较，而不是生成可直接用于券商层面的损益报表。读者应假设，高换手模型在实盘中的表现很可能更差，而流动性约束也可能使部分信号失效。

heading.en: Evidence, observation dates and accounting corrections
heading.zh: 证据、观察日期与计算修正

paragraphs.en: The first evidence release covers six strategies on SPY, gold and bitcoin (18 pairs). The /evidence/ pages link actual configurations, code identity, daily derived records, simulated position changes and a standalone arithmetic verifier. Replay checks recorded arithmetic, not independent regeneration of decisions from a fresh provider download. Original inputs are retained privately; adjusted historical prices can be revised. Other strategies are not claimed to have complete evidence bundles.
paragraphs.zh: 首批证据覆盖六个策略在 SPY、黄金和比特币上的 18 组结果。/zh/evidence/ 页面提供实际配置、代码标识、每日衍生记录、模拟仓位变化和独立算术复核脚本。复核检查的是已记录的计算，并不等于用重新下载的行情独立重算了策略决策。原始输入私下保留；历史复权价格可能被修订。其他策略尚不宣称具备完整证据包。

paragraphs.en: Daily builds exclude bars dated today in UTC or later for every market. This deliberately delayed cutoff is not exchange-calendar aware; the actual observation date and build time are separate. From this release, WFO targets are stitched first and returns recomputed from the previous published target, including fold boundaries; skipped folds retain defaults. Earlier results could use a different candidate's preceding exposure. The evidence index records same-input accounting differences separately from changes to overlapping published history and retains correction snapshots.
paragraphs.zh: 日构建对所有市场统一排除当前 UTC 日期及之后的数据。这是刻意延迟、并未按交易所日历计算的截止规则；实际观察日期与构建时间分别展示。从本次发布起，先拼接滚动前推目标仓位，再根据上一日已发布的目标重算收益，调参边界也遵循相同规则；被跳过的区间保留默认仓位。旧结果可能在边界使用另一候选规则此前的仓位。证据索引分别记录同一输入下的计算差异与新旧发布历史重叠区间的变化，并保留修正快照。

paragraphs.en: Stock strategies are scored with the Arena Score, a weighted average of percentile ranks (return quality, drawdown control, consistency, robustness and significance) within the same market and window. EA backtests report total trades, win rate, net P&L, maximum drawdown (both percentage and dollar), and an equity curve. The different scoring approaches reflect the different data frequencies and evaluation goals of each module.
paragraphs.zh: 股票策略使用 Arena Score 评分：在同一品种、同一窗口内，把收益质量、回撤控制、稳定性、稳健性和统计可信度换算成百分位后加权平均。EA 回测报告总交易次数、胜率、净盈亏、最大回撤（百分比与金额）以及净值曲线。不同的评分方式反映了两个模块在数据频率与评估目标上的差异。

paragraphs.en: The stock strategy pipeline assumes full allocation with no leverage and no short borrow constraints unless the strategy explicitly defines them. The EA backtest pipeline uses four instruments, one year of hourly data and a standard account, which may not match the instrument, timeframe, account size or broker settings the original EA was designed for. Both pipelines use public data sources that can differ from institutional feeds. Strategy results use walk-forward optimization only. Until 3 November 2026 the site kept the default parameters whenever they scored better over the full history, which applied to 106 of 576 strategy-and-market results; because that choice saw the whole sample, those results were slightly optimistic.
paragraphs.zh: 股票策略流水线默认假设满仓配置，不使用杠杆，也不存在融券约束，除非策略本身有明确规定。EA 回测流水线使用四个品种、一年的小时线和统一的账户设置，可能与原 EA 设计时针对的品种、周期、资金规模或券商设置不同。两条流水线均使用可能与机构级行情存在差异的公共数据源。策略结果一律采用滚动前推优化。2026 年 11 月 3 日之前，如果默认参数在整段历史上得分更高，网站就保留默认参数，576 个“策略 × 市场”结果里有 106 个属于这种情况；这一步看过了整段样本，所以这些结果略偏乐观。

paragraphs.en: The MQ5→Python translation may simplify or approximate some indicator calculations. Custom indicators, multi-timeframe logic, and DLL-dependent features are intentionally excluded from auto-conversion. These constraints are part of the design and should be considered when interpreting backtest results.
paragraphs.zh: MQ5→Python 翻译可能会简化或近似某些指标计算。自定义指标、多时间周期逻辑和依赖 DLL 的特性被有意排除在自动转换之外。这些限制本就是设计的一部分，在解读回测结果时应充分考虑。

paragraphs.en: The methodology is intentionally transparent, but it is still a model. A high score or profitable backtest does not guarantee live performance, and a low score does not prove an idea is worthless. The output should be read as a research summary and combined with other due diligence such as liquidity analysis, execution modeling, and stress testing.
paragraphs.zh: 该方法论虽刻意保持透明，但它本质上仍是一个模型。高分或盈利回测并不保证实盘表现，低分也不意味着一个想法毫无价值。输出结果应被视为研究摘要，并与流动性分析、执行建模和压力测试等其他尽职调查工作结合使用。

paragraphs.en: QuantArenas is updated with new strategies, new EA analyses, and new backtest results over time. Changes are logged in the changelog so readers can track when rankings shift and why a strategy may behave differently across releases.
paragraphs.zh: QuantArenas 会随着新策略加入、新 EA 分析与新回测结果而持续演进。所有变更都会记录在更新日志中，方便读者追踪排名何时发生变化，以及为何同一策略会在不同版本之间呈现不同表现。

paragraphs.en: All results are for research and education only. They are not financial advice and should not be treated as a recommendation to trade. Always validate a strategy in your own environment before taking any real market risk.
paragraphs.zh: 所有结果仅供研究与教育用途。它们不构成金融建议，也不应被视为交易推荐。在承担任何真实市场风险之前，请务必在你自己的环境中完成策略验证。

paragraphs.en: QuantArenas is a static research site. We do not require user accounts and we do not collect personal profiles. This policy explains what limited information may be collected through analytics and advertising services, and how that information is used.

Before sending, the site removes private URL parameters, referrers, user-supplied titles and unapproved event fields. Cloudflare Web Analytics runs only on eligible public static pages, not the personalized app shell. Browser-local saved state is not included in these analytics payloads. Links you choose to share can contain portfolio settings and reach the hosting server when opened; this is not a promise of no network requests.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Umami 统计通用页面类别及允许的交互计数。发送前，网站会移除私人网址参数、来源网址、用户提供的标题及未经允许的事件字段。Cloudflare Web Analytics 仅在符合条件的公开静态页面运行，不在个性化应用页面运行。浏览器本地保存的状态不包含在这些分析载荷中。你主动分享的链接可能含有组合设置，打开时会到达托管服务器；这不表示网站不会发送任何网络请求。

paragraphs.en: QuantArenas may display ads served by Google AdSense. AdSense may use cookies or device identifiers to show relevant ads and to measure ad performance. You can manage ad personalization in your Google account settings and opt out of interest based ads where available. Some reading pages also show one labelled ad block from Adsterra near the bottom of the page; Adsterra may use cookies or device identifiers for the same purposes. Ads are not shown on evidence, cost, AI season or legal pages. Some pages also carry clearly labelled affiliate links, for example to TradingView; if you sign up through one we may earn a commission at no cost to you. Affiliate links do not affect rankings or results.
paragraphs.zh: QuantArenas 可能会展示由 Google AdSense 提供的广告。AdSense 可能使用 Cookie 或设备标识符来展示相关广告并衡量广告效果。你可以在 Google 账户设置中管理广告个性化，并在可用范围内选择退出基于兴趣的广告。部分阅读类页面底部还会展示一个标注为“广告”的 Adsterra 广告位，Adsterra 可能出于同样目的使用 Cookie 或设备标识符。证据页、成本页、AI 赛季页和法律条款页不展示广告。部分页面还带有明确标注的推广链接（例如 TradingView）；你通过它注册，我们可能获得佣金，你不会多花钱。推广链接不影响本站的排名和结果。

paragraphs.zh: 我们不会出售个人数据。我们仅会在运营与改进网站所必需的范围内，与服务提供商共享有限的分析数据。数据仅在满足分析与合规目的所需的期限内保留。

title.en: What Trading Costs Do to a Backtest: 576 Strategy Results With and Without Costs
title.zh: 交易成本对回测的影响：576 个策略结果扣成本前后对比

summary.en: Every backtest on Quant Arena is shown before trading costs, with a cost estimate next to it. Over the five years to November 2026, an assumed 10 basis points per trade cost the median strategy 1.2 percentage points a year, about a fifth of its return. For one result in six it took half or more. 53 profitable results turned flat or negative, and the number that beat buy-and-hold fell from 195 to 163. At 30 basis points only 129 would have.
summary.zh: Quant Arena 上所有回测展示的都是扣成本前的结果，旁边附上成本估算。截至 2026 年 11 月的五年里，按每次交易 10 个基点算，中位数策略每年要少赚 1.2 个百分点，大约是收益的五分之一；每六个结果里就有一个被吃掉一半甚至更多。有 53 个原本赚钱的结果变成不赚或亏钱，跑赢买入持有的结果从 195 个降到 163 个；如果成本是 30 个基点，只剩 129 个。

paragraphs.en: We took all 576 strategy-and-market results over the five years to 3 November 2026: 72 strategies on up to 10 markets, all with walk-forward optimization. For each one we estimate the cost of trading from its turnover: every time the position changes by 100% of the account, we charge 10 basis points (0.10%). That covers commission, the bid-ask spread and some slippage, a middle-of-the-road figure for a retail trader. Large ETFs and major currency pairs can be cheaper; crypto and thinner markets usually cost more.
paragraphs.zh: 我们取了截至 2026 年 11 月 3 日近五年的全部 576 个“策略 × 市场”结果：72 个策略，最多 10 个市场，全部用滚动前推优化。每个结果按换手估算交易成本：仓位每变动相当于账户 100% 的金额，就收 10 个基点（0.10%）。这包括佣金、买卖价差和一部分滑点，对个人交易者来说是个中间水平。大型 ETF 和主要货币对可能更便宜，加密货币和流动性差的市场通常更贵。

paragraphs.en: The cost is subtracted from the annual return. This is an approximation, but a close one at these sizes, and the same one the cost slider on every strategy page uses.
paragraphs.zh: 成本直接从年化收益里减掉。这是近似算法，但在这个量级上误差很小，和每个策略页面上的成本滑块用的是同一种算法。

heading.en: The typical cost: 1.2 points a year
heading.zh: 典型成本：每年 1.2 个百分点

paragraphs.en: The median result changed position 82 times in five years and paid about **1.2 percentage points a year** at 10 basis points. One in ten paid 2.9 points or more, and the busiest paid 6.8.
paragraphs.zh: 中位数结果五年里调整了 82 次仓位，按 10 个基点算，每年大约要付 **1.2 个百分点**。十分之一的结果每年要付 2.9 个百分点以上，交易最频繁的要付 6.8 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: That sounds small, but most strategy returns are small too. Among the 340 results that made more than 1% a year, the cost took a median of **20%** of the return. For 60 of them (18%) it took half or more.
paragraphs.zh: 听起来不多，但大多数策略的收益本来也不高。在年化超过 1% 的 340 个结果里，成本吃掉的收益中位数是 **20%**；其中 60 个（18%）被吃掉一半甚至更多。

heading.en: Profitable results that stop being profitable
heading.zh: 赚钱的结果变得不赚钱

paragraphs.en: 380 of the 576 results had a positive annual return before costs. Charging for trading turned some of them into losers:
paragraphs.zh: 576 个结果里有 380 个扣成本前年化为正。算上交易成本后，一部分变成了亏损：

en: At 5 basis points: 34 became flat or negative
At 10 basis points: 53
At 20 basis points: 94
At 30 basis points: 149, nearly two in five
zh: 5 个基点：34 个变成不赚或亏钱
10 个基点：53 个
20 个基点：94 个
30 个基点：149 个，接近五分之二

paragraphs.en: The same happens to the results that look best. Before costs, 195 results beat simply holding the market over five years. After 10 basis points 163 still did, after 20 basis points 145, and after 30 basis points 129. On the S&P 500 the bar was already high: 2 of 62 strategies beat holding the index before costs, and only one after.
paragraphs.zh: 看起来最好的那些结果也一样。扣成本前，有 195 个结果五年下来跑赢了直接持有；扣 10 个基点后还剩 163 个，20 个基点 145 个，30 个基点 129 个。标普 500 上门槛本来就高：扣成本前 62 个策略只有 2 个跑赢持有指数，扣成本后只剩 1 个。

paragraphs.en: Cost depends almost entirely on how often a strategy trades. A few examples on the S&P 500 over five years:
paragraphs.zh: 成本几乎完全取决于交易频率。看几个标普 500 上近五年的例子：

en: **TREND-17 Chandelier Exit** made 6.1% a year before costs from 119 position changes, about 3.8% after
**MR-16 Connors RSI** made 7.9% a year from 152 changes, about 4.8% after
**HMA-01 HMA Crossover** was already flat before costs (−0.1%) and lost about 3.9% a year after
**TREND-10 Ichimoku Cloud** traded 59 times and kept 5.3% of its 6.5%
zh: **TREND-17 吊灯止损**：仓位调整 119 次，扣成本前年化 6.1%，扣后约 3.8%
**MR-16 康纳斯 RSI**：调整 152 次，年化 7.9%，扣后约 4.8%
**HMA-01 HMA 交叉**：扣成本前就基本持平（−0.1%），扣后每年亏约 3.9%
**TREND-10 一目均衡表**：只交易了 59 次，6.5% 的年化里保住了 5.3%

paragraphs.en: By family, volatility strategies traded the most (a median of 151 position changes in five years) and paid 1.7 points a year. Regime strategies paid 2.2. Trend and mean-reversion strategies paid about 1.2 each, but that hurts mean reversion far more: its median result made only 0.8% a year, so the cost was larger than the return. The cheapest strategies to run were slow allocation rules such as dual momentum and asset-class rotation, which change position only a few times a year.
paragraphs.zh: 按类别看，波动率策略交易最频繁（五年调整仓位中位数 151 次），每年成本 1.7 个百分点；市场状态类 2.2 个百分点。趋势和均值回归都是 1.2 个百分点左右，但对均值回归伤害大得多：它的中位数结果年化只有 0.8%，成本比收益还高。运行成本最低的是双动量、资产类别轮动这类慢速配置规则，一年只调整几次仓位。

en: Read every backtest as "before costs" unless it says otherwise, and check how often the strategy trades.
At 10 basis points, a strategy that changes position about 30 times a year needs roughly 3 points of extra return just to break even with a version that never trades.
Fast strategies on small edges are the first to disappear. Slow strategies with larger edges survive costs best.
Use your own numbers. Every strategy page has a cost slider from 0 to 50 basis points.
zh: 除非特别说明，所有回测都要当成“扣成本前”来看，并且留意策略交易有多频繁。
按 10 个基点算，一年调整 30 次左右仓位的策略，每年要多赚大约 3 个百分点，才能和不交易的版本打平。
靠微薄优势、交易又快的策略最先消失；交易慢、优势大的策略最扛得住成本。
用你自己的成本去算。每个策略页面都有 0 到 50 个基点的成本滑块。

paragraphs.en: These are backtests, not investment advice.
paragraphs.zh: 以上都是回测结果，不构成投资建议。

title.en: How Much of a Backtest Survives Out of Sample? Walk-Forward Results for 63 Strategies
title.zh: 回测到了样本外还剩多少？63 个策略的滚动前推检验

summary.en: We re-tuned 63 strategies on 10 markets every six months for up to 14 years and then traded the chosen settings on data they had never seen. The median Sharpe ratio fell from 0.32 on the training data to 0.19 out of sample. Trend and momentum strategies kept almost all of their edge; mean reversion lost nearly all of it. Re-tuning beat simply keeping the default settings only half the time, and the best predictor of a strategy that holds up was a parameter grid where every setting worked.
summary.zh: 我们让 63 个策略在 10 个市场上每六个月重新调一次参数，最长跑了 14 年，每次都拿选出的参数去交易它们从没见过的数据。夏普中位数从训练期的 0.32 降到了样本外的 0.19。趋势和动量策略几乎保住了全部优势，均值回归则几乎全丢了。重新调参只有一半的时候比一直用默认参数好；最能预示策略经得住考验的，是参数网格里每一组参数都有效。

paragraphs.en: Quant Arena runs every strategy with walk-forward optimization. For each strategy and market we take three years of daily data, try up to nine parameter settings, keep the one that scored best, and trade it for the next six months. Then the window moves forward six months and the process repeats, typically 28 times, from January 2013 to November 2026 (bitcoin from 2017, ether from 2020).
paragraphs.zh: Quant Arena 上的每个策略都用滚动前推优化回测。对每个策略和市场，我们取 3 年日线数据，试最多 9 组参数，留下得分最高的一组，用它交易接下来的 6 个月；然后窗口往前挪 6 个月，再重复一遍。一般要重复 28 次，从 2013 年 1 月一直到 2026 年 11 月（比特币从 2017 年、以太坊从 2020 年开始）。

paragraphs.en: That gives two numbers for every strategy and market. The in-sample Sharpe ratio is what the chosen settings achieved on the three years they were picked on, averaged over all the re-fits. The out-of-sample Sharpe ratio is what the strategy earned in the six-month periods that followed, stitched together. This study covers the 486 strategy-and-market pairs with something to tune, from 63 strategies: most run on all 10 markets, a few only on their own portfolio basket. Nine strategies have no adjustable parameters and are left out. All figures are before trading costs.
paragraphs.zh: 这样每个“策略 × 市场”就有两个数字。样本内夏普，是选出的参数在它被选出来的那 3 年里的表现，再对所有重新选参取平均；样本外夏普，是之后那些 6 个月拼起来、策略真正赚到的。这次研究覆盖 486 个有参数可调的“策略 × 市场”组合，来自 63 个策略：大多数在全部 10 个市场上运行，少数只在自己的组合篮子上运行。有 9 个策略没有可调参数，不在其中。所有数字都没扣交易成本。

heading.en: The headline: about 40% of the Sharpe ratio disappears
heading.zh: 结论先说：大约 40% 的夏普没了

paragraphs.en: Across all 486 pairs the median in-sample Sharpe ratio was **0.32** and the median out-of-sample Sharpe ratio **0.19**. In 357 pairs (73%) the strategy did worse on new data than on the data it was tuned on, and in 91 pairs the Sharpe ratio fell by more than 0.3.
paragraphs.zh: 486 个组合里，样本内夏普中位数是 **0.32**，样本外是 **0.19**。有 357 个组合（73%）在新数据上的表现不如调参用的数据，其中 91 个夏普掉了 0.3 以上。

paragraphs.en: Part of that drop is the cost of choosing. When you test nine settings and keep the best, the winner looks better than its true quality simply because it was the luckiest of nine. Over the full history the median setting in each grid had a Sharpe ratio of 0.18 and the best one 0.31, a gap of about the same size as the in-sample to out-of-sample drop.
paragraphs.zh: 一部分下降是“挑选”本身的代价。从 9 组参数里挑最好的一组，赢家看起来会比它真实的水平更好，只因为它是 9 组里运气最好的。在全部历史上，每个参数网格里中位数那一组的夏普是 0.18，最好的一组是 0.31，差距和样本内到样本外的下降差不多大。

heading.en: Trend held up, mean reversion did not
heading.zh: 趋势扛住了，均值回归没有

paragraphs.en: The decay was very uneven across strategy families. Median Sharpe ratio, in-sample then out of sample:
paragraphs.zh: 不同类别的策略，衰减差别很大。夏普中位数，样本内 → 样本外：

en: Trend following (21 strategies, 201 pairs): 0.37 → **0.34**
Momentum (7 strategies, 43 pairs): 0.37 → **0.35**
Volatility (6 strategies, 51 pairs): 0.33 → **0.18**
Mean reversion (13 strategies, 121 pairs): 0.29 → **0.03**

paragraphs.en: Trend and momentum rules lost about a tenth of their in-sample Sharpe ratio. Mean-reversion rules, which buy dips and sell rallies at tuned thresholds, kept almost nothing: only 67 of their 121 pairs had a positive Sharpe ratio out of sample. A threshold that caught the reversals of the last three years tends not to catch the next ones.
paragraphs.zh: 趋势和动量规则只丢了大约十分之一的样本内夏普。均值回归规则按调好的阈值逢低买入、逢高卖出，到了样本外几乎什么都没剩：121 个组合里只有 67 个样本外夏普为正。能抓住过去 3 年反转的阈值，往往抓不住接下来的反转。

paragraphs.en: The out-of-sample periods give a fair comparison: what if we had simply kept the default settings over the same months? The default parameters had a median out-of-sample Sharpe ratio of **0.20**, slightly higher than the re-tuned 0.19, and re-tuning won in only 248 of 486 pairs (51%).
paragraphs.zh: 样本外的这些月份正好可以做一个公平的对比：如果同样这些月份一直用默认参数会怎样？默认参数的样本外夏普中位数是 **0.20**，比重新调参的 0.19 还略高一点；486 个组合里，重新调参只赢了 248 个（51%）。

paragraphs.en: Re-tuning helped most on oil (31 of 47 pairs) and bitcoin (32 of 47) and least on EUR/USD (17 of 47). For regime-switching and volatility strategies it hurt more often than it helped. The chosen settings also changed a lot: in a median of 8 of 28 re-fits the winning setting was different from the previous one. That is a sign the optimizer was often chasing noise.
paragraphs.zh: 调参帮助最大的是原油（47 个里赢了 31 个）和比特币（47 个里 32 个），最小的是欧元/美元（47 个里 17 个）。对市场状态切换和波动率类策略来说，调参坏处比好处多。选出的参数也换得很勤：28 次重新选参里，中位数有 8 次换成了和上一次不同的参数。这说明优化器很多时候是在追逐噪音。

heading.en: What predicts a strategy that holds up
heading.zh: 什么样的策略经得住考验

paragraphs.en: Two things did.
paragraphs.zh: 有两样东西能看出来。

paragraphs.en: The first is the in-sample result itself. Ranking pairs by in-sample Sharpe ratio and by out-of-sample Sharpe ratio gave very similar orders (rank correlation 0.84). The 97 pairs with the highest in-sample Sharpe ratios fell from 0.94 to 0.74, but every one of them stayed positive out of sample. A strong backtest shrinks; it rarely turns into a loser.
paragraphs.zh: 第一是样本内结果本身。按样本内夏普和样本外夏普分别排序，两个顺序非常接近（秩相关系数 0.84）。样本内夏普最高的 97 个组合，从 0.94 降到了 0.74，但每一个在样本外都还是正的。很强的回测会缩水，但很少会变成亏损。

paragraphs.en: The second is the shape of the parameter grid. Where all the settings had a positive Sharpe ratio over the full history (277 pairs), the out-of-sample median was **0.40** and 273 of the 277 stayed positive. Where only some settings worked (105 pairs), the out-of-sample median was 0.02, about zero. A strategy that only works with one particular setting is probably fitted to the past.
paragraphs.zh: 第二是参数网格的形状。在全部历史上所有参数组夏普都为正的 277 个组合，样本外中位数是 **0.40**，277 个里有 273 个样本外仍为正。只有部分参数有效的 105 个组合，样本外中位数是 0.02，基本是 0。只在某一组特定参数下才有效的策略，多半是拟合了过去。

paragraphs.en: The decay showed up almost everywhere. On the S&P 500 the median Sharpe ratio went from 0.83 to 0.63, on gold from 0.50 to 0.37, on bitcoin from 0.97 to 0.64. EUR/USD and natural gas were negative even in sample (0.01 and −0.09) and worse out of sample. The exceptions were broad commodities and oil, where the out-of-sample median matched or slightly beat the in-sample one.
paragraphs.zh: 几乎每个市场都有衰减。标普 500 的夏普中位数从 0.83 降到 0.63，黄金从 0.50 降到 0.37，比特币从 0.97 降到 0.64。欧元/美元和天然气连样本内都是负的（0.01 和 −0.09），样本外更差。例外是综合大宗商品和原油，样本外中位数和样本内持平，甚至略高。

en: Expect a backtest Sharpe ratio to shrink by roughly a third to a half on new data, and by much more for tuned mean-reversion rules.
Look at the whole parameter grid, not the best cell. If most nearby settings also work, the result is far more likely to last.
Re-optimizing regularly is not a free improvement. Over these 14 years it did no better than leaving sensible defaults alone.
Strong results usually stay positive. They just get smaller.
zh: 回测里的夏普，到了新数据上大概会缩水三分之一到一半；调过参的均值回归规则缩水得更多。
看整个参数网格，而不是最好的那一格。如果相邻的参数大多也有效，结果更有可能持续。
定期重新优化不是白来的提升。在这 14 年里，它并不比一直用合理的默认参数更好。
很强的结果通常还会是正的，只是会变小。

paragraphs.en: Every strategy page now shows its own out-of-sample check, with the in-sample Sharpe ratio, the out-of-sample Sharpe ratio, the default-settings comparison and the parameter grid. These are backtests, not investment advice.
paragraphs.zh: 现在每个策略页面都有自己的“样本外检验”：样本内夏普、样本外夏普、默认参数对比和参数网格。以上都是回测结果，不构成投资建议。

title.en: RSI vs Stochastic vs Williams %R vs CCI: Six Oscillators Backtested on 10 Markets
title.zh: RSI、随机指标、威廉指标还是 CCI？6 个震荡指标策略在 10 个市场上的回测

summary.en: Six "buy when oversold" strategies built on different oscillators, tested on ten markets. Plain RSI with a volatility cap was the most consistent: a positive Sharpe ratio on all ten markets over five years and a median drawdown of 10%. Connors RSI was the best on the S&P 500. Stochastic, Williams %R and CCI turned out to be close cousins that stay in the market longer, and lost 27% to 35% in the 2020 crash, against 5% for RSI.
summary.zh: 6 个基于不同震荡指标的“超卖就买”策略，在 10 个市场上回测。带波动率上限的普通 RSI 最稳：近五年在全部 10 个市场上夏普都为正，最大回撤中位数 10%。康纳斯 RSI 在标普 500 上最好。随机指标、威廉指标和 CCI 其实是近亲，持仓时间更长，2020 年暴跌时亏了 27% 到 35%，RSI 只亏了 5%。

paragraphs.en: All six buy when an oscillator says the market is oversold and sell when it recovers:
paragraphs.zh: 这 6 个策略都是震荡指标显示超卖时买入、回升后卖出：

en: **MR-01 RSI Mean Reversion**: the classic RSI, with a cap that keeps it out of very volatile markets
**MR-16 Connors RSI**: a composite of a short RSI, the length of the current up or down streak, and how today's move ranks against recent days
**MR-10 Stochastic Oscillator Reversion**
**MR-11 Williams %R Reversion**
**MR-05 CCI Mean Reversion** (Commodity Channel Index)
**MR-12 Money Flow Index Reversion**, which adds volume to an RSI-like reading
zh: **MR-01 RSI 均值回归**：经典 RSI，加了一个波动率上限，市场太剧烈时不进场
**MR-16 康纳斯 RSI**：由短周期 RSI、连涨连跌天数，以及当天涨跌在近期的排位组合而成
**MR-10 随机指标回归**
**MR-11 威廉指标回归**
**MR-05 CCI 均值回归**（商品通道指数）
**MR-12 资金流量指标回归**：在类似 RSI 的读数里加入了成交量

paragraphs.en: Each runs on ten markets (the S&P 500, gold, silver, oil, natural gas, agriculture, broad commodities, EUR/USD, bitcoin and ether) with daily data and walk-forward optimization, before trading costs unless stated. We look at the last five years and at the full history since 2010.
paragraphs.zh: 每个策略都在 10 个市场上运行（标普 500、黄金、白银、原油、天然气、农产品、综合大宗商品、欧元/美元、比特币和以太坊），使用日线数据和滚动前推优化，除非特别说明都不计交易成本。我们分别看近五年和 2010 年以来的完整历史。

heading.en: Five years: RSI was the most consistent

paragraphs.en: Over the five years to November 2026, the median Sharpe ratio across the ten markets was:
paragraphs.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月的五年里，10 个市场的夏普中位数是：

en: RSI: 0.41, positive on all 10 markets
Money Flow Index: 0.39, positive on 7
Stochastic: 0.28, positive on 7
CCI: 0.26, positive on 6
Williams %R: 0.13, positive on 7
Connors RSI: 0.09, positive on 6
zh: RSI：0.41，10 个市场全部为正
资金流量指标：0.39，7 个为正
随机指标：0.28，7 个为正
CCI：0.26，6 个为正
威廉指标：0.13，7 个为正
康纳斯 RSI：0.09，6 个为正

paragraphs.en: RSI also had the smallest drawdowns, a median of 10% against 18% to 25% for the stochastic-type oscillators, largely because it was in the market only 10% of the time. It had the best Sharpe ratio of the six on five markets: gold, silver, EUR/USD, natural gas and bitcoin.
paragraphs.zh: RSI 的回撤也最小，中位数 10%，随机指标这一类是 18% 到 25%，主要原因是 RSI 只有 10% 的时间在场内。在黄金、白银、欧元/美元、天然气和比特币这 5 个市场上，它是 6 个策略里夏普最高的。

heading.en: The S&P 500 is a special case

paragraphs.en: On the S&P 500 the ranking changes. Over the last five years Connors RSI had a Sharpe ratio of 1.03 (7.9% a year) and plain RSI 0.77 (5.2% a year), both above buy-and-hold's 0.73, though below its 11.7% a year. Since 2010 Connors RSI kept the lead with a Sharpe ratio of 0.80 and a probabilistic Sharpe ratio above 99.9%, close to holding the index (0.85) while invested only 11% of the time.
paragraphs.zh: 到了标普 500，排名就变了。近五年康纳斯 RSI 的夏普是 1.03（年化 7.9%），普通 RSI 是 0.77（年化 5.2%），都高于买入持有的 0.73，但年化收益都不如持有的 11.7%。2010 年以来康纳斯 RSI 依然领先，夏普 0.80，概率夏普比率（PSR）超过 99.9%，只有 11% 的时间持仓，夏普却接近持有指数的 0.85。

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere Connors RSI was weak: since 2010 its median Sharpe ratio across the ten markets was slightly negative. Buying short, sharp dips has worked best on the broad stock market.
paragraphs.zh: 在其他市场上康纳斯 RSI 表现平平：2010 年以来它在 10 个市场的夏普中位数略低于 0。抄短线急跌，在大盘股指上效果最好。

heading.zh: 三个指标，其实是一个信号

paragraphs.en: Stochastic, Williams %R and CCI measure much the same thing: where today's price sits within its recent range. Their daily returns on the S&P 500 over five years were correlated at 0.71 to 0.83, against about 0.3 to 0.6 between them and RSI. They also stayed in the market longer, 26% to 44% of the time, and held on through falls.
paragraphs.zh: 随机指标、威廉指标和 CCI 衡量的东西差不多：今天的价格处在最近区间的什么位置。近五年它们在标普 500 上的日收益相关系数在 0.71 到 0.83 之间，和 RSI 只有 0.3 到 0.6 左右。它们在场内的时间也更长，占 26% 到 44%，下跌时会一直拿着。

paragraphs.en: That showed in the COVID crash of February and March 2020, when the S&P 500 fell 33.7%: CCI lost 35.4%, Stochastic 30.4% and Williams %R 26.7%. Plain RSI lost 4.8%, thanks to its volatility cap, and Connors RSI, which exits after short bounces, gained 9.4%.
paragraphs.zh: 这在 2020 年 2–3 月的新冠暴跌中表现得很明显：标普 500 跌了 33.7%，CCI 亏了 35.4%，随机指标亏 30.4%，威廉指标亏 26.7%。普通 RSI 靠波动率上限只亏了 4.8%，康纳斯 RSI 因为反弹一下就离场，反而赚了 9.4%。

paragraphs.en: Over the full history the picture is sobering. Across the ten markets the median Sharpe ratio was 0.13 for RSI, 0.11 for the Money Flow Index and about zero or slightly negative for the other four, with median worst drawdowns of 45% to 73%: buying dips in oil, natural gas or crypto during long declines was ruinous. None of the six beat simply holding the S&P 500, which made 13.9% a year with a Sharpe ratio of 0.85.
paragraphs.zh: 放到完整的历史里，结果就让人清醒多了。10 个市场的夏普中位数，RSI 是 0.13，资金流量指标 0.11，其余 4 个在 0 左右甚至略低于 0；最大回撤中位数在 45% 到 73% 之间：在原油、天然气或加密货币的长期下跌里抄底，代价是毁灭性的。6 个策略都没跑赢直接持有标普 500，后者年化 13.9%，夏普 0.85。

paragraphs.en: Oscillator strategies trade often. Connors RSI averaged about 29 trades a year over the last five years, the stochastic-type oscillators 23 to 25, RSI and the Money Flow Index about 13. At 10 basis points per trade that costs roughly 2.9, 2.2 to 2.5 and 1.1 to 1.3 points a year respectively, a large share of returns that are mostly in single digits.
paragraphs.zh: 震荡指标策略交易很频繁。近五年康纳斯 RSI 平均每年交易约 29 次，随机指标这一类 23 到 25 次，RSI 和资金流量指标大约 13 次。按每次 10 个基点算，每年的成本分别约 2.9、2.2 到 2.5 和 1.1 到 1.3 个百分点，而这些策略的收益大多只有个位数。

en: If you use one oscillator, plain RSI with a volatility filter was the most robust across markets, and the filter mattered as much as the oscillator.
Stochastic, Williams %R and CCI are close substitutes; choosing between them changes little, and all three need a way to step aside in crashes.
Connors RSI is a stock-index tool. It was the best of the six on the S&P 500 and unremarkable elsewhere.
Count the trades: on most markets, costs take a big bite out of oscillator strategies.
zh: 如果只用一个震荡指标，带波动率过滤的普通 RSI 在各个市场上最稳；过滤条件和指标本身一样重要。
随机指标、威廉指标和 CCI 可以互相替代，选哪个差别不大，但三者都需要在暴跌时有办法离场。
康纳斯 RSI 是股指工具：在标普 500 上是 6 个策略里最好的，在别的市场上表现一般。
留意交易次数：在大多数市场上，成本会吃掉震荡指标策略相当一部分收益。

paragraphs.en: Every strategy page shows these results per market, updated every trading day. These are backtests, not investment advice.
paragraphs.zh: 每个策略页面都有分市场的结果，每个交易日更新。以上都是回测结果，不构成投资建议。

title.en: Sell in May and the Turn of the Month: Do Calendar Effects Still Work?
title.zh: “五月卖出”和月末效应还灵吗？10 个市场、16 年的回测

summary.en: Two of the best-known calendar rules, tested on ten markets since 2010. On the S&P 500, "Sell in May" earned 7.7% a year against 13.9% for holding, and did not avoid the worst crash, which fell inside its November–April season. The turn-of-the-month rule made 5.6% a year while invested only a third of the time, with a much smaller drawdown, but it has been weak over the last five years and trades often enough for costs to eat half of it.
summary.zh: 我们在 10 个市场上回测了两条最有名的日历规则，时间从 2010 年开始。在标普 500 上，“五月卖出”年化 7.7%，直接持有是 13.9%；而且它没躲过最大的那次暴跌，因为暴跌正好发生在它持仓的 11 月到 4 月之间。月末效应规则只有三分之一的时间持仓，年化 5.6%，回撤小得多；但近五年表现很弱，而且交易频繁，成本能吃掉一半收益。

en: **Sell in May (SEAS-01)**: own the market from November to April and hold cash from May to October. Two trades a year.

**Turn of the month (CAL-01)**: own the market for roughly the last three and the first three trading days of each month and hold cash otherwise, which on the S&P 500 means about a third of all trading days.
zh: **五月卖出（SEAS-01）**：11 月到 4 月持有，5 月到 10 月拿现金。一年交易两次。
**月末效应（CAL-01）**：每个月最后三个和开头三个交易日左右持有，其余时间拿现金。在标普 500 上，大约三分之一的交易日在场内。

paragraphs.en: Both run on ten markets from 2010 (bitcoin from 2014, ether from 2017) under the same rules as every Quant Arena strategy: daily data, signals executed on the next session, walk-forward optimization (only the turn-of-the-month rule has a setting to tune, the number of days), and no trading costs unless stated.
paragraphs.zh: 两条规则都在 10 个市场上从 2010 年开始回测（比特币从 2014 年、以太坊从 2017 年开始），规则和 Quant Arena 上所有策略一样：日线数据，信号在下一个交易日执行，滚动前推优化（只有月末效应有一个可调的参数，就是天数），除非特别说明都不计交易成本。

heading.en: Sell in May on the S&P 500
heading.zh: 标普 500 上的“五月卖出”

paragraphs.en: Since 2010 the rule earned 7.7% a year on the S&P 500, against 13.9% for simply holding, with a Sharpe ratio of 0.64 against 0.85. It did not even soften the worst fall: the COVID crash of February and March 2020 happened inside the November–April window, so the rule's worst drawdown was the same 34% as the index's.
paragraphs.zh: 2010 年以来，这条规则在标普 500 上年化 7.7%，直接持有是 13.9%；夏普 0.64，持有是 0.85。它甚至没能减轻最大的那次下跌：2020 年 2–3 月的新冠暴跌正好落在 11 月到 4 月的持仓期里，所以它的最大回撤和指数一样，都是 34%。

paragraphs.en: The rule looked better in the early 2010s: from 2010 to 2015 it had a higher Sharpe ratio than holding (1.10 against 0.83). From 2016 onwards it fell behind on both return and risk-adjusted return.
paragraphs.zh: 2010 年代初这条规则看起来还不错：2010 到 2015 年，它的夏普比持有更高（1.10 对 0.83）。但从 2016 年开始，不管是收益还是风险调整后的收益，它都落后了。

heading.en: Sell in May on other markets
heading.zh: 其他市场上的“五月卖出”

paragraphs.en: On commodities the picture is different. Over the last five years the rule had a higher Sharpe ratio than buy-and-hold on seven of ten markets, including gold (1.02 against 0.91) and agriculture (1.02 against 0.70), and a smaller worst drawdown on all ten.
paragraphs.zh: 大宗商品上情况不太一样。近五年里，这条规则在 10 个市场中的 7 个夏普高于买入持有，包括黄金（1.02 对 0.91）和农产品（1.02 对 0.70），而且 10 个市场的最大回撤都更小。

paragraphs.en: Over the full history since 2010, though, it beat holding on a risk-adjusted basis on only five markets, mostly by small margins: oil, EUR/USD, broad commodities, agriculture and natural gas. A pattern that comes and goes like this is more likely to be chance than a reliable seasonal force.
paragraphs.zh: 但把时间拉长到 2010 年以来，它只在 5 个市场上风险调整后跑赢持有，而且大多领先不多：原油、欧元/美元、综合大宗商品、农产品和天然气。这种时有时无的规律，更像是巧合，而不是稳定的季节性。

paragraphs.en: The turn-of-the-month rule is the stronger of the two on the S&P 500. Since 2010 it earned 5.6% a year while invested only 33% of the time, with a worst drawdown of 20.3% against 33.7% for the index, and a probabilistic Sharpe ratio of 99%: judged on its own, before adjusting for the many rules we test, very unlikely to be pure luck. It also did well on gold (Sharpe ratio 0.59 against 0.50 for holding) and on bitcoin (16.3% a year since 2014, though holding bitcoin made far more).
paragraphs.zh: 在标普 500 上，月末效应是两条规则里更强的一条。2010 年以来，它只有 33% 的时间持仓，年化 5.6%，最大回撤 20.3%，指数是 33.7%；概率夏普比率（PSR）99%：在不考虑我们同时测试了很多规则的前提下，很难说只是运气。它在黄金上也不错（夏普 0.59，持有是 0.50），在比特币上 2014 年以来年化 16.3%（当然直接持有比特币赚得多得多）。

paragraphs.en: But it is not steady. On the S&P 500 it made 3.7% a year from 2010 to 2015 and 8.9% from 2016 to 2020, when its Sharpe ratio was slightly above buy-and-hold's. Over the last five years it made only 2.9% a year, and it lost money on seven of the other nine markets.
paragraphs.zh: 但它并不稳定。在标普 500 上，2010–2015 年年化 3.7%，2016–2020 年 8.9%，这段时间夏普略高于持有。近五年只有年化 2.9%，在另外 9 个市场里有 7 个是亏钱的。

paragraphs.en: Calendar rules trade on a schedule, and the turn-of-the-month rule trades a lot: about 24 trades a year. At 10 basis points per trade that costs roughly 2.4 points a year, nearly half of its 5.6% on the S&P 500. Sell in May trades twice a year and costs about 0.2 points.
paragraphs.zh: 日历规则按时间表交易，月末效应交易得很频繁：一年大约 24 次。按每次 10 个基点算，每年成本大约 2.4 个百分点，几乎是它在标普 500 上 5.6% 年化收益的一半。“五月卖出”一年只交易两次，成本大约 0.2 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Because it is out of the market two thirds of the time, the turn-of-the-month rule sidestepped the S&P 500's three big falls: +2.8% in the fourth quarter of 2018 while the index fell 19.2%, −4.9% in the COVID crash (index −33.7%) and −0.1% in the 2022 bear market (index −24.5%). Sell in May was caught by the first two, losing 13.8% and 33.7%, and lost 13.0% in 2022.
paragraphs.zh: 月末效应三分之二的时间都不在场内，所以躲过了标普 500 的三次大跌：2018 年四季度指数跌 19.2%，它反而赚了 2.8%；新冠暴跌指数跌 33.7%，它只亏 4.9%；2022 年熊市指数跌 24.5%，它只亏 0.1%。“五月卖出”前两次都没躲开，分别亏了 13.8% 和 33.7%，2022 年亏了 13.0%。

en: Sell in May has not paid on the S&P 500 since the early 2010s. On commodities it has looked good lately, but not consistently.
The turn-of-the-month effect on stocks is visible over 16 years, but it is uneven, and trading costs take about half of it.
Both rules cut drawdowns mostly by being out of the market. A simple trend filter protected about as well in the 2020 crash (median trend-following strategy −4.7%) with fewer trades.
zh: “五月卖出”在标普 500 上从 2010 年代初以后就不灵了。在大宗商品上最近几年看起来不错，但并不稳定。
股票上的月末效应在 16 年里确实看得到，但时强时弱，而且交易成本会吃掉大约一半。
两条规则减少回撤，主要靠的是不在场内。一个简单的趋势过滤在 2020 年暴跌中保护得差不多好（趋势跟踪策略中位数 −4.7%），交易次数还更少。

paragraphs.en: Every number here is on the strategy pages for SEAS-01 and CAL-01, updated every trading day. These are backtests, not investment advice.
paragraphs.zh: 文中所有数字都能在 SEAS-01 和 CAL-01 的策略页面上看到，每个交易日更新。以上都是回测结果，不构成投资建议。

title.en: Trend Following vs Mean Reversion: What 381 Backtests on 10 Markets Show
title.zh: 趋势跟踪还是均值回归？10 个市场、381 次回测的答案

summary.en: We compared 24 trend-following and 15 mean-reversion strategies on ten markets over five years. Trend following had the better median Sharpe ratio on six markets, including gold, silver and bitcoin; mean reversion won on oil, broad commodities and agriculture. Mean reversion was in the market only 15% of the time and had less than half the drawdowns, but in a crash buying the dip hurt: on the S&P 500 in March 2020 it lost about four times as much as trend following.
summary.zh: 我们在 10 个市场上比较了 24 个趋势跟踪策略和 15 个均值回归策略近五年的表现。趋势跟踪在 6 个市场上夏普中位数更高，包括黄金、白银和比特币；均值回归在原油、综合大宗商品和农产品上胜出。均值回归只有 15% 的时间持仓，回撤不到趋势跟踪的一半；但遇到暴跌时，抄底很伤：2020 年 3 月的标普 500 上，它亏的差不多是趋势跟踪的四倍。

paragraphs.en: Quant Arena groups its strategies into families. Here we compare the 24 trend-following strategies (moving-average crossovers, channel breakouts, Supertrend, Ichimoku, turtle rules and similar) with the 15 mean-reversion strategies (RSI, Bollinger Bands, z-scores, Connors RSI and similar) on ten markets: the S&P 500 (SPY), gold, silver, oil, natural gas, agriculture, broad commodities, EUR/USD, bitcoin and ether. Every strategy uses daily data and walk-forward optimization, with no trading costs unless stated. The main window is the five years to 3 November 2026, which gives 240 trend-following and 141 mean-reversion results.
paragraphs.zh: Quant Arena 把策略分成几个大类。这次比较的是 24 个趋势跟踪策略（均线交叉、通道突破、超级趋势、一目均衡表、海龟法则等）和 15 个均值回归策略（RSI、布林带、Z 分数、康纳斯 RSI 等），市场共 10 个：标普 500（SPY）、黄金、白银、原油、天然气、农产品、综合大宗商品、欧元/美元、比特币和以太坊。所有策略都用日线数据和滚动前推优化，除非特别说明都不计交易成本。主要看截至 2026 年 11 月 3 日的近五年，一共是 240 个趋势跟踪结果和 141 个均值回归结果。

paragraphs.en: Median Sharpe ratio over five years, trend following vs mean reversion:
paragraphs.zh: 近五年的夏普中位数，趋势跟踪对均值回归：

en: Gold: 0.78 vs 0.35
Silver: 0.54 vs 0.07
Bitcoin: 0.35 vs 0.12
Ether: 0.20 vs 0.00
EUR/USD: 0.11 vs −0.13
Broad commodities: 0.38 vs 0.57
Agriculture: 0.39 vs 0.42
Natural gas: −0.24 vs −0.12
zh: 综合大宗商品：0.38 对 0.57

paragraphs.en: Trend following won where prices made long, one-way moves: precious metals and crypto. Mean reversion won on the commodity markets that went back and forth, oil above all, where its median Sharpe ratio of 0.85 was the best figure for either family on any market. On natural gas, which lost 35% a year, the median strategy of both families lost money.
paragraphs.zh: 价格走出长时间单边行情的市场，趋势跟踪赢了：贵金属和加密货币都是这样。来回震荡的大宗商品市场，均值回归赢了，尤其是原油：0.85 的夏普中位数是两类策略在所有市场里最高的一个。天然气每年跌 35%，两类策略都没占到便宜。

paragraphs.en: Across all markets, the median trend-following result returned 4.0% a year with a Sharpe ratio of 0.32 and a worst drawdown of 31.6%. The median mean-reversion result returned 0.8% a year with a Sharpe ratio of 0.20 and a worst drawdown of 14.7%.
paragraphs.zh: 把所有市场放在一起看，趋势跟踪的中位数结果是年化 4.0%、夏普 0.32、最大回撤 31.6%；均值回归的中位数结果是年化 0.8%、夏普 0.20、最大回撤 14.7%。

paragraphs.en: Most of the difference in drawdowns is time in the market. Mean-reversion rules wait for stretched prices and were invested only 15% of the time, against 49% for trend following. Both traded about 13 times a year, so costs hit them about equally: roughly 1.2 points of annual return at 10 basis points per unit traded.
paragraphs.zh: 回撤差这么多，主要是因为持仓时间不同。均值回归要等价格偏离得够远才出手，只有 15% 的时间在场内，趋势跟踪则是 49%。两类策略每年都交易 13 次左右，所以成本的影响差不多：按每单位成交 10 个基点算，每年大约少赚 1.2 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: The S&P 500 had three sharp sell-offs in our data: the fourth quarter of 2018 (−19.2%), the COVID crash of February and March 2020 (−33.7%) and the 2022 bear market (−24.5%). Nearly every strategy in both families lost far less than the index each time, because both spend a lot of time out of the market. But they protected in different ways.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的数据里，标普 500 有过三次急跌：2018 年四季度（−19.2%）、2020 年 2–3 月的新冠暴跌（−33.7%）和 2022 年熊市（−24.5%）。每一次，两类策略几乎都比指数亏得少得多，因为它们本来就有很多时间不在场内。但两者的保护方式不一样。

paragraphs.en: In the COVID crash the median trend-following strategy lost 4.7%: it had already stepped aside as prices broke down. The median mean-reversion strategy lost 18.3%, because each new low looked like a bargain and triggered another buy. In the slower 2022 decline mean reversion did better: its median strategy ended flat, against −8.0% for trend following.
paragraphs.zh: 新冠暴跌时，趋势跟踪的中位数策略只亏了 4.7%：价格跌破趋势时它已经离场了。均值回归的中位数策略亏了 18.3%，因为每一个新低看起来都像便宜货，于是一次又一次地买进。到了跌得比较慢的 2022 年，均值回归反而更好：中位数策略不赚不亏，趋势跟踪则是 −8.0%。

paragraphs.en: Over the year to November 2026 the picture was more one-sided: trend following had the better median Sharpe ratio on eight of ten markets. The exception that matters most is the S&P 500, where mean reversion led clearly (1.07 against 0.33) in a market that rose 11.6% with only shallow pullbacks. One year is a short sample, but it is a reminder that the better family changes with the character of the market.
paragraphs.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月的一年里，局面更一边倒：10 个市场中有 8 个是趋势跟踪的夏普中位数更高。最值得注意的例外是标普 500：这一年指数涨了 11.6%，回调都很浅，均值回归明显领先（1.07 对 0.33）。一年的样本很短，但它提醒我们，哪一类策略更好，会随着市场的性格而变。

heading.zh: 两类策略都很难跑赢持有

paragraphs.en: In absolute return both families mostly trailed buy-and-hold: 84 of 240 trend-following results (35%) and 41 of 141 mean-reversion results (29%) earned more than holding the market over five years. On five of the ten markets, simply holding had a higher Sharpe ratio than the median strategy of either family. Their value lies in how they lose, not in how much they make.
paragraphs.zh: 论绝对收益，两类策略大多不如买入持有：近五年里，240 个趋势跟踪结果中有 84 个（35%）、141 个均值回归结果中有 41 个（29%）赚得比持有多。在 10 个市场中的 5 个，直接持有的夏普比两类策略的中位数都高。它们的价值在于怎么亏，而不是能赚多少。

heading.en: The gap inside each family is bigger
heading.zh: 同一类策略之间的差别更大

paragraphs.en: The difference between the families is smaller than the difference within them. The middle half of trend-following results had Sharpe ratios between 0.05 and 0.55; for mean reversion the middle half ran from −0.06 to 0.46. 77% of trend-following results and 66% of mean-reversion results had a positive Sharpe ratio. Choosing a sound rule, and checking it on more than one market, matters more than choosing the family.
paragraphs.zh: 两类策略之间的差距，比同一类内部的差距小。趋势跟踪中间一半结果的夏普在 0.05 到 0.55 之间；均值回归中间一半在 −0.06 到 0.46 之间。77% 的趋势跟踪结果和 66% 的均值回归结果夏普为正。选对一条靠谱的规则、并在不止一个市场上验证，比选哪一类更重要。

en: Trend following suited markets with long one-way moves (gold, silver, crypto) and lost little in sudden crashes.
Mean reversion suited choppy commodity markets and kept drawdowns small by staying out most of the time, but buying dips in a crash was costly.
Neither beat simply holding on most markets. Use them to shape risk, and judge any strategy on several markets, not one.
zh: 趋势跟踪适合有长时间单边行情的市场（黄金、白银、加密货币），突然暴跌时亏得少。
均值回归适合来回震荡的大宗商品市场，大部分时间不持仓，所以回撤小；但在暴跌中抄底代价很大。
两者在大多数市场上都跑不赢直接持有。用它们来控制风险，并且在多个市场上检验一个策略，而不是只看一个。

paragraphs.en: The strategy heatmap shows every strategy on every market with current data. These are backtests, not investment advice.
paragraphs.zh: 策略热力图上有每个策略在每个市场上的最新数据。以上都是回测结果，不构成投资建议。

title.en: We Backtested 56 Trading Strategies on Gold. Only 3 Beat Simply Holding It.
title.zh: 我们在黄金上回测了 56 个交易策略，只有 3 个跑赢了直接持有

summary.en: Gold more than doubled between November 2021 and November 2026, then fell 28% from its January 2026 peak. Over those five years only three of 56 rule-based strategies earned more than simply holding the gold ETF. But 55 had smaller drawdowns, eleven had a better Sharpe ratio, and trend and volatility rules worked noticeably better on gold than on the S&P 500.
summary.zh: 2021 年 11 月到 2026 年 11 月，黄金涨了一倍多，又从 2026 年 1 月的高点跌了 28%。这五年里，56 个规则化策略只有 3 个比直接持有黄金 ETF 赚得多。但有 55 个策略的最大回撤更小，11 个的夏普比率更高；而且趋势和波动率类策略在黄金上的表现明显好于在标普 500 上。

paragraphs.en: Every strategy on Quant Arena runs under the same rules: daily data, signals at the close executed on the next session, walk-forward optimization that re-fits parameters on past data every six months, full allocation without leverage, and no trading costs unless stated. This study uses the 56 strategies that trade gold through GLD, the largest gold ETF, from 3 November 2021 to 3 November 2026. Buy-and-hold means owning GLD for the whole period.
paragraphs.zh: Quant Arena 上的每个策略都按同一套规则回测：日线数据，收盘时出信号、下一个交易日执行，用滚动前推优化每六个月只用过去的数据重新选参数，满仓、不加杠杆，除非特别说明都不计交易成本。这次看的是在 GLD（规模最大的黄金 ETF）上交易的 56 个策略，时间从 2021 年 11 月 3 日到 2026 年 11 月 3 日。“买入持有”就是这五年一直拿着 GLD。

paragraphs.en: Holding GLD returned 117% over the five years, 16.73% a year, with a Sharpe ratio of 0.91. Most of it came late: gold rose 27% in 2024 and 64% in 2025. Only three strategies earned a higher annual return, and none by more than a percentage point:
paragraphs.zh: 这五年直接持有 GLD 的总收益是 117%，年化 16.73%，夏普比率 0.91。大部分涨幅来得很晚：2024 年涨了 27%，2025 年涨了 64%。只有 3 个策略的年化收益更高，而且领先都不到 1 个百分点：

en: **REG-01 Regime Switch**: 17.42% a year, worst drawdown 17.7%
**RISK-01 Drawdown Control**: 17.12% a year, worst drawdown 24.4%
**RISK-03 Stop Loss Overlay**: 16.92% a year, worst drawdown 13.9%
zh: **REG-01 市场状态切换**：年化 17.42%，最大回撤 17.7%
**RISK-01 回撤控制**：年化 17.12%，最大回撤 24.4%
**RISK-03 止损叠加**：年化 16.92%，最大回撤 13.9%

paragraphs.en: It is the same story as on the S&P 500, where two of 62 strategies beat buy-and-hold over the same five years. In a strong, steady rally, any rule that spends time out of the market gives up return.
paragraphs.zh: 这和标普 500 上的情况一样：同样五年，62 个策略里只有 2 个跑赢买入持有。在一轮又强又稳的上涨里，任何会离场的规则都要少赚一些。

paragraphs.en: 55 of the 56 strategies had a smaller worst drawdown than holding gold, which fell 28.3% at its worst; the exception, MOM-03 52-Week High Momentum, fell 33.9%. Most of the difference comes from simply not always being invested: the median strategy was in the market 47% of the time. Eleven strategies also had a higher Sharpe ratio than buy-and-hold, meaning more return for each unit of volatility.
paragraphs.zh: 56 个策略中有 55 个的最大回撤小于直接持有黄金（最大回撤 28.3%）；唯一的例外是 MOM-03 52 周新高动量，最大回撤 33.9%。差别主要来自它们不总在场内：中位数策略只有 47% 的时间持仓。另外有 11 个策略的夏普比率高于买入持有，也就是每承担一单位波动，赚得更多。

paragraphs.en: The best balance came from **VOL-13 Volatility Regime Strategy**: 11.4% a year with a Sharpe ratio of 1.20 and a worst drawdown of 10.5%, less than 40% of buy-and-hold's. **REG-01 Regime Switch** came closest to having both: 17.4% a year, Sharpe 1.19, worst drawdown 17.7%. **RISK-03 Stop Loss Overlay** matched gold's return with half its drawdown (13.9%).
paragraphs.zh: 平衡得最好的是 **VOL-13 波动率状态策略**：年化 11.4%，夏普 1.20，最大回撤 10.5%，还不到买入持有的 40%。**REG-01 市场状态切换** 最接近两头兼顾：年化 17.4%，夏普 1.19，最大回撤 17.7%。**RISK-03 止损叠加** 赚到了和黄金差不多的收益，回撤只有一半（13.9%）。

heading.en: Gold suits trend and volatility rules
heading.zh: 黄金更适合趋势和波动率策略

paragraphs.en: All 56 strategies also ran on the S&P 500 (SPY) over the same five years, so they can be compared directly. 33 of the 56 had a higher Sharpe ratio on gold. By family, the median Sharpe ratio on gold versus SPY was:
paragraphs.zh: 这 56 个策略同一时间段也都在标普 500（SPY）上跑过，可以直接对比。其中 33 个在黄金上的夏普比率更高。按策略类别看，黄金和 SPY 上的夏普中位数分别是：

en: Volatility strategies: 0.98 vs 0.47
Trend following: 0.78 vs 0.53
Momentum: 0.69 vs 0.63
Mean reversion: 0.35 vs 0.42
zh: 波动率策略：0.98 对 0.47

paragraphs.en: Gold's gains came in long runs, the kind of market that trend and volatility-breakout rules are built for. Buying dips did not help: mean-reversion rules did slightly worse on gold than on stocks.
paragraphs.zh: 黄金的涨幅是一段一段持续出来的，正好是趋势和波动率突破规则擅长的行情。逢低买入就没占到便宜：均值回归策略在黄金上反而比在股票上稍差。

heading.en: The last twelve months: a 28% fall
heading.zh: 最近 12 个月：一次 28% 的下跌

paragraphs.en: The last year looked very different. Gold peaked on 29 January 2026, fell 28% to its low on 30 October, and ended the twelve months 2.6% lower. 41 of the 56 strategies did better than holding, and all but one had a smaller drawdown.
paragraphs.zh: 最近一年完全是另一番景象。黄金在 2026 年 1 月 29 日见顶，到 10 月 30 日的低点跌了 28%，整整 12 个月下来跌了 2.6%。56 个策略里有 41 个比持有表现好，除了一个之外回撤都更小。

paragraphs.en: The one-year leader was **MR-01 RSI Mean Reversion**: +18.5% with a Sharpe ratio of 1.80, from 22 trades and only 9% of the time in the market. Over the full five years the same strategy made 4.8% a year on gold. Twenty-two trades is a small sample, and one-year leaders change often, so treat them with care.
paragraphs.zh: 近一年排第一的是 **MR-01 RSI 均值回归**：收益 +18.5%，夏普 1.80，只交易了 22 次，持仓时间仅占 9%。但放到完整的五年，同一个策略在黄金上的年化只有 4.8%。22 笔交易的样本很小，一年期的冠军也经常换人，看的时候要谨慎。

paragraphs.en: On gold, 25 of the 56 strategies have a probabilistic Sharpe ratio above 95%: judged on its own, each has a 95% or higher probability that its true Sharpe ratio is above zero. On the S&P 500 the count is 11 of 62. But once you correct for testing hundreds of strategy-and-market pairs at the same time (the deflated Sharpe ratio), none reaches 95%; the best, VOL-13, gets to 80%.
paragraphs.zh: 在黄金上，56 个策略中有 25 个的概率夏普比率（PSR）超过 95%：单独来看，每个都有 95% 以上的把握真实夏普大于 0。在标普 500 上是 62 个中有 11 个。但如果考虑到我们同时测试了几百个“策略 × 市场”组合（Deflated Sharpe），没有一个能达到 95%，最高的 VOL-13 也只有 80%。

paragraphs.en: That is the same lesson as in our luck-adjusted study of all 72 strategies: these are promising candidates, not proven edges.
paragraphs.zh: 这和我们对全部 72 个策略做的运气修正研究结论一样：这些是值得关注的候选，而不是被证明了的优势。

paragraphs.en: All figures are before trading costs. At an assumed 10 basis points per unit traded, the strategies above give up between 0.3 and 2 points of annual return: about 0.3 for RISK-01, 0.9 for REG-01, 1.6 for RISK-03 and 2 for VOL-13. Busier strategies pay much more: TREND-17 Chandelier Exit, with 332 trades, drops from 11.5% to roughly 4.8% a year. Every strategy page has a cost slider to try other levels.
paragraphs.zh: 以上数字都没扣交易成本。按每单位成交 10 个基点的成本估算，上面这些策略每年要少赚 0.3 到 2 个百分点：RISK-01 约 0.3，REG-01 约 0.9，RISK-03 约 1.6，VOL-13 约 2。交易越频繁，成本越高：交易了 332 次的 TREND-17 吊灯止损，年化会从 11.5% 降到 4.8% 左右。每个策略页面都有成本滑块，可以试试别的成本水平。

en: If you just wanted gold's return, holding it was hard to beat: 53 of 56 strategies earned less over five years.
If you wanted gold with less pain, several rules cut the worst drawdown by between a third and almost two-thirds while keeping much of the return, and volatility- and regime-based rules did best.
One-year winners, and any result not adjusted for multiple testing, deserve extra skepticism.
zh: 如果只是想拿到黄金的收益，直接持有很难被超越：五年下来 56 个策略里有 53 个赚得更少。
如果想少受点罪，有几个规则把最大回撤砍掉了三分之一到将近三分之二，同时保住了大部分收益，其中波动率和市场状态类策略做得最好。
一年期的冠军，以及没做多重检验修正的结果，都要多打几个问号。

paragraphs.en: The gold column of the strategy heatmap and the leaderboard show the current numbers, updated every trading day. These are backtests, not investment advice.
paragraphs.zh: 策略热力图的黄金一列和排行榜上有最新数字，每个交易日更新。以上都是回测结果，不构成投资建议。

title.en: We Backtested 72 Strategies. After Adjusting for Luck, None Clearly Beat the Odds.
title.zh: 我们回测了 72 个策略，扣除运气之后，没有一个能明确胜出

summary.en: 104 strategy-and-market combinations look statistically convincing on their own. Once you account for the fact that we tested hundreds of them at the same time, the number drops to zero. Here is what that means for reading any leaderboard, including ours.
summary.zh: 单独看，有 104 个“策略 × 市场”的结果在统计上很有说服力；可一旦考虑到我们同时测试了几百个，这个数字就变成了零。这对怎么看任何排行榜（包括我们自己的）都很重要。

paragraphs.en: Quant Arena runs 72 systematic strategies on up to 10 markets — US stocks (SPY), gold, silver, oil, natural gas, agriculture, broad commodities, EUR/USD, bitcoin and ether — with the same rules, the same walk-forward optimization and the same metrics. Over the last five years of data that gives 576 strategy-and-market results.
paragraphs.zh: Quant Arena 在最多 10 个市场上运行 72 个系统化策略：美股（SPY）、黄金、白银、原油、天然气、农产品、综合大宗商品、欧元/美元、比特币和以太坊。所有策略使用同样的规则、同样的滚动前推优化和同样的指标。近五年的数据一共给出 576 个“策略 × 市场”结果。

paragraphs.en: For each one we compute two numbers that try to answer the question "is this edge real or luck?":
paragraphs.zh: 每个结果我们都算两个数，试图回答“这是真本事还是运气”：

en: The **probabilistic Sharpe ratio (PSR)**: the probability that the true Sharpe ratio is above zero, given how long and how lumpy the return history is.
The **deflated Sharpe ratio (DSR)**: the same question, but against the best Sharpe ratio you would expect from luck alone when you test many strategies at once.
zh: **概率夏普（PSR）**：结合收益记录的长度和形状，真实夏普大于 0 的概率。
**Deflated 夏普（DSR）**：同一个问题，但比较对象换成“同时测试很多策略时，单靠运气能达到的最好夏普”。

paragraphs.en: Looked at one by one, 104 of the 576 results have a PSR above 95%. That is the kind of number that ends up in a marketing deck.
paragraphs.zh: 逐个看，576 个结果里有 104 个的 PSR 超过 95%，这种数字很容易被写进宣传材料。

paragraphs.en: The DSR tells a different story. Not a single result clears 95%. The best is SAR-01 Parabolic SAR on EUR/USD at 91%, followed by REG-14 Volatility Regime Switch on gold (85%), MACRO-01 Cross-Asset Momentum on SPY (84%), TREND-20 Vortex Indicator on EUR/USD (83%), and MR-03 Kalman Filter Mean Reversion on broad commodities and VOL-13 Volatility Regime Strategy on gold (82% each). The median DSR across all 576 results is 23%.
paragraphs.zh: DSR 给出的答案完全不同：没有一个结果超过 95%。最高的是欧元/美元上的 SAR-01 抛物线 SAR（91%），其后是黄金上的 REG-14 波动率状态切换（85%）、SPY 上的 MACRO-01 跨资产动量（84%）、欧元/美元上的 TREND-20 涡旋指标（83%），以及综合大宗商品上的 MR-03 卡尔曼滤波均值回归和黄金上的 VOL-13 波动率状态策略（都是 82%）。576 个结果的 DSR 中位数只有 23%。

paragraphs.en: In plain words: if you pick the best-looking strategy after trying hundreds, a five-year Sharpe ratio of 1.2–1.5 is roughly what chance alone would hand you.
paragraphs.zh: 说白了：试了几百个之后挑出看起来最好的那个，五年夏普 1.2 到 1.5，差不多就是运气本身能给你的水平。

paragraphs.en: Every extra strategy you test is another lottery ticket. With 60 strategies on the same market, the luckiest one will usually show a Sharpe ratio well above its true value. The DSR, introduced by Bailey and López de Prado, estimates how high that "luckiest ticket" should be from the spread of all the results, and only gives credit for the part above it.
paragraphs.zh: 每多测试一个策略，就多买了一张彩票。同一个市场上有 60 个策略时，最幸运的那个，夏普通常会明显高于它的真实水平。Bailey 和 López de Prado 提出的 DSR，用所有结果的离散程度估计“最幸运的那张彩票”该有多高，只把超过这条线的部分算作真本事。

paragraphs.en: Two details in our setup make the bar higher, not lower. First, the same strategy appears on many correlated markets. Second, walk-forward optimization picks parameters from a small grid every six months, which is itself a form of testing. We count only the strategies, not the parameter sets, so if anything our DSR is still generous.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的设置里有两点会让门槛更高而不是更低：第一，同一个策略出现在多个相关的市场上；第二，滚动前推优化每六个月从一个小参数网格里挑参数，这本身也是一种“多次测试”。我们只把策略个数算作试验次数，没有算参数组合，所以我们的 DSR 其实还偏宽松。

heading.zh: 买入持有是个很难打败的基准

paragraphs.en: The same five years show how high the bar was. Buy-and-hold SPY returned about 13.2% a year with a Sharpe ratio of 0.81. Only 1 of the 62 strategies tested on SPY beat it on annual return, and 14 beat it on Sharpe ratio. Most timing strategies spend part of the time in cash, so they give up return in exchange for smaller drawdowns — a trade-off that can be worth it, but is not "beating the market".
paragraphs.zh: 同样这五年，也能看出门槛有多高：买入持有 SPY 年化约 13.2%，夏普 0.81。在 SPY 上测试的 62 个策略里，只有 1 个年化收益超过它，14 个夏普超过它。大多数择时策略有一部分时间空仓，用更小的回撤换了更低的收益——这种交换可能值得，但它不等于“跑赢市场”。

heading.en: How to use this when you read a leaderboard
heading.zh: 看排行榜时可以怎么用

en: Treat a high Sharpe ratio as a reason to look closer, not as a conclusion. Check the DSR on the strategy page.
Prefer strategies that hold up across markets and time windows. The Arena Score's robustness component uses the worst Sharpe across the 1-, 3-, 5-year and full windows for exactly this reason.
Look at what a strategy was designed to do. A trend filter that halves the drawdown of buy-and-hold is doing its job even if its DSR is modest.
Remember the costs. Our backtests do not subtract commissions or slippage; strategy pages show an estimate after 10 basis points.
zh: 把高夏普当成值得细看的理由，而不是结论。去策略页看看 DSR。
优先选在不同市场、不同时间窗口都站得住的策略。Arena Score 的稳健性分项用的就是 1 年、3 年、5 年和全部历史中最差的那个夏普。
看策略本来想解决什么问题。一个把买入持有的回撤砍掉一半的趋势过滤，即使 DSR 不高，也是在做它该做的事。
别忘了成本。我们的回测没有扣佣金和滑点；策略页给出了扣除 10 个基点后的估算。

paragraphs.en: The deflated Sharpe ratio now appears on every strategy page next to the probabilistic Sharpe ratio, and the Arena Score uses PSR for its significance component. We would rather show an honest "probably luck" than a confident number that will not survive the next five years.
paragraphs.zh: 现在每个策略页都会在概率夏普旁边显示 Deflated 夏普，Arena Score 的统计可信度分项也使用 PSR。我们宁愿诚实地告诉你“很可能是运气”，也不想给出一个下一个五年就站不住的漂亮数字。

title.en: We Tried to Backtest 1,063 Free MT5 Expert Advisors. Here Is What Survived.
title.zh: 我们试着回测了 1063 个免费 MT5 EA，最后留下了什么

summary.en: Free MetaTrader 5 EAs from the MQL5 CodeBase, converted automatically and tested on four markets for one year. More than half could not be converted at all. Of the 1,123 results we trust, about half made money — but on currencies the typical EA ended flat, only 30 EAs were profitable on all four markets, and one in five gold runs wiped out the account.
summary.zh: 来自 MQL5 代码库的免费 MetaTrader 5 智能交易系统，经自动转换后在四个市场上测试了一年。一半以上根本没法转换；在 1123 个可信的结果里，大约一半赚钱——但在外汇上，典型的 EA 基本不赚不亏，只有 30 个 EA 在四个市场上都盈利，黄金上每五次回测就有一次把账户亏光。

paragraphs.en: **Update, 3 November 2026:** after publishing we found 85 EAs whose converted versions produce exactly the same backtest as another EA on every market — for example 14 unrelated EAs with identical results. The conversion evidently lost what made them different, so their 298 runs are no longer counted, and the figures below have been recalculated. Most of them were profitable on gold, so the gold numbers fell the most. All figures here come from the test on hourly data from May 2025 to May 2026. Since 4 November 2026 every EA is re-run each month on the latest twelve months, so the numbers on the EA pages differ slightly from this article.
paragraphs.zh: **2026 年 11 月 3 日更新：** 文章发布后我们发现，有 85 个 EA 转换后的回测在每个市场上都和另一个 EA 一模一样——比如有 14 个毫不相干的 EA 结果完全相同。这说明转换丢掉了它们各自的特点，所以这 298 次运行不再计入，下面的数字都已重新计算。这些结果大多在黄金上赚钱，所以黄金相关的数字变化最大。文中所有数字都来自 2025 年 5 月至 2026 年 5 月小时线上的那次测试。2026 年 11 月 4 日起，每个 EA 每月都会用最近 12 个月的数据重跑一次，所以 EA 页面上的数字和本文会略有不同。

paragraphs.en: The EA Arena catalogs 1,515 Expert Advisors published on the MQL5 CodeBase. For 1,063 of them we translated the MQL5 source into Python automatically and backtested it on one year of hourly data (May 2025 to May 2026) for EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY and gold. Every EA got the same account: $10,000, 1:100 leverage, the EA's own lot size (100,000 units per currency lot, 100 ounces per gold lot), one order at a time, the same commission, and a broker-style stop-out when equity falls below 10% of the starting balance.
paragraphs.zh: EA 竞技场收录了 MQL5 代码库里公开的 1515 个智能交易系统。其中 1063 个，我们把 MQL5 源码自动翻译成 Python，在欧元/美元、英镑/美元、美元/日元和黄金一年的小时线数据（2025 年 5 月到 2026 年 5 月）上回测。所有 EA 用同样的账户条件：1 万美元本金、1:100 杠杆、按 EA 自己设定的手数下单（外汇每手 10 万单位，黄金每手 100 盎司）、同一时间只有一张挂单、相同的佣金，净值跌破初始资金 10% 时像券商一样强制平仓。

heading.en: Most EAs could not be tested
heading.zh: 大多数 EA 没法测试

paragraphs.en: Automatic conversion is hard. Out of 4,252 EA-and-market runs:
paragraphs.zh: 自动转换很难。4252 次“EA × 市场”运行中：

en: 2,348 came from EAs whose entry logic the converter could not translate (custom indicators, unusual order handling). We label them "not convertible yet" instead of pretending they were tested.
144 depend on a custom indicator the converter replaced with a placeholder, so they do not test the real EA.

155 converted but never traded. For 112 of them we can point to the conversion bug: the fast and slow settings of a crossover were lost, a price-based indicator was asked to cross zero, lines on different scales were compared, or no entry rule survived.
88 stopped with an error, and 96 traded too little or produced a flat curve.
298 runs from 85 different EAs came out exactly identical to another EA's run on every market, which means the conversion lost what made them different. We no longer count them.
1,123 results are reliable enough to rank.
zh: 2348 次来自转换器无法翻译开仓逻辑的 EA（自定义指标、特殊的下单方式等）。我们把它们标为“暂不支持转换”，而不是假装测过。
144 次依赖转换器无法翻译的自定义指标，回测里用了占位指标代替，测的并不是 EA 的真实逻辑。
155 次转换成功但从未交易。其中 112 次能找到具体的转换错误：均线交叉的快慢参数丢失、要求基于价格的指标穿越 0、拿量纲不同的两条线比较，或者开仓规则在转换中丢了。
88 次运行报错，96 次交易太少或曲线持平。
还有 85 个不同的 EA、共 298 次运行，在每个市场上都和另一个 EA 的结果一模一样，说明转换丢掉了它们各自的特点，这些我们不再计入。
剩下 1123 个结果足够可信，可以排名。

en: About half were profitable: 562 of 1,123. The median result was roughly zero over the year, with a median maximum drawdown of 7.8%. The typical EA had a longest losing streak of 6 trades and held a position for about a day.
On the three currency pairs the typical EA went nowhere: the median result was −0.12%, and only 27 of 830 currency results made more than 10%.

Gold looks better than it is. Gold rose 44% over the test year, so long-leaning systems were carried by the trend: the median gold result was +4.5% — with a median drawdown of 60%. 61 of 293 gold runs (21%) lost the whole account.
Consistency was rare: of 271 EAs with reliable results on all four markets, 30 were profitable on every one.
187 results had a Sharpe ratio above 1. Over a single year that is easy to reach by chance, which is why the EA Ranking also shows the recovery factor and how many markets an EA made money on.
zh: 大约一半赚钱：1123 个里有 562 个。中位数结果一年基本是 0，最大回撤中位数 7.8%。典型的 EA 最长连亏 6 笔，平均持仓大约一天。
在三个货币对上，典型的 EA 原地踏步：中位数结果是 −0.12%，830 个外汇结果里只有 27 个赚了 10% 以上。
黄金的数字看起来比实际好。测试这一年黄金涨了 44%，偏多的系统是被趋势带着走的：黄金结果的中位数是 +4.5%，但回撤中位数高达 60%；293 次黄金回测里有 61 次（21%）把整个账户亏光。
稳定的很少：在四个市场都有可信结果的 271 个 EA 里，只有 30 个在每个市场都盈利。
187 个结果的夏普超过 1。只看一年，这个水平很容易靠运气达到，所以 EA 排行榜还展示了恢复因子和 EA 在几个品种上赚钱。

paragraphs.en: The arena's risk review rates 34 of 40 martingale EAs and 14 of 33 grid EAs as "dangerous": they increase exposure after losses or keep opening positions against the trend. In our backtests martingale EAs did not show the usual very high win rates (median 49%), most likely because the automatic conversion trades a fixed lot size instead of reproducing the lot multiplication. Their real-world risk is therefore higher than these numbers suggest — read the risk review on each EA page, not only the backtest.
paragraphs.zh: 竞技场的风险评估把 40 个马丁格尔 EA 中的 34 个、33 个网格 EA 中的 14 个评为“危险”：它们在亏损后加大仓位，或者逆势不断开新仓。在我们的回测里，马丁 EA 并没有表现出通常那种很高的胜率（中位数 49%），很可能是因为自动转换用了固定手数，没有还原加倍下注的逻辑。所以它们在真实交易中的风险比这些数字显示的更高——请看每个 EA 页面上的风险评估，而不只是回测结果。

heading.en: How to use the EA Arena
heading.zh: 怎么用 EA 竞技场

en: Treat "not convertible yet" as "unknown", not "bad".
Look for EAs that hold up on several markets, not one spectacular result. The "Markets" column in the EA Ranking shows this at a glance.
On gold, check the drawdown before the profit: 0.1 lot of gold on a $10,000 account is a much bigger bet than 0.1 lot of EUR/USD.
Check the risk rating and the risk points before the P&L.

Free code is a learning resource. If you trade an EA, test it yourself in the MT5 Strategy Tester with your broker's data and costs — and you can compare the result with the arena in the Strategy Lab.
zh: 把“暂不支持转换”理解为“未知”，而不是“不好”。
找在多个市场上都站得住的 EA，而不是某一次特别亮眼的结果。EA 排行榜里的“盈利品种”一栏一眼就能看出来。
看黄金 EA 时先看回撤再看收益：1 万美元的账户做 0.1 手黄金，风险比 0.1 手欧元/美元大得多。
先看风险等级和风险点，再看盈亏。
免费代码是很好的学习材料。如果要实盘，请用自己券商的数据和成本在 MT5 策略测试器里重新测试——测完可以到策略实验室和竞技场的策略比一比。

title.en: Which Strategies Survived 2022, and Did the Winners Keep Winning?
title.zh: 哪些策略熬过了 2022 年？赢家后来还继续赢吗？

summary.en: In calendar 2022 US stocks fell 18.2% and only 10 of 55 single-market strategies finished positive, 8 of them mean-reversion rules. In 2023 those ten all stayed positive, yet their median return was 3.7% against 14.8% for the rest, and the rank correlation between the two years was −0.58.
summary.zh: 2022 日历年美股下跌 18.2%，55 个单市场策略里只有 10 个收正，其中 8 个是均值回归规则。到 2023 年，这十个全部继续为正，但收益中位数只有 3.7%，其余策略是 14.8%，两年排名的秩相关系数为 −0.58。

heading.en: The question and how it was tested

paragraphs.en: This article asks which of the site's rule-based strategies came through it with a gain, what they had in common, and whether being a 2022 winner told you anything about 2023.
paragraphs.zh: 本文要回答的是：站内的规则型策略里，哪些在 2022 年带着盈利走了出来，它们有什么共同点，以及“2022 年的赢家”对 2023 年有没有预示作用。

paragraphs.en: The test is calendar 2022: the return from the last close of 2021 to the last close of 2022, for 55 single-market strategies on each of ten markets, 550 strategy-market series in all. Divergence Strategy (COMBO-03) is left out because its code looks ahead. The 16 portfolio strategies, which trade baskets, are counted separately. Parameters come from walk-forward selection, positions are decided at the close and earn the next day's return, and everything is before trading costs. Data runs to 2026-11-11.
paragraphs.zh: 测试区间为 2022 日历年：从 2021 年最后一个收盘价到 2022 年最后一个收盘价。覆盖 10 个市场、每个市场 55 个单市场策略，共 550 条“策略-市场”序列。Divergence Strategy（COMBO-03）的代码存在前视问题，已排除。16 个投资组合类策略（交易一篮子资产）单独统计。参数由滚动前推优化选出，仓位在收盘时决定并赚取次日收益，所有结果均未扣交易成本。数据截至 2026-11-11。

heading.en: US stocks: ten of 55 finished positive
heading.zh: 美股：55 个里 10 个收正

paragraphs.en: Buy-and-hold SPY lost 18.2% in 2022, with a maximum drawdown inside the year of −24.5%. Of the 55 strategies, 10 finished positive, 2 finished flat with no trades (Elder Triple Screen, TREND-19, and TRIX Reversion, MR-13) and 43 lost money. The median was −6.4%. Fifty-one lost less than holding; three lost more, and a fourth, Stop Loss Overlay, matched it to two decimals (−18.18%).
paragraphs.zh: 2022 年买入持有 SPY 亏损 18.2%，年内最大回撤为 −24.5%。55 个策略中，10 个收正，2 个持平且没有交易（Elder Triple Screen，TREND-19；TRIX Reversion，MR-13），43 个亏损，中位数为 −6.4%。51 个亏得比持有少，3 个亏得更多，还有 1 个——Stop Loss Overlay——与持有在小数点后两位上持平（−18.18%）。

paragraphs.en: The ten winners were RSI Mean Reversion (MR-01, +11.2%), Ultimate Oscillator (MR-15, +10.4%), Linear Regression Channel (TREND-14, +9.4%), Kalman Filter Mean Reversion (MR-03, +6.2%), Stochastic Oscillator Reversion (MR-10, +5.7%), Bollinger Band Reversion (MR-02, +5.7%), Z-Score Mean Reversion (MR-06, +4.7%), Hurst-Filtered Mean Reversion (MR-07, +4.5%), Detrended Price Oscillator (MR-14, +1.7%) and MACD + RSI Filter (COMBO-02, +1.1%).
paragraphs.zh: 十个赢家依次是：RSI Mean Reversion（MR-01，+11.2%）、Ultimate Oscillator（MR-15，+10.4%）、Linear Regression Channel（TREND-14，+9.4%）、Kalman Filter Mean Reversion（MR-03，+6.2%）、Stochastic Oscillator Reversion（MR-10，+5.7%）、Bollinger Band Reversion（MR-02，+5.7%）、Z-Score Mean Reversion（MR-06，+4.7%）、Hurst-Filtered Mean Reversion（MR-07，+4.5%）、Detrended Price Oscillator（MR-14，+1.7%）和 MACD + RSI Filter（COMBO-02，+1.1%）。

paragraphs.en: The worst were Drawdown Control (RISK-01, −24.3%), Parabolic SAR (SAR-01, −19.5%), Time-Series Momentum (MOM-01, −18.5%) and Stop Loss Overlay (RISK-03, −18.2%), the first three below holding and the fourth level with it, followed by HMA Crossover (HMA-01, −17.7%) and Williams %R Reversion (MR-11, −17.4%).
paragraphs.zh: 表现最差的是 Drawdown Control（RISK-01，−24.3%）、Parabolic SAR（SAR-01，−19.5%）、Time-Series Momentum（MOM-01，−18.5%）和 Stop Loss Overlay（RISK-03，−18.2%），前三个低于持有，第四个与持有持平；其后是 HMA Crossover（HMA-01，−17.7%）和 Williams %R Reversion（MR-11，−17.4%）。

paragraphs.en: Using the strategy tags (a strategy can carry several):
paragraphs.zh: 按策略标签统计（一个策略可以带多个标签）：

en: **Mean Reversion:** 15 strategies, median +1.7%, 8 positive. The six that lost money included Williams %R Reversion (−17.4%) and CCI Mean Reversion (MR-05, −10.3%), so the tag is no guarantee.
**Trend:** 24 strategies, median −8.0%, 1 positive (Linear Regression Channel).
**Momentum:** 12 strategies, median −10.8%, 1 positive (MACD + RSI Filter).
**Volatility:** 9 strategies, median −8.0%, 1 positive (Bollinger Band Reversion).
**Regime:** 4 strategies, median −12.7%, none positive. **Risk Management:** 4 strategies, median −16.0%, none positive.
zh: **均值回归（Mean Reversion）**：15 个策略，中位数 +1.7%，8 个为正。亏钱的 6 个包括 Williams %R Reversion（−17.4%）和 CCI Mean Reversion（MR-05，−10.3%），所以这个标签并不保证什么。
**趋势（Trend）**：24 个策略，中位数 −8.0%，1 个为正（Linear Regression Channel）。
**动量（Momentum）**：12 个策略，中位数 −10.8%，1 个为正（MACD + RSI Filter）。
**波动率（Volatility）**：9 个策略，中位数 −8.0%，1 个为正（Bollinger Band Reversion）。
**市场状态（Regime）**：4 个策略，中位数 −12.7%，无一为正。**风险管理（Risk Management）**：4 个策略，中位数 −16.0%，无一为正。

paragraphs.en: Eight of the ten winners carry the Mean Reversion tag. A note on what these rules do: RSI Mean Reversion is long only on days when its 14-day RSI is below 30 and flat otherwise (it does not hold until RSI recovers), which is why it was in the market on just 13% of days.
paragraphs.zh: 十个赢家中有 8 个带均值回归标签。顺便说明这类规则实际怎么做：RSI Mean Reversion 只在 14 日 RSI 低于 30 的那些天持有，其余时间空仓（并不会一直持有到 RSI 回升），所以它在 2022 年只有 13% 的日子在场内。

heading.en: What the survivors had in common

paragraphs.en: They were rarely invested and shallow in their losses. The ten winners were in the market a median 25% of days in 2022 against 36% for the 43 losers, and nine of ten were under 50%. Their worst drawdown inside the year had a median of −8.2% (range −5.5% to −13.7%), against −13.3% for the losers and −24.5% for SPY. Across all 55 strategies the rank correlation between 2022 return and days in the market was −0.42.
paragraphs.zh: 它们很少持仓，亏损也浅。十个赢家在 2022 年的持仓天数占比中位数为 25%，43 个亏损策略为 36%，十个里有九个低于 50%。它们年内最大回撤的中位数为 −8.2%（范围 −5.5% 到 −13.7%），亏损策略为 −13.3%，SPY 为 −24.5%。在全部 55 个策略中，2022 年收益与持仓天数占比的秩相关系数为 −0.42。

paragraphs.en: Being out of the market was not enough. Twenty strategies were invested under 25% of days and only five of them finished positive; their median return was −3.1%. The one winner that was heavily invested, Linear Regression Channel, was in the market 65% of days, and its code lets it go short: it was short on 33% of days in 2022. It is the only one of the 55 US-stock strategies besides Crisis Alpha (TAIL-01) that took short positions that year.
