paragraphs.zh: 但光是少持仓还不够。有 20 个策略的持仓天数占比低于 25%，其中只有 5 个收正，它们的收益中位数是 −3.1%。唯一重仓的赢家是 Linear Regression Channel，持仓 65% 的日子，而它的代码允许做空：2022 年有 33% 的日子是空头。2022 年在 55 个美股策略中，除它之外只有 Crisis Alpha（TAIL-01）持有过空头仓位。

heading.en: Other markets: 2022 was a commodity year
heading.zh: 其他市场：2022 是大宗商品年

paragraphs.en: Across all ten markets 231 of 550 series finished positive. The split follows the market, not the rule:
paragraphs.zh: 10 个市场合计，550 条序列中有 231 条收正。分化跟着市场走，而不是跟着规则走：

en: Where holding rose (oil +29.0%, broad commodities +19.3%, natural gas +12.9%, agriculture +2.5%, silver +2.4%), 168 of 275 series were positive.
Where holding fell (US stocks −18.2%, EUR/USD −5.9%, gold −0.8%, bitcoin −64.3%, ether −67.5%), only 63 of 275 were.
zh: 持有上涨的市场（原油 +29.0%、综合大宗商品 +19.3%、天然气 +12.9%、农产品 +2.5%、白银 +2.4%），275 条序列中有 168 条为正。
持有下跌的市场（美股 −18.2%、欧元/美元 −5.9%、黄金 −0.8%、比特币 −64.3%、以太坊 −67.5%），275 条里只有 63 条为正。

paragraphs.en: Bitcoin was the starkest case: all 55 strategies lost less than holding, but only four finished positive, while on ether 11 did. No single family dominated outside US stocks: mean reversion was positive in 63 of 150 series (median −0.9%) and trend in 100 of 240 (median −1.0%). Of the 16 portfolio strategies, 6 finished positive, led by Dual Momentum (MOM-02, +29.0%), Hierarchical Risk Parity (PORT-05, +20.4%) and FX Carry (CARRY-01, +20.2%).
paragraphs.zh: 比特币最极端：55 个策略全部亏得比持有少，但只有 4 个收正，以太坊上则有 11 个。美股之外没有哪一类明显占优：均值回归类 150 条序列中 63 条为正（中位数 −0.9%），趋势类 240 条中 100 条为正（中位数 −1.0%）。16 个投资组合类策略中有 6 个收正，领先的是 Dual Momentum（MOM-02，+29.0%）、Hierarchical Risk Parity（PORT-05，+20.4%）和 FX Carry（CARRY-01，+20.2%）。

heading.zh: 2022 年的赢家在 2023 年继续赢了吗？

paragraphs.en: They did not, on any measure we tried. SPY rose 26.2% in 2023 and 51 of the 55 US-stock strategies were positive. All ten 2022 winners were positive again, but none beat holding, and their median return was 3.7% against 14.8% for the other 45. The ten worst of 2022 returned a median 17.1% in 2023. Only one of the 2022 top ten finished in the top half of the 2023 ranking, and their median 2023 rank was 45 out of 55. The Spearman rank correlation between the two years was −0.58.
paragraphs.zh: 不论怎么算，都没有。2023 年 SPY 上涨 26.2%，55 个美股策略中有 51 个为正。2022 年的十个赢家这一年也都为正，但没有一个跑赢持有，收益中位数是 3.7%，其余 45 个是 14.8%。2022 年最差的十个策略在 2023 年的收益中位数为 17.1%。2022 年前十名里只有一个在 2023 年排进前一半，它们 2023 年排名的中位数是 55 个中的第 45 名。两年之间的 Spearman 秩相关系数为 −0.58。

paragraphs.en: The other nine markets are less clear-cut but lean the same way. Across all ten markets the correlation was positive on only three, ranging from −0.58 to 0.21. Pooling all markets, 103 of the 231 strategies that made money in 2022 were positive in 2023 (median −0.4%), against 207 of the 319 others (median +4.1%).
paragraphs.zh: 其余九个市场没有这么清晰，但倾向相同：10 个市场里只有 3 个相关系数为正，范围在 −0.58 到 0.21 之间。把所有市场合并来看，2022 年赚钱的 231 条序列中有 103 条在 2023 年为正（中位数 −0.4%），其余 319 条中有 207 条为正（中位数 +4.1%）。

heading.zh: 这些数字没有说明什么

paragraphs.en: One year is one observation per strategy, and market conditions produced much of it: the same rules scored very differently across markets. The negative correlation is a statement about these two years, not a law. Samples are small in places (only four winners on bitcoin), the winners were in the market a median 25% of days, so each result rests on a limited number of trading days, and none of this includes trading costs.
paragraphs.zh: 一年对每个策略来说只是一个观察值，而且很大一部分来自市场环境：同样的规则在不同市场上的表现差别很大。负相关说的是这两年的情况，而不是什么规律。有些样本很小（比特币上只有 4 个赢家）；赢家的持仓天数占比中位数只有 25%，所以每个结果只建立在有限的几个交易日上；而且以上全部未计入交易成本。

en: In calendar 2022, 10 of 55 US-stock strategies made money; 8 were mean-reversion rules that were in the market a quarter of the time.
Low exposure and shallow drawdowns marked the survivors, but only 5 of the 20 strategies invested under a quarter of the days finished positive.
Across markets the result depended on the market: 168 of 275 series were positive where holding rose, 63 of 275 where it fell.
2022's winners were mostly 2023's laggards: the rank correlation was −0.58 on US stocks and positive on only three of ten markets.
Read single-year rankings as a description of that year.
zh: 2022 日历年，55 个美股策略中有 10 个赚钱；其中 8 个是均值回归规则，约四分之一的时间在场内。
幸存者的特征是低持仓、浅回撤，但持仓天数占比低于 25% 的 20 个策略里，也只有 5 个收正。
跨市场看，结果取决于市场：持有上涨的市场里 275 条序列有 168 条为正，持有下跌的市场里是 275 条有 63 条。
2022 年的赢家多半是 2023 年的落后者：美股上的秩相关系数为 −0.58，10 个市场里只有 3 个为正。
单一年份的排名，只能当作对那一年的描述来读。

title.en: Why Martingale and Grid EAs Blow Up: What 1,515 Free MT5 Expert Advisors and Their Losing Streaks Show
title.zh: 马丁格尔和网格 EA 为什么会爆仓：1515 个免费 MT5 EA 和它们的连亏记录告诉你

summary.en: Martingale and grid EAs make up 5% of the free MT5 Expert Advisors we review, but more than half of the ones we rate "dangerous". The reason is arithmetic: losing streaks of six to eight trades are normal — and that is exactly where doubling the position runs out of money.
summary.zh: 在我们评估的免费 MT5 智能交易系统里，马丁格尔和网格 EA 只占 5%，却占了被评为“危险”的一半以上。原因是一道算术题：连亏 6 到 8 笔很正常，而这恰恰是加倍下注的资金耗尽的地方。

paragraphs.en: Our risk review covers all 1,515 EAs in the EA Arena. 88 of them are rated "dangerous". Most of those come from two small categories:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的风险评估覆盖了 EA 竞技场里全部 1515 个 EA，其中 88 个被评为“危险”。它们大多来自两个很小的类别：

en: Martingale: 34 of 40 EAs (85%) rated dangerous.
Trend following, momentum, breakout and mean reversion: 2–4% each.
zh: 马丁格尔：40 个里 34 个（85%）被评为危险。
趋势跟踪、动量、突破和均值回归：各自只有 2%–4%。

paragraphs.en: Martingale and grid EAs are 73 of 1,515 EAs (5%) but 48 of the 88 dangerous ones (55%).
paragraphs.zh: 马丁格尔和网格 EA 合计只占 1515 个里的 73 个（5%），却占了 88 个危险 EA 里的 48 个（55%）。

heading.en: How a martingale works — and fails
heading.zh: 马丁格尔怎么运作，又怎么失败

paragraphs.en: A martingale EA increases the position after every loss, usually doubling it, so that one win recovers everything lost before. Most of the time this works, which is why these EAs show high win rates and smooth equity curves. The problem is the losing streak. If the first trade risks 0.5% of the account and every loss doubles the next position:
paragraphs.zh: 马丁格尔 EA 每亏一次就加大仓位，通常是翻倍，指望赢一次就把之前亏的全部赚回来。大多数时候这确实管用，所以这类 EA 胜率很高、权益曲线很平滑。问题出在连续亏损上。假设第一笔交易承担账户 0.5% 的风险，每亏一次下一笔仓位翻倍：

en: after 4 losses in a row the account is down 7.5%;
after 6 losses, 31.5%;
after 7 losses, 63.5%;
the eighth trade alone would then risk 64% of the starting balance, with only 36.5% left. One more loss and the account is gone.
zh: 连亏 4 笔，账户亏 7.5%；
这时第八笔单子本身就要承担初始资金 64% 的风险，而账户只剩 36.5%。再亏一次，账户就没了。

heading.en: How common are long losing streaks?

paragraphs.en: We looked at the longest losing streak in 1,095 reliable EA backtests that made at least 20 trades over one year of hourly data (May 2025 to May 2026). The median longest streak was 6 losses. More than a fifth of them (22.5%) had 8 or more losses in a row, and 5.2% had 10 or more. These are ordinary EAs, not martingales — they simply show how often a run of losses happens. For a doubling martingale, a streak that is unremarkable for a normal EA is fatal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们统计了 1095 个可信的 EA 回测（2025 年 5 月至 2026 年 5 月一年的小时线数据、至少 20 笔交易）里的最长连亏。中位数是 6 笔；超过五分之一（22.5%）的回测出现过连亏 8 笔或更多，5.2% 出现过 10 笔或更多。这些都是普通 EA，不是马丁格尔——它们只是说明连续亏损有多常见。对普通 EA 来说平平无奇的一段连亏，对翻倍加仓的马丁格尔就是致命的。

heading.en: Grids: the same problem in a trend
heading.zh: 网格：遇到趋势是同一个问题

paragraphs.en: A grid EA places orders at fixed price steps and adds positions as price moves against it, expecting it to come back. In a range that works. In a trend the positions pile up: over our test year gold rose from about $3,280 to $4,730, so a grid adding one short position every $20 would have opened more than 70 of them, all losing at once. Grids without a maximum number of positions or a stop for the whole basket are the ones our review marks as dangerous.
paragraphs.zh: 网格 EA 按固定价格间隔挂单，价格逆向移动时不断加仓，等着价格回来。在震荡行情里这行得通；遇到趋势，仓位就会越堆越多。我们测试的这一年里，黄金从大约 3280 美元涨到 4730 美元，一个每涨 20 美元加一张空单的网格，会开出 70 多张空单，而且全部同时亏损。没有最大仓位数、也没有整体止损的网格，就是我们评估里标为危险的那一类。

heading.en: Why our backtests understate the risk
heading.zh: 为什么我们的回测低估了风险

paragraphs.en: Our automatic conversion trades a fixed lot size, so it does not reproduce lot doubling or unlimited grid levels. That is why martingale EAs in our backtests show ordinary results (median win rate 49%) instead of the typical "95% wins, then a wipe-out". Treat their backtest numbers as a lower bound on risk and read the risk review on each EA page.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的自动转换按固定手数交易，没有还原加倍下注和无限加网格的逻辑。所以马丁格尔 EA 在我们的回测里表现得很普通（胜率中位数 49%），而不是典型的“95% 都赢，然后一次爆仓”。请把它们的回测数字当作风险的下限，并且一定要看每个 EA 页面上的风险评估。

en: Check the maximum lot multiplier and the maximum number of grid levels. If there is no cap, the worst case is the whole account.
Work out how many losses in a row your account can absorb at the EA's settings, and compare it with the losing streaks above.
Look for a stop for the whole basket of positions, not just per trade.
Test in the MT5 Strategy Tester over several years, including fast trends — one quiet year will make almost any martingale look good.
zh: 查清楚最大加倍倍数和最多加几层网格。如果没有上限，最坏情况就是整个账户。
按 EA 的参数算一算，你的账户能扛住连亏几笔，再和上面的连亏数据比一比。
看有没有针对整组持仓的止损，而不只是单笔止损。
在 MT5 策略测试器里测好几年的数据，一定要包含快速单边行情——只测一年平静的行情，几乎任何马丁都会看起来不错。

title.en: Do Moving-Average Strategies Beat Buy-and-Hold on Bitcoin?
title.zh: 均线策略在比特币上能跑赢买入持有吗？

summary.en: Over the last five years six moving-average systems all had a shallower maximum drawdown than holding bitcoin (−36.7% to −51.2% against −75.9%), and four beat its 2.6% annual return. Over the full history since September 2014 only one of six beat holding on return (MACD, 59.0% against 52.0%).
summary.zh: 近五年，六个均线系统的最大回撤都比持有比特币浅（−36.7% 到 −51.2%，持有为 −75.9%），其中四个的年化收益高于持有的 2.6%。但看 2014 年 9 月以来的完整历史，六个里只有一个在收益上赢过持有（MACD，59.0% 对 52.0%）。

heading.en: Six rules built on moving averages
heading.zh: 六条以均线为基础的规则

paragraphs.en: The moving-average family on the site is larger than its name suggests. Six long-only systems are pure moving-average rules, all tested on daily bitcoin and ether data, before trading costs:
paragraphs.zh: 站内的均线策略家族比名字看上去要大。其中六个纯均线规则都是只做多，在比特币和以太坊的日线数据上回测，均未扣交易成本：

en: **Dual Moving Average (TREND-05):** long while the 50-day simple average is above the 200-day.
**Triple Moving Average (TREND-13):** long when the 50, 100 and 200-day averages are stacked in order, flat when they stack the other way, and it holds its previous position when they are mixed.
**Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average (TREND-11):** long when price is above an adaptive average that speeds up in clean trends and slows in chop, and the average is rising.
**HMA Crossover (HMA-01):** long while a 9-day Hull average is above a 21-day Hull average.
**MACD Strategy (TREND-12):** long while the 12/26-day exponential-average difference is above its own 9-day average.

**Trend + Macro Filter (EVENT-01):** the 50/200 rule of TREND-05, but forced flat on the first three trading days of every month. The code has no economic calendar; that is what "macro filter" means here.
zh: **Dual Moving Average（TREND-05）**：50 日简单均线在 200 日均线之上时持有。
**Triple Moving Average（TREND-13）**：50、100、200 日均线依次多头排列时做多，反向排列时空仓，排列混乱时保持原仓位。
**Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average（TREND-11）**：价格在自适应均线之上且该均线上行时做多；这条均线在趋势干净时加快、在震荡时放慢。
**HMA Crossover（HMA-01）**：9 日 Hull 均线在 21 日 Hull 均线之上时持有。
**MACD Strategy（TREND-12）**：12/26 日指数均线之差高于其自身 9 日均线时持有。
**Trend + Macro Filter（EVENT-01）**：规则与 TREND-05 的 50/200 相同，但每个月前三个交易日强制空仓。代码里并没有经济日历，这里所谓“宏观过滤”指的就是这个。

paragraphs.en: Three more use a moving average inside a larger rule: MACD + RSI Filter (COMBO-02), Regime Switch (REG-01, price above its 200-day average and 60-day volatility under 25%) and Trend + Mean Reversion Hybrid (COMBO-04, buys RSI dips above the 200-day average). Walk-forward selection retunes the settings of five of the six pure rules (3 to 6 distinct settings across the bitcoin folds); TREND-05 and REG-01 have no tunable parameters and always run as described. Bitcoin data starts on 2014-09-17 and the first walk-forward test period on 2017-09-17; ether starts on 2017-11-09, first test period 2020-11-09.
paragraphs.zh: 另有三个策略把均线嵌在更大的规则里：MACD + RSI Filter（COMBO-02）、Regime Switch（REG-01，价格在 200 日均线之上且 60 日波动率低于 25%）和 Trend + Mean Reversion Hybrid（COMBO-04，在 200 日均线之上买入 RSI 回落）。滚动前推优化会重新选择六个纯规则中五个的参数（比特币各个折里出现 3 到 6 种不同设置）；TREND-05 和 REG-01 没有可调参数，始终按上述规则运行。比特币数据从 2014-09-17 开始，第一个前推测试期从 2017-09-17 开始；以太坊数据从 2017-11-09 开始，第一个测试期从 2020-11-09 开始。

heading.en: The last five years: a bear market at the start
heading.zh: 近五年：一开始就是熊市

paragraphs.en: The five-year window starts on 2021-11-11, three days after bitcoin's November 2021 high. Buy-and-hold made 2.6% a year with a Sharpe ratio of 0.25 and a maximum drawdown of −75.9%.
paragraphs.zh: 五年窗口从 2021-11-11 开始，距离比特币 2021 年 11 月的高点只有三天。买入持有的年化收益为 2.6%，夏普比率 0.25，最大回撤 −75.9%。

paragraphs.en: Four of the six systems beat that return: MACD (10.6%), Trend + Macro Filter (9.8%), HMA Crossover (5.8%) and Dual Moving Average (3.2%). Triple MA (0.6%) and the Kaufman system (−0.6%) did not. All six had a shallower maximum drawdown, from −36.7% (Trend + Macro Filter) to −51.2% (HMA Crossover), while being in the market 40% to 53% of days. Only three of six had a better Sharpe ratio than holding.
paragraphs.zh: 六个系统中有四个跑赢了这个收益：MACD（10.6%）、Trend + Macro Filter（9.8%）、HMA Crossover（5.8%）和 Dual Moving Average（3.2%）。Triple MA（0.6%）和 Kaufman 系统（−0.6%）没有。六个系统的最大回撤都比持有浅，从 −36.7%（Trend + Macro Filter）到 −51.2%（HMA Crossover），持仓天数占 40% 到 53%。夏普比率高于持有的只有三个。

paragraphs.en: Two things stand out. The systems cut the drawdown by 24.7 to 39.2 percentage points, yet a drawdown of −36.7% to −51.2% is still a deep hole. And the filtered relatives did better still on risk: Trend + Mean Reversion Hybrid (COMBO-04) had a −26.8% drawdown and 4.7% a year, but was in the market only 11.5% of days.
paragraphs.zh: 有两点值得注意。系统把回撤缩小了 24.7 到 39.2 个百分点，但 −36.7% 到 −51.2% 的回撤依然是个很深的坑。而带过滤条件的近亲在风险上做得更好：Trend + Mean Reversion Hybrid（COMBO-04）最大回撤 −26.8%，年化 4.7%，但只有 11.5% 的日子在场内。

heading.en: The full history reverses the picture

paragraphs.en: Since 2014-09-17 (12.2 years) buy-and-hold bitcoin compounded at 52.0% a year with a −83.4% maximum drawdown and a Sharpe ratio of 0.80. Only MACD beat it on return, at 59.0%. The others ran from 44.5% (Trend + Macro Filter) to 49.5% (Dual Moving Average), with 43% to 58% of days in the market.
paragraphs.zh: 自 2014-09-17 起（12.2 年），买入持有比特币年化 52.0%，最大回撤 −83.4%，夏普比率 0.80。收益上只有 MACD 超过它，为 59.0%。其余几个在 44.5%（Trend + Macro Filter）到 49.5%（Dual Moving Average）之间，持仓天数占 43% 到 58%。

paragraphs.en: All six beat holding on Sharpe ratio (0.82 to 1.05) and all six had a shallower drawdown, but the shallowest was still −56.1% (Kaufman) and the deepest −73.7% (Trend + Macro Filter). The three filtered relatives gave up most of the return: 15.8% for MACD + RSI Filter, 4.9% for the Hybrid and 3.8% for Regime Switch, which was in the market 3.4% of days.
paragraphs.zh: 六个系统的夏普比率（0.82 到 1.05）都高于持有，最大回撤也都更浅，但最浅的仍有 −56.1%（Kaufman），最深的是 −73.7%（Trend + Macro Filter）。三个带过滤的近亲放弃了大部分收益：MACD + RSI Filter 为 15.8%，Hybrid 为 4.9%，Regime Switch 为 3.8%，后者只有 3.4% 的日子在场内。

paragraphs.en: The fast systems trade a great deal. Over the full history, the HMA Crossover changed position 652 times (53.7 a year), the Kaufman system 470 and MACD 314, against 21 for the dual and triple averages (1.7 a year). Each change costs money that these results leave out.
paragraphs.zh: 快速系统交易得很频繁。整个历史里，HMA Crossover 换仓 652 次（每年 53.7 次），Kaufman 系统 470 次，MACD 314 次，而双均线和三均线只有 21 次（每年 1.7 次）。每一次换仓都有成本，而这些结果并未计入。

paragraphs.en: Holding bitcoin rose in eight of the eleven full calendar years from 2015 to 2025 and fell in 2018, 2022 and 2025. Across the six systems and those eleven years:
paragraphs.zh: 2015 到 2025 这十一个完整日历年里，持有比特币有八年上涨，2018、2022 和 2025 年下跌。把六个系统和这十一年放在一起看：

en: In the eight up years a system beat holding in 8 of 48 system-years. In 2017 holding gained 1,368.9% and the median system 1,142.5%; in 2020 it was 303.2% against 121.0% and none of the six beat holding; in 2023, 155.4% against 45.8%.

In the three down years a system beat holding in 14 of 18 system-years, but none of the 18 made money. In 2018 holding lost 73.6% and the median system 30.0%; in 2022 holding lost 64.3% and the median system 28.9%; in 2025 holding lost 6.3% and the median system 8.6%, with only two of six doing better than holding.
zh: 在八个上涨年里，系统跑赢持有的次数是 48 个“系统年”中的 8 个。2017 年持有涨 1,368.9%，系统中位数为 1,142.5%；2020 年是 303.2% 对 121.0%，六个系统无一跑赢持有；2023 年是 155.4% 对 45.8%。
在三个下跌年里，系统跑赢持有的次数是 18 个“系统年”中的 14 个，但 18 个全部没有赚钱。2018 年持有亏 73.6%，系统中位数亏 30.0%；2022 年持有亏 64.3%，系统中位数亏 28.9%；2025 年持有亏 6.3%，系统中位数亏 8.6%，六个里只有两个好于持有。

paragraphs.en: In 2026 through 2026-11-11, holding is down 15.5% and the median system down 9.0%, with five of six ahead of holding. The trade is the same every time: less in the up years, less lost in the down years. Whether it pays depends on how many of each the sample contains.
paragraphs.zh: 2026 年截至 2026-11-11，持有下跌 15.5%，系统中位数下跌 9.0%，六个里有五个领先于持有。交易的内容每次都一样：上涨年少赚，下跌年少亏。值不值得，取决于样本里这两种年份各有多少。

paragraphs.en: Measured peak to trough (2021-11-08 to 2022-11-21, 378 days), bitcoin fell 76.6%. None of the nine systems made money in that window. Losses ran from −27.2% (Trend + Macro Filter) to −52.3% (HMA Crossover), median −46.3% for the six pure rules, with 18% to 53% of days in the market.
paragraphs.zh: 从高点到低谷（2021-11-08 至 2022-11-21，378 天），比特币下跌 76.6%。九个系统在这个区间里没有一个赚钱。亏损从 −27.2%（Trend + Macro Filter）到 −52.3%（HMA Crossover），六个纯规则的中位数为 −46.3%，持仓天数占 18% 到 53%。

paragraphs.en: The calendar year looks much kinder: holding lost 64.3% in 2022 and the six systems lost between 6.9% (Dual Moving Average) and 42.8% (Kaufman). The gap is timing. From the peak to the end of 2021 bitcoin fell 31.5%, and the dual and triple averages fell the same 31.5%, so they had not stepped aside yet. They then lost only 6.9% and 18.1% from 2022-01-01 to the trough. The faster systems, MACD and HMA, lost 15.8% and 22.2% before year end and a further 39.1% and 38.7% afterwards, and were in the market 52% and 53% of days in the bear window.
paragraphs.zh: 按日历年看就温和得多：2022 年持有亏 64.3%，六个系统亏损在 6.9%（Dual Moving Average）到 42.8%（Kaufman）之间。差别在于时点。从高点到 2021 年底，比特币下跌 31.5%，双均线和三均线也同样下跌 31.5%，说明它们当时还没有离场。此后从 2022-01-01 到低谷，它们只分别亏了 6.9% 和 18.1%。较快的 MACD 和 HMA 在年底前分别亏了 15.8% 和 22.2%，之后又分别亏了 39.1% 和 38.7%，在这段熊市里的持仓天数占 52% 和 53%。

heading.en: Ether: the same pattern, a harsher sample
heading.zh: 以太坊：同样的规律，更苛刻的样本

paragraphs.en: Ether data covers 9.0 years from 2017-11-09. Holding made 22.9% a year over the full period with a −94.0% maximum drawdown, and −15.4% a year over five years (−79.0% drawdown). Four of six systems beat holding over the full period (HMA Crossover 43.7%, Kaufman 32.2%, MACD 31.7%, Triple MA 23.1%) and all six had a shallower drawdown, from −59.7% to −78.9%.
paragraphs.zh: 以太坊数据从 2017-11-09 起共 9.0 年。持有的完整期年化为 22.9%，最大回撤 −94.0%；近五年年化 −15.4%（最大回撤 −79.0%）。完整期里六个系统中有四个跑赢持有（HMA Crossover 43.7%、Kaufman 32.2%、MACD 31.7%、Triple MA 23.1%），六个的回撤都更浅，在 −59.7% 到 −78.9% 之间。

paragraphs.en: Over five years five of six beat holding, but only two had a positive return: MACD at 3.9% and HMA Crossover at 1.6%. In the 2022 bear (2021-11-08 to 2022-06-18, −79.4%) the six lost between 22.5% (Kaufman) and 47.6% (HMA Crossover). Across the four down years from 2018 to 2025, systems beat holding in 18 of 24 system-years, yet made money in only 8; MACD gained 14.0% in calendar 2022.
paragraphs.zh: 近五年六个里有五个跑赢持有，但只有两个收益为正：MACD 的 3.9% 和 HMA Crossover 的 1.6%。在 2022 年的熊市里（2021-11-08 至 2022-06-18，−79.4%），六个系统亏损在 22.5%（Kaufman）到 47.6%（HMA Crossover）之间。2018 到 2025 年的四个下跌年里，系统在 24 个“系统年”中有 18 个好于持有，但只有 8 个赚钱；MACD 在 2022 日历年里赚了 14.0%。

heading.en: What the numbers cannot tell you
heading.zh: 这些数字说明不了什么

paragraphs.en: Bitcoin has only 12.2 years of data, so every conclusion rests on a handful of episodes: the 2017 and 2020 rallies and the 2018 and 2022 crashes. The 2014 and 2026 figures are partial years, and the ether systems were in the market on average only 13% of days in 2017 (from 9 November) and 22% in 2018. Results are before trading costs and the faster systems trade often. Daily returns of these systems correlate 0.61 to 0.81 with holding, so they behave more like a partial holding than like an independent bet.
paragraphs.zh: 比特币只有 12.2 年的数据，所以每个结论都依赖少数几段行情：2017 年和 2020 年的上涨，以及 2018 年和 2022 年的暴跌。2014 年和 2026 年是不完整的年份，以太坊系统在 2017 年（从 11 月 9 日起）平均只有 13% 的日子在场内，2018 年为 22%。结果均未扣交易成本，而快速系统交易频繁。这些系统的日收益与持有的相关系数为 0.61 到 0.81，所以它们更像是一份部分持仓，而不是一个独立的押注。

en: Over five years the six systems cut maximum drawdown by 24.7 to 39.2 percentage points against holding and four beat its return; over the full history only MACD beat the return.
The systems lag in the up years and lose less in the down years; whether they win over a window depends on how many bull years it holds.
The slow 50/200 averages matched holding through the first leg of the 2022 fall and only protected the rest; MACD and HMA were in the market about half the days of the bear window and lost more.
Filtered variants (Hybrid, Regime Switch) traded return for very small exposure and should be read as different products.
Ether follows the same pattern with deeper holes.
zh: 近五年，六个系统相对持有把最大回撤缩小了 24.7 到 39.2 个百分点，四个跑赢了持有的收益；完整历史里只有 MACD 在收益上胜出。
系统在上涨年落后，在下跌年少亏；在某个窗口里能否胜出，取决于这段时间里有多少个牛市年。
50/200 的慢均线在 2022 年下跌的第一段与持有同步，只保护了其后的部分；MACD 和 HMA 在熊市区间里约有一半的日子在场内，亏得更多。
带过滤的变体（Hybrid、Regime Switch）以极低的持仓换来了较低的收益，应当当作另一类产品来看。
以太坊呈现同样的规律，只是坑更深。

title.en: Does Turtle Trading Still Work? Ten Markets, 2021–2026
title.zh: 海龟交易法还管用吗？10 个市场、2021–2026

summary.en: Over the five years to November 2026 the 20/10 Turtle breakout (TURTLE-01) made 6.0% a year on US stocks against 11.9% for holding, with a smaller drawdown (-13.3% against -24.5%). It beat holding on return on four of ten markets, and the slower Donchian Breakout (TREND-02) had the higher return and Sharpe ratio on eight.
summary.zh: 在截至 2026 年 11 月的五年里，20/10 海龟突破（TURTLE-01）在美股上年化 6.0%，持有为 11.9%，但回撤更小（-13.3%，持有为 -24.5%）。它在 10 个市场中的 4 个跑赢了持有的收益，而较慢的唐奇安突破（TREND-02）在其中 8 个市场上收益和夏普都更高。

paragraphs.en: Turtle Trading (TURTLE-01) works on daily closing prices. It goes long when the close is above the highest close of the previous 20 days, and goes flat when the close is below the lowest close of the previous 10 days. Otherwise it keeps its position. It is long only, always fully invested when long, and does not add to winners. The strategy page mentions position sizing by risk; the code does not do it. The original Turtle system of the 1980s also sold short and added to positions, and this version does neither.
paragraphs.zh: 海龟交易法（TURTLE-01）使用日收盘价。收盘价高于前 20 天最高收盘价时做多，低于前 10 天最低收盘价时转为空仓，其余时间保持原有仓位。它只做多，持仓时满仓，不加仓。策略页面提到按风险定仓位，代码里没有。上世纪 80 年代的原版海龟系统还会做空和加仓，这个版本两者都没有。

paragraphs.en: In the walk-forward test the entry window was chosen from 16, 20 and 24 days and the exit window from 8, 10 and 12, re-selected every six months. Donchian Breakout (TREND-02) is the slower relative: long above the previous 55-day high, flat below the previous 20-day low. It has no parameters to tune, and the ATR sizing, trade limit and trailing stop on its page are not in the code. All results are before trading costs, and the site counts each entry and each exit as a trade.
paragraphs.zh: 在滚动前推测试中，入场窗口从 16、20、24 天中选择，离场窗口从 8、10、12 天中选择，每六个月重新选择一次。唐奇安突破（TREND-02）是较慢的对照：高于前 55 天最高价做多，低于前 20 天最低价转为空仓。它没有可调参数，页面上提到的 ATR 仓位、交易数量限制和移动止损在代码里都没有。所有结果均未扣交易成本，网站把每一次入场和每一次离场都算作一笔交易。

heading.en: Five years against the full history

paragraphs.en: Over the five years to 11 November 2026 TURTLE-01 had a positive annual return on 7 of 10 markets (not on silver, natural gas or ether) and a positive Sharpe ratio on 9. Against holding it earned a higher return on 4 markets (natural gas, EUR/USD, bitcoin and ether), a higher Sharpe ratio on 2 (EUR/USD and bitcoin) and a smaller maximum drawdown on 8 (not oil or broad commodities). On US stocks it made 6.0% a year with a Sharpe of 0.63 and a -13.3% drawdown; holding made 11.9%, 0.74 and -24.5%.
paragraphs.zh: 在截至 2026 年 11 月 11 日的五年里，TURTLE-01 在 10 个市场中的 7 个年化收益为正（白银、天然气和以太坊为负），9 个市场夏普为正。与持有相比，它在 4 个市场上收益更高（天然气、欧元/美元、比特币和以太坊），在 2 个市场上夏普更高（欧元/美元和比特币），在 8 个市场上最大回撤更小（原油和综合大宗商品除外）。美股上它年化 6.0%，夏普 0.63，回撤 -13.3%；持有为 11.9%、0.74 和 -24.5%。

paragraphs.en: Compared with its own full history, the last five years were better on only three markets. Gold made 6.4% a year against 3.8%, agriculture 1.5% against 0.5% and EUR/USD 0.3% against -1.3%. On the others the recent record is weaker, and the gap is widest in crypto: bitcoin 8.0% a year (Sharpe 0.34) against 54.1% (1.05) since 2014, and ether -4.1% against 43.9% since 2017. Silver went from 4.5% to -1.0% and natural gas from -13.6% to -21.9%. Over the full history the rule beat holding on return on 6 markets and had a smaller drawdown on 9.
paragraphs.zh: 与自己的完整历史相比，最近五年只有三个市场更好。黄金年化 6.4%，完整历史是 3.8%；农产品 1.5% 对 0.5%；欧元/美元 0.3% 对 -1.3%。其他市场近期表现更弱，差距最大的是加密货币：比特币年化 8.0%（夏普 0.34），自 2014 年以来为 54.1%（1.05）；以太坊 -4.1%，自 2017 年以来为 43.9%。白银从 4.5% 变成 -1.0%，天然气从 -13.6% 变成 -21.9%。完整历史上，这个规则在 6 个市场收益高于持有，在 9 个市场回撤更小。

paragraphs.en: The calendar years show why the five-year number is modest. For each year, the median market return is given for Turtle, Donchian and holding.
paragraphs.zh: 逐年情况说明了五年数字为什么偏低。下面每一年给出的是各市场收益的中位数，依次是海龟、唐奇安和持有。

en: **2022:** -4.2%, +3.4% and +0.8%. Turtle beat holding on 5 of 10 markets; it made 32.4% on natural gas and lost 46.4% on bitcoin (holding lost 64.3%). US stocks: -5.6% against -18.2% for holding.
**2023:** +0.5%, +1.2% and +5.7%. It beat holding on 3 of 10. Bitcoin made 64.8% against 155.4% for holding; US stocks 17.7% against 26.2%.
**2024:** +3.5%, +10.4% and +22.9%. It beat holding on 2 of 10. US stocks made 6.3% against 24.9%.
**2025:** +7.3%, +4.5% and +3.8%. It beat holding on 2 of 10. Silver made 56.6% against 144.7%.
**2026 to 11 November:** +1.9%, +2.3% and -6.4%. It beat holding on 6 of 10; oil was its best market at 45.5% (holding 104.6%).

paragraphs.en: In the 12 calendar years 2010 to 2021, Turtle beat holding in 57 of 109 market-years (the first years of bitcoin and ether are partial). In 2022 to 2026 it did so in 18 of 50. Rising markets, where holding earned its keep, were the hardest comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 2010 年到 2021 年的 12 个自然年里，海龟在 109 个市场年（比特币和以太坊的首年不完整）中的 57 个跑赢了持有；2022 到 2026 年是 50 个中的 18 个。持有收益丰厚的上涨市场，是最难比的。

paragraphs.en: We split each market's five-year record into round trips, from entry to exit. TURTLE-01 closed 340 of them and 36% made money. Winners averaged +8.8% and lasted a median 24 days; losers averaged -4.2% and lasted a median 8 days, and 208 of the 218 losers were over within 20 days. The win rate was lowest on natural gas (23%), bitcoin (29%), agriculture (30%) and silver (31%) and highest on gold and EUR/USD (48% each). This is the usual breakout trade: many small losses, few large gains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们把每个市场的五年记录拆成一次次从入场到离场的往返交易。TURTLE-01 完成了 340 次，其中 36% 盈利。盈利交易平均 +8.8%，持续中位数 24 天；亏损交易平均 -4.2%，持续中位数 8 天，218 笔亏损中有 208 笔在 20 天内结束。胜率最低的是天然气（23%）、比特币（29%）、农产品（30%）和白银（31%），最高的是黄金和欧元/美元（各 48%）。这是典型的突破交易：很多笔小亏，少数几笔大赚。

paragraphs.en: The worst single trades were short, sharp reversals: natural gas lost 21.1% in 10 days in March 2023, ether 15.6% in 10 days in December 2021 and silver 15.1% in 16 days in May to June 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 最糟的几笔都是又短又急的反转：天然气 2023 年 3 月 10 天亏了 21.1%，以太坊 2021 年 12 月 10 天亏了 15.6%，白银 2026 年 5 月到 6 月 16 天亏了 15.1%。

paragraphs.en: Oil shows what whipsaws cost. From 8 March 2022 to 1 October 2025 TURTLE-01 fell 51.9%, while oil itself fell 14.4% over the same dates; Donchian fell 24.7%. On natural gas, TURTLE-01 lost 85.0% between 6 June 2022 and 1 October 2026, the fund lost 92.0% and Donchian 65.4%. On silver, after the 2025 rally, TURTLE-01 fell 45.5% between 28 January and 18 August 2026, almost exactly the 45.6% fall in the metal.
paragraphs.zh: 原油说明了反复洗盘的代价。从 2022 年 3 月 8 日到 2025 年 10 月 1 日，TURTLE-01 下跌 51.9%，而同一时期原油本身只跌了 14.4%；唐奇安下跌 24.7%。天然气上，TURTLE-01 在 2022 年 6 月 6 日到 2026 年 10 月 1 日之间亏了 85.0%，基金亏了 92.0%，唐奇安亏了 65.4%。白银在 2025 年上涨之后，TURTLE-01 在 2026 年 1 月 28 日到 8 月 18 日下跌 45.5%，与白银本身 45.6% 的跌幅几乎一样。

paragraphs.en: Between 3 January and 12 October 2022 US stocks fell 24.5%. TURTLE-01 lost 9.7% on US stocks, and Donchian 8.7%. Turtle finished positive on only 3 of 10 markets: natural gas +51.2%, broad commodities +13.1% and oil +4.3%. Donchian was positive on 5: oil +37.3%, broad commodities +28.9%, natural gas +8.8%, agriculture +2.6% and gold +1.9%. Both lost on bitcoin, Turtle 37.9% and Donchian 26.4% against 58.8% for holding. The slower rule caught more of the oil and broad-commodity trends; the faster one caught more of natural gas.
paragraphs.zh: 2022 年 1 月 3 日到 10 月 12 日，美股下跌 24.5%。TURTLE-01 在美股上亏了 9.7%，唐奇安亏了 8.7%。海龟只在 10 个市场中的 3 个为正：天然气 +51.2%、综合大宗商品 +13.1% 和原油 +4.3%。唐奇安在 5 个市场为正：原油 +37.3%，综合大宗商品 +28.9%，天然气 +8.8%，农产品 +2.6%，黄金 +1.9%。两者在比特币上都亏了，海龟 37.9%，唐奇安 26.4%，持有是 58.8%。较慢的规则抓住了更多原油和综合大宗商品的趋势；较快的规则抓住了更多天然气的行情。

paragraphs.en: Donchian traded far less: 258 trades over five years across the ten markets against 675 for Turtle, and was invested on 36% of days on average against 41%. It beat holding's Sharpe ratio on 6 markets (silver, natural gas, broad commodities, EUR/USD, bitcoin and ether), against 2 for Turtle, and had a smaller drawdown than holding on 9 of 10. Turtle beat Donchian on return and Sharpe on only two markets, US stocks and EUR/USD. Donchian's round trips were fewer but bigger: 132 closed, a 41% win rate, winners +16.1% over a median 58 days and losers -5.7% over 17.
paragraphs.zh: 唐奇安的交易少得多：十个市场五年共 258 笔，海龟是 675 笔；平均持仓日占比为 36%，海龟是 41%。它在 6 个市场上夏普高于持有（白银、天然气、综合大宗商品、欧元/美元、比特币和以太坊），海龟只有 2 个；在 10 个市场中的 9 个回撤小于持有。海龟只在美股和欧元/美元两个市场上收益和夏普都超过唐奇安。唐奇安的往返交易更少但更大：共 132 次，胜率 41%，盈利交易 +16.1%、中位数持续 58 天，亏损交易 -5.7%、持续 17 天。

paragraphs.en: Over the full history the order changes in crypto. Turtle made 54.1% a year on bitcoin (Sharpe 1.05, drawdown -63.4%) against 48.2% (0.98, -56.9%) for Donchian, and 43.9% on ether against 32.7%. Turtle also led on US stocks, 6.7% against 4.4%.
paragraphs.zh: 放到完整历史上，加密货币里的排序反过来了。海龟在比特币上年化 54.1%（夏普 1.05，回撤 -63.4%），唐奇安是 48.2%（0.98，-56.9%）；以太坊上海龟 43.9%，唐奇安 32.7%。海龟在美股上也领先，6.7% 对 4.4%。

heading.en: What the numbers cannot tell you
heading.zh: 这些数字说明不了什么

paragraphs.en: Most of these samples are small: on US stocks, TURTLE-01 closed 29 round trips in five years. The probabilistic Sharpe ratio on US stocks was 0.92 for Turtle and 0.85 for Donchian; the deflated Sharpe ratio, which allows for the number of strategies compared, was 0.48 and 0.34. Neither is close to a conventional 0.95. Costs matter more for the faster rule: at the site's assumption of 10 basis points per unit of turnover, the average drag over the ten markets was 1.2% a year for Turtle and 0.5% for Donchian. Both are long-only on closing prices with no position sizing, so the results say little about the original multi-market system.
paragraphs.zh: 多数样本很小：在美股上，TURTLE-01 五年只完成了 29 次往返交易。美股上海龟的概率夏普比率是 0.92，唐奇安是 0.85；考虑了比较策略数量的折算夏普比率分别是 0.48 和 0.34，都离常用的 0.95 很远。成本对更快的规则影响更大：按网站每单位换手 10 个基点的假设，十个市场平均每年的成本拖累，海龟是 1.2%，唐奇安是 0.5%。两者都只做多、使用收盘价、没有仓位管理，所以这些结果并不能说明原版多市场系统的表现。

en: On a single market, breakouts rarely beat holding on return: Turtle did on 4 of 10 markets over five years, and Donchian on 4.
The benefit is drawdown: Turtle's was smaller on 8 of 10 markets and Donchian's on 9.
The faster 20/10 rule made 340 round trips in five years and won 36% of them; the 55/20 rule made 132 and won 41%, with bigger winners.
The last five years were weaker than the full history for Turtle on seven of ten markets, with the widest gap in crypto.
zh: 在单一市场上，突破系统很少在收益上跑赢持有：近五年海龟在 10 个市场中的 4 个做到了，唐奇安也是 4 个。
它的价值在回撤：海龟在 8 个市场上回撤更小，唐奇安在 9 个。
较快的 20/10 规则五年里完成了 340 次往返交易，赢了其中 36%；55/20 规则完成了 132 次，赢了 41%，盈利交易更大。
海龟最近五年在十个市场中的七个都弱于完整历史，差距最大的是加密货币。

title.en: Does an RSI Filter Improve MACD? A Ten-Market Backtest
title.zh: RSI 过滤能改进 MACD 吗？10 个市场回测

summary.en: Adding an RSI filter to a MACD crossover (COMBO-02 against TREND-12) cut trades on all ten markets and the five-year maximum drawdown on nine, but raised the Sharpe ratio on only six. The filter kept the strategy invested on 33% of days instead of 50%, and it cost the most return on bitcoin.
summary.zh: 给 MACD 交叉加上 RSI 过滤（COMBO-02 对比 TREND-12）后，10 个市场的交易次数都减少了，近五年最大回撤在 9 个市场上变小，但夏普只在 6 个市场上提高。过滤让策略的持仓日从 50% 降到 33%，在比特币上让出的收益最多。

heading.en: Two rules, read from the code
heading.zh: 从代码读出的两套规则

paragraphs.en: MACD Strategy (TREND-12) is long whenever the MACD line (by default the 12-day exponential average minus the 26-day one) is above its 9-day signal line, and flat otherwise. It checks that state every day and always holds 100% or nothing.
paragraphs.zh: MACD 策略（TREND-12）在 MACD 线（默认为 12 日指数均线减 26 日指数均线）高于 9 日信号线时持有多头，否则空仓。它每天检查这个状态，仓位只有 100% 或零。

paragraphs.en: MACD + RSI Filter (COMBO-02) uses the same lines but adds three RSI rules. It enters when MACD crosses above the signal line and RSI is below 70, or when MACD is already above the signal line and RSI is below 30. It exits on a cross down, when RSI rises above 80, or when MACD is below the signal line and RSI is above 70. After an RSI exit while MACD is still bullish, the way back in is the next cross up (or RSI falling below 30 while MACD is bullish). This RSI uses exponential smoothing with a span of 14 days, which is not the Wilder smoothing many charting tools use.
paragraphs.zh: MACD + RSI 过滤（COMBO-02）用同样的两条线，再加三条 RSI 规则。入场条件有两种：MACD 上穿信号线且 RSI 低于 70；或者 MACD 已在信号线之上而 RSI 低于 30。离场条件有三种：MACD 下穿、RSI 升到 80 以上，或者 MACD 在信号线之下而 RSI 高于 70。因 RSI 离场而 MACD 仍然看多时，重新入场要等下一次上穿（或者 MACD 看多时 RSI 跌到 30 以下）。这里的 RSI 用的是跨度为 14 天的指数平滑，不是许多看盘软件用的 Wilder 平滑。

paragraphs.en: The strategy page also says sell signals are ignored when RSI is oversold. The code has no such rule: a cross down always exits. In the walk-forward test TREND-12 chose its fast and slow lengths from 10, 12 and 14 and 21, 26 and 31 days; COMBO-02 chose the fast length (10, 12 or 14) and the RSI length (11, 14 or 17), with the 70, 30 and 80 thresholds fixed. Results are before trading costs, and a position decided at the close of day t earns the return of day t+1.
paragraphs.zh: 策略页面还说，RSI 超卖时会忽略卖出信号。代码里没有这条规则：MACD 下穿一定会离场。在滚动前推测试中，TREND-12 从 10、12、14 天中选快线，从 21、26、31 天中选慢线；COMBO-02 选快线长度（10、12 或 14）和 RSI 长度（11、14 或 17），70、30、80 三个阈值固定不变。所有结果均未扣交易成本，收盘时决定的仓位获得下一个交易日的收益。

paragraphs.en: Over the five years to 11 November 2026, TREND-12 was invested on 50% of days on average across the ten markets and COMBO-02 on 33%. TREND-12 made 1,179 trades in total and COMBO-02 971, 18% fewer (the site counts each entry and each exit as a trade); on every market the filter traded less, by between 10% and 29%.
paragraphs.zh: 在截至 2026 年 11 月 11 日的五年里，十个市场平均，TREND-12 有 50% 的交易日持仓，COMBO-02 为 33%。TREND-12 总共交易 1,179 次，COMBO-02 为 971 次，少了 18%（网站把每次入场和每次离场各算一笔）；每个市场上过滤都让交易减少，幅度在 10% 到 29% 之间。

paragraphs.en: The days it removed are the ones where MACD was long and the filter was flat, and their value depends on the market. On US stocks that was 15% of days, and the asset fell 5.8% on them. On natural gas it was 12% of days, with a 67.2% fall. On silver it was 26% of days, with a 37.7% gain; on bitcoin 18% of days and a 66.0% gain; on ether 16% of days and a 39.9% gain. On the strongest trends, the filter sat out days that carried much of the gain.
paragraphs.zh: 被过滤掉的是 MACD 持多而过滤版空仓的那些日子，它们的价值因市场而异。美股上这类日子占 15%，期间资产下跌 5.8%。天然气占 12%，期间下跌 67.2%。白银占 26%，期间上涨 37.7%；比特币占 18%，上涨 66.0%；以太坊占 16%，上涨 39.9%。在趋势最强的市场上，过滤版错过了贡献大部分涨幅的那些日子。

paragraphs.en: Over the five years the filter had the higher Sharpe ratio on six markets and the smaller maximum drawdown on nine.
paragraphs.zh: 五年里，过滤版在 6 个市场上夏普更高，在 9 个市场上最大回撤更小。

en: **Sharpe improved:** US stocks (0.32 to 0.51), gold (0.40 to 0.49), natural gas (-0.49 to -0.13), broad commodities (0.44 to 0.62), agriculture (0.24 to 0.59) and EUR/USD (-0.18 to 0.06).
**Sharpe fell:** silver (0.55 to 0.37), oil (-0.12 to -0.23), bitcoin (0.39 to 0.11) and ether (0.26 to 0.13).
**Drawdown:** silver -46.7% to -28.1%, broad commodities -30.7% to -17.0%, gold -23.6% to -13.1%, US stocks -17.1% to -12.3%. The exception was EUR/USD, -10.1% to -11.3%.

**Annual return:** higher with the filter on six markets. The largest losses were bitcoin (10.6% to 0.1% a year), silver (11.3% to 4.4%) and ether (3.9% to -2.0%); the largest gain was natural gas (-29.0% to -11.4%).
zh: **年化收益：**过滤版在 6 个市场更高。损失最大的是比特币（年化 10.6% 降到 0.1%）、白银（11.3% 到 4.4%）和以太坊（3.9% 到 -2.0%）；提高最多的是天然气（-29.0% 到 -11.4%）。

paragraphs.en: Neither version was a good substitute for holding. TREND-12 beat holding's Sharpe on 2 of 10 markets and COMBO-02 on 3. On US stocks they made 2.8% and 4.4% a year against 11.9% for holding (Sharpe 0.74).
paragraphs.zh: 两个版本都不能替代持有。TREND-12 在 10 个市场中有 2 个夏普高于持有，COMBO-02 有 3 个。美股上两者年化分别是 2.8% 和 4.4%，持有为 11.9%（夏普 0.74）。

paragraphs.en: Over the full history (since January 2010 for US stocks, September 2014 for bitcoin and November 2017 for ether) the picture is similar but not identical. The filter again raised the Sharpe ratio on six markets (US stocks, oil, natural gas, broad commodities, agriculture and EUR/USD) and lowered it on gold, silver, bitcoin and ether. It reduced the maximum drawdown on eight, not on oil or agriculture. Total trades fell from 3,448 to 2,804.
paragraphs.zh: 看完整历史（美股自 2010 年 1 月，比特币自 2014 年 9 月，以太坊自 2017 年 11 月），结论相近但不完全相同。过滤版同样在 6 个市场提高了夏普（美股、原油、天然气、综合大宗商品、农产品和欧元/美元），在黄金、白银、比特币和以太坊上降低了夏普。它在 8 个市场上降低了最大回撤，原油和农产品除外。总交易次数从 3,448 次降到 2,804 次。

paragraphs.en: Bitcoin shows the price of the filter. Over the full history TREND-12 made 59.0% a year with a Sharpe of 1.05 and a -57.9% drawdown, against 52.0%, 0.80 and -83.4% for holding. COMBO-02 made 15.8% with a Sharpe of 0.52 and a -45.9% drawdown. On US stocks the filter was better: 6.2% a year, Sharpe 0.72 and a -14.9% drawdown, against 5.8%, 0.63 and -17.1% for MACD alone.
paragraphs.zh: 比特币最能说明过滤的代价。完整历史上 TREND-12 年化 59.0%，夏普 1.05，回撤 -57.9%；持有为 52.0%、0.80 和 -83.4%。COMBO-02 年化 15.8%，夏普 0.52，回撤 -45.9%。美股上过滤版更好：年化 6.2%，夏普 0.72，回撤 -14.9%，单用 MACD 为 5.8%、0.63 和 -17.1%。

heading.en: The years it helped and hurt
heading.zh: 过滤有帮助和有伤害的年份

paragraphs.en: We compared each strategy's calendar-year return on each market for the 16 full years from 2010 to 2025 (147 market-years). The filter did better in 71 of them and worse in 76; the median difference was -0.4 percentage points. It was ahead on a majority of markets in only 6 of the 16 years.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了 2010 年到 2025 年共 16 个完整年份、每个市场各策略的自然年收益（共 147 个市场年）。过滤版有 71 个更好，76 个更差，差值的中位数是 -0.4 个百分点。16 个年份里，只有 6 年它在多数市场上领先。

paragraphs.en: The year it helped most was 2022. The filter beat plain MACD on 8 of 10 markets, with a median gain of 4.0 points: the median market lost 8.3% under MACD and gained 1.6% with the filter. US stocks went from -7.7% to +1.1%, gold from -6.4% to +2.2%, silver from -9.0% to +5.5% and natural gas from -17.6% to +5.8%. The next-best years were 2015 (better on 7 of 9 markets) and 2010.
paragraphs.zh: 帮助最大的一年是 2022 年。过滤版在 10 个市场中的 8 个胜过普通 MACD，中位数领先 4.0 个百分点：中位数市场在 MACD 下亏损 8.3%，在过滤版下赚 1.6%。美股从 -7.7% 变为 +1.1%，黄金从 -6.4% 到 +2.2%，白银从 -9.0% 到 +5.5%，天然气从 -17.6% 到 +5.8%。其次是 2015 年（9 个市场中 7 个更好）和 2010 年。

paragraphs.en: The years it hurt most were 2021 (better on only 4 of 10 markets; median -5.4 points) and 2020 (3 of 10; median -3.8). The largest single losses were in crypto: bitcoin returned 916.0% in 2017 under MACD and 78.1% with the filter, and in 2020 192.8% against 86.2%. The years 2010 to 2012 come before the first walk-forward fold for the ETFs and use default parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 伤害最大的年份是 2021 年（10 个市场中只有 4 个更好，中位数 -5.4 个百分点）和 2020 年（3 个，中位数 -3.8）。单项最大的损失在加密货币：比特币 2017 年在 MACD 下上涨 916.0%，加了过滤是 78.1%；2020 年分别是 192.8% 和 86.2%。2010 到 2012 年处在 ETF 第一次滚动前推之前，使用的是默认参数。

heading.en: A drawdown, and what the numbers cannot tell you
heading.zh: 一次回撤，以及数字说明不了什么

paragraphs.en: MACD's worst five-year drawdown on silver was -46.7%, from 28 January to 16 July 2026. Over the same dates the filter lost 23.6%, and silver itself fell 52.3%. In that stretch the filter worked as intended. It cost silver 6.9 points of annual return over the five years.
paragraphs.zh: MACD 在白银上近五年最糟的回撤是 -46.7%，从 2026 年 1 月 28 日到 7 月 16 日。同一时期过滤版亏损 23.6%，白银本身下跌 52.3%。在这一段里，过滤发挥了应有的作用。但五年里它让白银的年化收益少了 6.9 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: The evidence is thin. On US stocks the probabilistic Sharpe ratio was 0.76 for TREND-12 and 0.87 for COMBO-02; the deflated Sharpe ratio, which allows for the number of strategies compared, was 0.22 and 0.37. A difference of 0.1 to 0.2 in the Sharpe ratio over five years should not be read as skill. Both systems were also re-fitted every six months, so the comparison is between two adaptive procedures, not two fixed rules. At the site's cost assumption of 10 basis points per unit of turnover, the average drag over the ten markets was 2.2% a year for TREND-12 and 1.8% for COMBO-02, so costs would widen the gap a little in the filter's favour.
paragraphs.zh: 证据不算充分。美股上 TREND-12 的概率夏普比率是 0.76，COMBO-02 是 0.87；考虑了比较策略数量的折算夏普比率分别是 0.22 和 0.37。五年里 0.1 到 0.2 的夏普差异不应被解读为能力。两套系统每六个月还会重新拟合参数，所以比较的是两种自适应流程，而不是两条固定规则。按网站每单位换手 10 个基点的成本假设，十个市场的平均成本拖累是 TREND-12 每年 2.2%，COMBO-02 为 1.8%，所以计入成本后差距会略微向过滤版倾斜。

en: The RSI filter is mostly an exit and entry rule that keeps MACD out of fast, overbought moves: 33% of days invested instead of 50%, and 18% fewer trades.
It cut the five-year maximum drawdown on 9 of 10 markets and raised the Sharpe ratio on 6, so it is a risk reducer more than a return booster.
It helped most in 2022 and hurt most in crypto-led years such as 2017 and 2020; across 147 market-years it was close to a coin flip.
Bitcoin paid the most for the filter (10.6% a year over five years against 0.1%), and silver and ether also gave up return.
zh: RSI 过滤本质上是一套让 MACD 避开又快又超买行情的入场和离场规则：持仓日从 50% 降到 33%，交易次数少了 18%。
它让近五年最大回撤在 10 个市场中的 9 个变小，夏普在 6 个市场提高，所以更像降风险工具，而不是提收益工具。
它在 2022 年帮助最大，在 2017 年、2020 年这类加密货币主导的年份伤害最大；放到 147 个市场年里，结果接近抛硬币。
比特币为这个过滤付出的代价最大（五年年化 10.6% 降到 0.1%），白银和以太坊也让出了收益。

title.en: Same Max Drawdown, Different Pain: Ulcer Index and Rolling Sharpe
title.zh: 最大回撤相同，煎熬程度不同：Ulcer 指数与滚动夏普

summary.en: On US stocks over the last five years, Z-Score Mean Reversion and Volatility Breakout both had a maximum drawdown of about 10% (−10.4% and −10.1%), yet one spent at most 224 days below its previous high and the other 1,006, and their Ulcer indexes were 1.3% and 5.4%.
summary.zh: 近五年美股上，Z-Score Mean Reversion 和 Volatility Breakout 的最大回撤都在 10% 左右（−10.4% 和 −10.1%），但一个最长只有 224 天处于前高之下，另一个是 1,006 天，两者的 Ulcer 指数分别为 1.3% 和 5.4%。

heading.zh: 四个数字，四个不同的问题

paragraphs.en: Most strategy tables lead with one risk number, the maximum drawdown. This guide uses real pairs of strategies from the arena to show what that number misses and what to read next to it. All figures are from backtests before trading costs, over the five-year window that starts on 2021-11-11 and ends on 2026-11-11.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数策略表格都把最大回撤放在风险指标的第一位。本文用竞技场里的真实策略对子，说明这个数字漏掉了什么，以及该和它一起看什么。所有数字都来自未扣交易成本的回测，区间为从 2021-11-11 到 2026-11-11 的五年窗口。

en: **Maximum drawdown:** the deepest fall from a previous peak to a later low.
**Time under water:** the longest stretch, in calendar days, spent below a previous peak. The site also shows the share of days spent below one.
**Ulcer Index:** the root mean square of the daily drawdown from the running peak, so it grows with both depth and duration.
**Rolling Sharpe:** the Sharpe ratio recomputed over a moving 252-day window, so you see how it changed instead of one average.
zh: **最大回撤**：从前高到之后最低点的最深跌幅。
**水下时间**：处于前高之下的最长一段时间，以日历日计算。站内也会显示处于前高之下的天数占比。
**Ulcer 指数**：每日相对运行前高的回撤的均方根，因此深度和时长都会推高它。
**滚动夏普**：在 252 天的移动窗口上重新计算的夏普比率，你看到的是它如何变化，而不是一个平均值。

heading.en: Maximum drawdown: depth and nothing else

paragraphs.en: Maximum drawdown is one episode. It says how far the worst fall went, not how long it lasted, how often the strategy was below a high, or whether it recovered. Buy-and-hold SPY had a −24.5% maximum drawdown in this window and a Sharpe ratio of 0.74.
paragraphs.zh: 最大回撤只是一次事件。它告诉你最糟的一次下跌有多深，却不说明持续了多久、策略有多少时间处在前高之下，也不说明有没有恢复。在这个窗口里，买入持有 SPY 的最大回撤是 −24.5%，夏普比率 0.74。

paragraphs.en: Take two strategies on SPY. Z-Score Mean Reversion (MR-06) had a maximum drawdown of −10.4% and Volatility Breakout (VOL-01) −10.1%. Of 53 strategies with meaningful trading on SPY, they ranked 11th and 10th by drawdown: next to each other on any leaderboard. They also spent almost the same share of time in the market, 14.0% of days against 14.4%. So neither depth nor exposure separates them.
paragraphs.zh: 看 SPY 上的两个策略。Z-Score Mean Reversion（MR-06）的最大回撤为 −10.4%，Volatility Breakout（VOL-01）为 −10.1%。在 SPY 上有实际交易的 53 个策略里，它们按回撤排第 11 和第 10，在任何排行榜上都紧挨着。它们的持仓时间占比也几乎一样：14.0% 的日子对 14.4%。所以无论是深度还是仓位，都无法把它们区分开。

heading.zh: 水下时间：224 天对 1,006 天

paragraphs.en: The dates do. Z-Score Mean Reversion peaked on 2025-02-28, fell to its low on 2025-04-08 (39 days) and made a new high on 2025-10-13. Its longest stretch below a previous peak ran from 2025-03-03 to 2025-10-13: 224 days. Over the whole window it was below a previous high on 29% of days.
paragraphs.zh: 区分它们的是日期。Z-Score Mean Reversion 在 2025-02-28 见顶，2025-04-08 跌到低点（39 天），2025-10-13 创出新高。它最长的一段处于前高之下的时间从 2025-03-03 到 2025-10-13，共 224 天。整个窗口里，它有 29% 的日子低于此前高点。

paragraphs.en: Volatility Breakout peaked on 2021-11-16, hit its low on 2022-06-27 (223 days later) and did not make a new high until 2024-08-19. That stretch, from 2021-11-17 to 2024-08-19, lasted 1,006 days, almost three years, and it was below a previous high on 99% of all days. The first fall was the same size; the second kept it below a high 4.5 times as long. Annual return followed: 8.0% against 1.1%.
paragraphs.zh: Volatility Breakout 在 2021-11-16 见顶，2022-06-27 到达低点（223 天后），直到 2024-08-19 才创出新高。这一段从 2021-11-17 到 2024-08-19，持续了 1,006 天，将近三年，窗口内有 99% 的日子都低于此前高点。第一次下跌的幅度相同，第二个策略待在前高之下的时间却是前者的 4.5 倍。年化收益也一致地反映了这一点：8.0% 对 1.1%。

paragraphs.en: Being underwater most of the time is normal here: the median SPY strategy was below a previous high on 91% of days, and 36 of 53 were below one on more than 90% of days. Against that, 29% is unusual.
paragraphs.zh: 这里大部分时间处在水下是常态：SPY 上的策略中位数有 91% 的日子低于前高，53 个里有 36 个超过 90% 的日子低于前高。相比之下，29% 就很少见了。

heading.en: The Ulcer Index puts depth and duration in one number
heading.zh: Ulcer 指数把深度和时长放进一个数字

paragraphs.en: For each day, take the percentage the equity is below its running peak, square it, average over the window and take the square root. A day 10% down counts four times as much as a day 5% down, and a long stretch counts for every day of it. That is why a strategy that hovers 3% to 5% below its high for years can score worse than one that dropped 10% once and recovered.
paragraphs.zh: 对每一天，取权益低于运行前高的百分比，平方，在窗口内求平均，再开方。回撤 10% 的一天，权重是回撤 5% 的一天的四倍，而长时间的低迷每一天都会被计入。所以，一个多年徘徊在前高之下 3% 到 5% 的策略，得分可能比一次性下跌 10% 然后恢复的策略更差。

paragraphs.en: Here the Ulcer Index was 1.3% for Z-Score Mean Reversion and 5.4% for Volatility Breakout: 4.2 times higher for the same maximum drawdown. The ranks tell the same story: by drawdown they were 11th and 10th of 53, by Ulcer Index 2nd and 22nd.
paragraphs.zh: 在这里，Z-Score Mean Reversion 的 Ulcer 指数是 1.3%，Volatility Breakout 是 5.4%：最大回撤相同，指数却高出 4.2 倍。排名也说明同一件事：按回撤，它们分别排第 11 和第 10（共 53 个）；按 Ulcer 指数，则是第 2 和第 22。

paragraphs.en: The two measures usually agree: the rank correlation of maximum drawdown and Ulcer Index across the 53 strategies is 0.87. Large gaps are the exception, not the rule. Among strategy pairs on the same market and window whose maximum drawdowns were within one percentage point of each other (790 pairs over five years), 33 had Ulcer Indexes at least twice apart and 157 had longest stretches below a high at least twice apart.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个指标通常是一致的：53 个策略里，最大回撤与 Ulcer 指数的秩相关系数为 0.87。差距这么大的情形是例外，而不是常态。在同一市场、同一窗口、最大回撤相差不到一个百分点的策略对子里（五年窗口共 790 对），有 33 对的 Ulcer 指数相差至少两倍，有 157 对处于前高之下的最长时间相差至少两倍。

paragraphs.en: **Gold:** CCI Mean Reversion (MR-05) and Regime Switch (REG-01, long while the price is above its 200-day average and 60-day volatility is under 25%) had maximum drawdowns of −17.0% and −17.7%. Regime Switch made 16.8% a year against 4.5%, and still had the higher Ulcer Index (9.2% against 3.5%): its fall ran from 2022-03-08 to 2022-12-22 and it needed until 2024-04-03 to recover, 756 days under water. Return and Ulcer Index measure different things, and a good number on the first does not buy the second.
paragraphs.zh: **黄金：**CCI Mean Reversion（MR-05）和 Regime Switch（REG-01，价格在 200 日均线之上且 60 日波动率低于 25% 时持有）的最大回撤分别为 −17.0% 和 −17.7%。Regime Switch 年化 16.8%，对比 4.5%，但 Ulcer 指数仍然更高（9.2% 对 3.5%）：它的那次下跌从 2022-03-08 持续到 2022-12-22，直到 2024-04-03 才恢复，共 756 天处于水下。收益和 Ulcer 指数衡量的是不同的东西，前者好看并不能换来后者好看。

paragraphs.en: **Oil:** Stochastic Oscillator Reversion (MR-10) and Trend + Mean Reversion Hybrid (COMBO-04) had maximum drawdowns of −28.7% and −27.8%, both in the same 28 days, from 2026-06-03 to 2026-07-01. MR-10 had recovered by 2026-10-01. The Hybrid had been below a previous high for 1,435 days (2022-06-29 to 2026-06-03) before that fall and is still below its peak on 2026-11-11. Ulcer Index: 5.9% against 14.1%; annual return: 21.6% against −2.1%.
paragraphs.zh: **原油：**Stochastic Oscillator Reversion（MR-10）和 Trend + Mean Reversion Hybrid（COMBO-04）的最大回撤分别为 −28.7% 和 −27.8%，都发生在同样的 28 天里（2026-06-03 到 2026-07-01）。MR-10 在 2026-10-01 已经恢复。Hybrid 在这次下跌之前已经有 1,435 天（2022-06-29 到 2026-06-03）处于前高之下，到 2026-11-11 仍然在前高之下。Ulcer 指数：5.9% 对 14.1%；年化收益：21.6% 对 −2.1%。

heading.en: Rolling Sharpe: one ratio, many periods
heading.zh: 滚动夏普：一个比率，多个时期

paragraphs.en: A Sharpe ratio averages over a whole window, and the window decides. On SPY, Volatility Breakout's Sharpe ratio was 1.31 over one year, 0.76 over three, 0.21 over five and 0.09 over its full history; Z-Score Mean Reversion's was 1.53, 0.84, 0.89 and 0.44. Judged on one year alone the two look alike. The rolling 252-day Sharpe shows why they are not: Z-Score Mean Reversion's stayed between 0.01 and 1.89 and was positive on every day; Volatility Breakout's ranged from −1.52 (2025-11-13) to 2.69 (2026-10-15) and was positive on 59% of days.
paragraphs.zh: 夏普比率是对整个窗口取平均，窗口选哪一段决定了结果。在 SPY 上，Volatility Breakout 的夏普比率一年期为 1.31，三年期 0.76，五年期 0.21，全部历史 0.09；Z-Score Mean Reversion 分别是 1.53、0.84、0.89 和 0.44。只看一年，两者很像。252 日滚动夏普说明了它们为什么不一样：Z-Score Mean Reversion 的滚动夏普始终在 0.01 到 1.89 之间，每一天都为正；Volatility Breakout 的则从 −1.52（2025-11-13）到 2.69（2026-10-15），有 59% 的日子为正。

paragraphs.en: Rolling Sharpe also catches a slump the average hides. CCI Mean Reversion on gold has a five-year Sharpe of 0.52 but a one-year Sharpe of −0.72: its rolling value was at its low of −0.83 on 2026-11-03, the day its open drawdown bottomed.
paragraphs.zh: 滚动夏普还能抓住被平均数掩盖的低迷。黄金上的 CCI Mean Reversion 五年夏普为 0.52，但一年夏普是 −0.72：它的滚动值在 2026-11-03 降到 −0.83 的低点，正是它那次尚未结束的回撤触底的那天。

heading.en: What these measures cannot tell you
heading.zh: 这些指标没法告诉你的事

paragraphs.en: Every figure depends on its window. The five-year window opens on 2021-11-11, so a drawdown can start in its first days (Volatility Breakout's peak is on 2021-11-16), and a drawdown that is still open (CCI Mean Reversion on gold, the Hybrid on oil) counts as unfinished. All of it is backtested, before trading costs, with walk-forward parameters. A single max drawdown or rolling Sharpe is also one path out of many: on the site the 90% bootstrap range shows how much deeper the worst fall could have been.
paragraphs.zh: 每个数字都取决于窗口。五年窗口从 2021-11-11 开始，所以回撤可能在最初几天就开始（Volatility Breakout 的高点在 2021-11-16），尚未结束的回撤（黄金上的 CCI Mean Reversion、原油上的 Hybrid）也只能算作未完成。所有结果都是回测、未扣交易成本，并使用滚动前推优化的参数。单一的最大回撤或滚动夏普也只是众多可能路径中的一条：站内提供的 90% 自助法区间，可以看出最糟的一次下跌本来可能有多深。

en: Read maximum drawdown together with the longest stretch below a high and the Ulcer Index.
When two strategies have similar drawdowns, compare their Ulcer Indexes: a ratio of 2 or more means a different experience.
A Sharpe ratio that is similar over one, three and five years says more than one with a single good window.
Look at the rolling Sharpe chart for the last year before trusting the long-run number.
Ask how long you could watch a strategy sit below its high, and compare that with its longest stretch.
zh: 把最大回撤、处于前高之下的最长时间和 Ulcer 指数放在一起看。
两个策略的回撤相近时，比较它们的 Ulcer 指数：相差 2 倍或以上，意味着完全不同的体验。
一年、三年、五年夏普大致相近，比只有一个窗口特别好看的夏普更能说明问题。
在相信长期数字之前，先看最近一年的滚动夏普图。
问问自己，能忍受看着一个策略待在前高之下多久，再和它的最长水下时间对照。

title.en: Keltner Breakout vs Bollinger Reversion: Ten Markets Compared
title.zh: Keltner 突破与 Bollinger 回归：十个市场的对比

summary.en: A Keltner Channel breakout and a Bollinger Band reversion rule were never in the market on the same day across ten markets (0 overlapping days out of 4,648 for the reversion rule). Over five years each had the better Sharpe ratio on five markets; over the full history the breakout was ahead on all ten.
summary.zh: Keltner 通道突破和 Bollinger 带均值回归这两条规则，在十个市场上从未在同一天同时持仓（回归规则的 4,648 个持仓日里重叠 0 天）。近五年各自在五个市场上夏普更高；看完整历史，突破规则在十个市场上全部领先。

heading.zh: 两条通道，两种相反的押注

paragraphs.en: Both strategies draw a volatility envelope around a 20-day average, and both are long-only on the site. They disagree about what a touch of the envelope means.
paragraphs.zh: 两个策略都在 20 日均线周围画出波动率通道，站内也都只做多。它们对“触及通道边缘”的理解正好相反。

en: **Keltner Channel Breakout (KC-01):** the midline is a 20-day exponential average and the bands sit 2 times the ATR above and below it, where the ATR is a 20-day simple average of the true range. It goes long when the close is above the upper band and exits when the close drops below the midline.

**Bollinger Band Reversion (MR-02):** the midline is a 20-day simple average and the bands sit 2 standard deviations away. It buys when the close is at or below the lower band and the bandwidth is above its own 20-day average. It exits when the close returns to the midline, after 10 days, or if the close is more than 3% under the lower band.
zh: **Keltner Channel Breakout（KC-01）**：中轴是 20 日指数均线，上下轨在中轴之上、之下各 2 倍 ATR，这里的 ATR 是真实波幅的 20 日简单平均。收盘价站上上轨时做多，收盘价跌回中轴之下时离场。
**Bollinger Band Reversion（MR-02）**：中轴是 20 日简单均线，上下轨距离中轴 2 个标准差。收盘价触及或跌破下轨、且带宽高于自身 20 日均值时买入；收盘价回到中轴、持有满 10 天，或收盘价比下轨低 3% 以上时离场。

paragraphs.en: Walk-forward selection retunes the windows: on US stocks the breakout used 6 distinct settings and the reversion rule 7, starting from the first test period in January 2013. All results below are before trading costs, for five years (from 2021-11-11 to 2026-11-11) and for each market's full history, which begins in 2010 for most markets, September 2014 for bitcoin and November 2017 for ether.
paragraphs.zh: 滚动前推优化会重新选择窗口长度：在美股上，突破规则用过 6 种不同设置，回归规则用过 7 种，第一个测试期从 2013 年 1 月开始。下面所有结果都未扣交易成本，分别统计近五年（2021-11-11 至 2026-11-11）和各市场的完整历史；完整历史对大多数市场始于 2010 年，比特币始于 2014 年 9 月，以太坊始于 2017 年 11 月。

heading.en: They never hold at the same time

paragraphs.en: Pooled across the ten markets, the reversion rule was long on 4,648 days and the breakout on 10,582. On none of them were both long. That follows from the rules: the breakout enters only above its upper band and leaves when the close falls under its midline, while the reversion rule enters only at the lower band of its own envelope. The consequence is that the correlation of their daily returns is zero for practical purposes: between −0.001 and 0.000 on every market, in both windows.
paragraphs.zh: 十个市场合计，回归规则持仓 4,648 天，突破规则持仓 10,582 天，没有任何一天两者同时持仓。这是规则决定的：突破规则只在价格站上上轨时才进场、跌破中轴就离场，而回归规则只在自己通道的下轨进场。结果是两者日收益的相关系数在实际意义上为零：每个市场、两个窗口下都在 −0.001 到 0.000 之间。

paragraphs.en: That is not diversification in the usual sense. Zero correlation here comes from taking turns, not from independent information. Days in market also differ: the breakout was invested a median 27% of days over five years (13% to 35% across markets), the reversion rule 10% (7% to 15%).
paragraphs.zh: 这并不是通常意义上的分散化。这里的零相关来自“轮流上场”，而不是来自相互独立的信息。持仓天数也不同：近五年突破规则的持仓天数占比中位数为 27%（各市场在 13% 到 35% 之间），回归规则为 10%（7% 到 15%）。

heading.en: Five years: a clean five-five split

paragraphs.en: By Sharpe ratio the breakout won on US stocks (0.69 against 0.42), gold (0.60 against 0.18), silver (0.39 against −0.10), bitcoin (0.55 against −0.12) and ether (0.23 against 0.16). Its best case was bitcoin at 14.6% a year against 2.6% for holding, with a −32.9% maximum drawdown against −75.9%.

The reversion rule won on oil (0.74 against 0.26), natural gas (0.08 against −0.72), broad commodities (0.81 against 0.27), agriculture (0.50 against −0.12) and EUR/USD (0.28 against −0.36). On oil it made 8.9% a year with a −13.0% drawdown and was long 12% of days; on natural gas the breakout lost 24.4% a year with an −80.9% drawdown while the reversion rule broke even.
paragraphs.zh: 回归规则赢下了原油（0.74 对 0.26）、天然气（0.08 对 −0.72）、综合大宗商品（0.81 对 0.27）、农产品（0.50 对 −0.12）和欧元/美元（0.28 对 −0.36）。在原油上它年化 8.9%，最大回撤 −13.0%，持仓天数占 12%；在天然气上，突破规则年化亏损 24.4%、最大回撤 −80.9%，而回归规则基本持平（0.0%）。

paragraphs.en: Neither beat buy-and-hold on return in more than three of ten markets. On US stocks, where holding made 11.9% a year with a Sharpe ratio of 0.74 and a −24.5% drawdown, the breakout made 4.5% (0.69, −8.5%) and the reversion rule 3.3% (0.42, −9.0%).
paragraphs.zh: 两者在十个市场里，收益跑赢买入持有的都不超过三个。在美股上，持有年化 11.9%、夏普 0.74、最大回撤 −24.5%，突破规则年化 4.5%（0.69，−8.5%），回归规则年化 3.3%（0.42，−9.0%）。

heading.en: Full history: the breakout wins all ten
heading.zh: 完整历史：突破规则十战全胜

paragraphs.en: Over the full history the picture is lopsided. The breakout had the higher Sharpe ratio on all ten markets, median 0.39 against 0.11 for the reversion rule. It beat holding on return in eight markets, the reversion rule in three, and both had a shallower drawdown than holding on all ten.
paragraphs.zh: 看完整历史，结果一边倒。突破规则在十个市场上夏普全部更高，中位数 0.39，回归规则为 0.11。它在八个市场上收益跑赢持有，回归规则是三个；两者的最大回撤在十个市场上都比持有更浅。

paragraphs.en: The breakout's best results were bitcoin (53.8% a year, Sharpe 1.13, −45.5% drawdown, against 52.0%, 0.80 and −83.4% for holding) and ether (32.4%, 0.69 against 22.9%, 0.56). The reversion rule's best Sharpe was 0.35, on US stocks, where it made 2.8% a year and the breakout 3.1% with a Sharpe of 0.51. The breakout had a negative return on three markets (oil, natural gas, EUR/USD) and the reversion rule on four (silver, oil, natural gas, EUR/USD).
paragraphs.zh: 突破规则最好的成绩是比特币（年化 53.8%，夏普 1.13，最大回撤 −45.5%；持有为 52.0%、0.80、−83.4%）和以太坊（32.4%，0.69；持有为 22.9%，0.56）。回归规则夏普最高的是美股，只有 0.35，年化 2.8%，同一市场上突破规则年化 3.1%、夏普 0.51。突破规则在三个市场收益为负（原油、天然气、欧元/美元），回归规则在四个（白银、原油、天然气、欧元/美元）。

paragraphs.en: Counting calendar years, with each market's first partial year skipped, the breakout beat the reversion rule in 86 of 149 market-years, the reversion rule in 63.
paragraphs.zh: 按日历年计算（每个市场跳过第一个不完整年份），突破规则在 149 个“市场-年份”中赢了 86 个，回归规则赢了 63 个。

paragraphs.en: In 2022 the split came back: the breakout was ahead in five markets and the reversion rule in five; the breakout finished positive on five and the reversion rule on six. On US stocks, down 18.2%, the breakout lost 4.1% and the reversion rule gained 5.7%. On natural gas the reversion rule gained 19.8% and the breakout lost 24.2%. On ether, down 67.5%, the breakout made 11.0% and the reversion rule lost 32.3%.
paragraphs.zh: 2022 年两者的分化又出现了：突破规则在五个市场领先，回归规则也是五个；突破规则在五个市场收正，回归规则在六个。美股下跌 18.2%，突破规则亏 4.1%，回归规则赚 5.7%。天然气上回归规则赚 19.8%，突破规则亏 24.2%。以太坊下跌 67.5%，突破规则赚 11.0%，回归规则亏 32.3%。

paragraphs.en: Because the two never overlap, a daily-rebalanced 50/50 mix is simply half the capital working in each. It rarely beat both parents. Over five years the mix had a Sharpe ratio above both strategies on only three markets (US stocks, gold, ether) and above the weaker one on all ten. Over the full history it beat both on three (US stocks, broad commodities, agriculture), and its maximum drawdown was shallower than both on nine of ten.
paragraphs.zh: 由于两者从不重叠，每日再平衡的五五混合其实就是一半资金各用在一边。它很少同时胜过两个“父本”。近五年里，混合的夏普比率只在三个市场（美股、黄金、以太坊）高于两者，在全部十个市场高于较弱的那个；完整历史里，它在三个市场（美股、综合大宗商品、农产品）胜过两者，最大回撤则在十个市场中的九个比两者都浅。

paragraphs.en: The best case was US stocks over five years: 4.1% a year, Sharpe 0.75 and a −5.8% drawdown, against 4.5%, 0.69, −8.5% for the breakout and 3.3%, 0.42, −9.0% for the reversion rule. The cost shows up on markets where one side dominated: on bitcoin over the full history the mix made 28.5% a year at a Sharpe of 1.00 and a −40.2% drawdown, against 53.8%, 1.13 and −45.5% for the breakout alone.
paragraphs.zh: 最好的例子是近五年的美股：年化 4.1%，夏普 0.75，最大回撤 −5.8%；突破规则为 4.5%、0.69、−8.5%，回归规则为 3.3%、0.42、−9.0%。代价体现在一边明显占优的市场上：完整历史中的比特币，混合年化 28.5%、夏普 1.00、最大回撤 −40.2%，而单独的突破规则是 53.8%、1.13、−45.5%。

paragraphs.en: Not very. None of the 20 five-year results (two strategies, ten markets) has a deflated Sharpe ratio above 95%, and none of the 20 full-history results does either. The highest are the breakout on US stocks over five years (52.9%) and on bitcoin over the full history (82.6%). The 90% bootstrap range for the breakout's five-year return on US stocks is −0.2% to 9.7% a year, and for the reversion rule −1.0% to 7.8%; on bitcoin the breakout's range is −6.9% to 40.6%. Windows are short and few markets are independent, so read the split as a pattern, not a proof.
paragraphs.zh: 不太可靠。20 个近五年结果（两个策略、十个市场）没有一个的缩水夏普（Deflated Sharpe）超过 95%，20 个完整历史结果也没有。最高的两个是近五年美股上的突破规则（52.9%）和完整历史比特币上的突破规则（82.6%）。突破规则在美股上近五年收益的 90% 自助法区间为每年 −0.2% 到 9.7%，回归规则为 −1.0% 到 7.8%；比特币上突破规则的区间是 −6.9% 到 40.6%。窗口很短，真正独立的市场也不多，所以这个分化只能当作一种规律的迹象，而不是证明。

en: The two rules are mirror images that never trade on the same day; their zero correlation is mechanical.
Over five years each won five markets by Sharpe ratio; over the full history the breakout won all ten.
A 50/50 mix beat both parents on Sharpe in only three markets per window, and had a shallower drawdown than both on nine of ten markets over the full history but only three over five years.
Neither reliably beat buy-and-hold on return; the breakout's edge in this sample is a shallower drawdown than holding (all ten markets over the full history) and large gains on crypto.
Over five years reversion looked best where the breakout did worst (oil, natural gas, agriculture), so the market matters as much as the band.
zh: 这两条规则像镜像，从不在同一天交易；它们的零相关是机械造成的。
近五年各自按夏普赢下五个市场；完整历史里突破规则赢下全部十个。
五五混合每个窗口里只在三个市场的夏普上胜过两个父本，完整历史里最大回撤在十个市场中的九个比两者都浅，近五年只有三个。
两者都没有稳定跑赢买入持有的收益；这段样本里突破规则的优势是回撤比持有更浅（完整历史十个市场全部如此）以及在加密货币上的大幅收益。
近五年回归规则在突破规则表现最差的地方最好（原油、天然气、农产品），所以选市场和选通道同样重要。

title.zh: 通道对比

caption.en: Keltner Channels (Blue) are smoother and use ATR; Bollinger Bands (Red) are reactive and use Standard Deviation.
caption.zh: 肯特纳通道（蓝色）更平滑，基于 ATR 构建；布林带（红色）反应更敏捷，基于标准差计算。

title.en: EMA Crossover Strategy: Reading Trend With Two Clocks
title.zh: EMA 交叉策略：用两只时钟读取趋势

summary.en: An in depth look at why exponential moving average crossovers persist, how to interpret their backtests, and when trend signals fail.
summary.zh: 深入解析指数移动平均线交叉为何长期有效、应如何解读其回测，以及趋势信号何时会失效。

title.en: EMA crossover signal sketch
title.zh: EMA 交叉信号示意图

caption.en: A simplified illustration of price (teal) with fast and slow EMAs (orange and gray).
caption.zh: 价格（青绿色）与快、慢 EMA（橙色与灰色）的简化示意图。

heading.zh: 为何 EMA 交叉长期存在

paragraphs.en: The exponential moving average crossover exists because markets rarely move in straight lines. Prices drift, pause, and then continue, and traders need a simple way to decide whether a move is noise or a trend that is worth following. An EMA smooths recent prices while keeping more weight on the latest data, so it reacts faster than a simple average. By comparing a fast EMA to a slow EMA, the strategy asks a single question: is short term momentum strong enough to outrun the long term baseline? The answer is often good enough to keep traders aligned with the dominant move without overfitting to daily noise.
paragraphs.zh: 指数移动平均线交叉之所以长期有效，是因为市场很少沿直线运行。价格会漂移、停顿，再继续推进，交易者需要一种简单方式来判断当前波动究竟只是噪音，还是值得跟随的趋势。EMA 在平滑近期价格的同时，对最新数据赋予更高权重，因此反应快于简单均线。通过比较快线与慢线，策略本质上只在回答一个问题：短期动能是否足以跑赢长期基准？很多时候，这个答案已足够让交易者跟上主导趋势，而不必对日常噪音过度拟合。

paragraphs.en: EMA crossovers are also popular because they are easy to explain. A two line rule can be implemented across equities, FX, or commodities with minimal changes, which makes it a natural benchmark for trend systems. The simplicity hides an important idea: the crossover is not a prediction, it is a filter. It allows a trader to say no during choppy regimes and yes during clean directional moves. That filter, not the entry precision, is what keeps the strategy alive across decades.
paragraphs.zh: EMA 交叉之所以广受欢迎，还因为它极易解释。一套双均线规则只需极少调整，就能应用到股票、外汇和商品市场，因此天然适合作为趋势系统的基准模型。这种简洁性背后隐藏着一个关键点：交叉不是预测工具，而是过滤器。它帮助交易者在震荡市场中选择观望，在方向清晰的行情中选择参与。真正让这一策略跨越数十年仍然存活的，不是入场精度，而是这种过滤机制。

heading.en: Signal mechanics without the math overload
heading.zh: 不过度数学化的信号机制

paragraphs.en: A classic EMA crossover uses a fast window such as 20 days and a slow window such as 100 or 200 days. The fast EMA reacts to recent price changes while the slow EMA defines the longer term regime. When the fast line rises above the slow line, the strategy goes long. When it falls below, the strategy exits or goes short depending on the design. This creates a small number of trades, each one attempting to capture a multi week or multi month trend.
paragraphs.zh: 经典 EMA 交叉通常采用 20 日等较快窗口与 100 日或 200 日等较慢窗口。快 EMA 对近期价格变化反应更快，慢 EMA 则用于界定更长期的市场状态。当快线向上穿越慢线时，策略做多；当快线跌破慢线时，则根据设计选择平仓或反手做空。这样的规则会生成较少但更聚焦的交易，每一笔都试图捕捉数周乃至数月的趋势。

paragraphs.en: Because EMAs emphasize recent data, the crossover often occurs after a trend has already started. That delay is intentional. The strategy gives up the first part of a move in exchange for avoiding many false starts. In practice, the choice of windows controls the trade off between responsiveness and stability. Short windows increase turnover and whipsaws, while longer windows increase delay but may improve trend quality.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 EMA 更重视近期数据，交叉往往发生在趋势已经启动之后。这种滞后是有意为之。策略愿意放弃一段行情起步阶段，以换取减少大量假启动信号。在实务中，窗口长度决定了“响应速度”与“稳定性”之间的权衡。较短窗口会提高换手并带来更多反复震荡，较长窗口则会增加滞后，但往往能提升趋势质量。

heading.zh: 市场适配性与市场状态表现

paragraphs.en: EMA crossovers are most effective in markets that exhibit sustained directional moves. Equity indices and macro driven commodities often fit this profile because they trend in response to economic cycles, risk appetite, and policy shifts. The strategy can also work in FX pairs when a clear rate differential or risk regime exists, but it tends to be more sensitive to sudden reversals and central bank surprises.
paragraphs.zh: EMA 交叉在持续单边运行的市场中最为有效。股票指数与受宏观因素驱动的商品通常符合这一特征，因为它们会随经济周期、风险偏好和政策变化形成趋势。当汇率差异或风险环境较为明确时，该策略在外汇品种中也能发挥作用，但对突发反转和央行意外事件通常更为敏感。

paragraphs.en: In sideways markets the crossover struggles. Range bound regimes generate frequent cross signals with little follow through, leading to a series of small losses. That is why a crossover strategy typically looks best over long horizons that include both trends and noise. The long horizon allows a few large winners to outweigh the smaller whipsaws.
paragraphs.zh: 在横盘市场中，交叉策略往往表现艰难。区间震荡会产生频繁交叉，但后续延续性很差，最终形成一连串小亏损。因此，交叉策略通常只有在同时覆盖趋势与噪音的长周期回测中，表现才更有说服力。拉长周期后，少数大赢家才有机会覆盖大量小幅震荡损失。

paragraphs.en: Backtests for EMA crossovers often show a stair step equity curve. Long flat periods are followed by sharp gains during trend phases, then giveback during choppy markets. This is not a bug. It reflects the reality that trend following pays only when trends exist. When evaluating results, focus on the distribution of trade outcomes rather than the average trade. A small number of big winners often drives total return.
paragraphs.zh: EMA 交叉策略的回测净值曲线常呈现“台阶状”。长时间横盘之后，趋势阶段出现快速拉升，随后又在震荡市场中回吐部分收益。这并不是缺陷，而是趋势跟随的真实特征：只有当趋势存在时，策略才会获得报酬。评估结果时，应更多关注交易结果的分布，而不是单笔平均收益。总体回报往往由少数几笔大赢家驱动。

paragraphs.en: Look at drawdown depth and duration. A crossover may show acceptable long term return but still experience a multi year drawdown if the market stays range bound or reverses sharply. Also compare trade counts and turnover. If a parameter set produces too many trades, it may be too sensitive and may not survive real world costs.
paragraphs.zh: 还应重点观察回撤深度与回撤持续时间。某一组交叉参数即便长期收益尚可，如果市场长期震荡或急剧反转，仍可能经历持续数年的回撤。同时也要比较交易次数与换手率。若某组参数产生过多交易，往往意味着系统过于敏感，未必能承受真实世界中的交易成本。

paragraphs.en: The primary risk is whipsaw. When price oscillates around the slow EMA, the strategy flips positions and suffers a series of small losses. Another risk is gap risk. Because trades are executed on the next session, a sudden overnight gap can create a much worse entry or exit than expected. The model is also exposed to crash risk because it remains long during trends and exits only after a reversal is confirmed.
paragraphs.zh: 核心风险是反复震荡带来的 whipsaw。当价格围绕慢 EMA 来回摆动时，策略会频繁翻转仓位并承受连续小亏损。另一个风险是跳空风险。由于交易在下一交易时段执行，隔夜跳空可能导致远差于预期的入场或出场价格。该模型还暴露于崩跌风险之下，因为它在趋势中持续持有，只有在反转被确认后才退出。

paragraphs.en: Parameter sensitivity is another weakness. A crossover that looks perfect on a specific historical window can fail out of sample if the chosen windows fit that period too tightly. Walk forward tests and multiple window evaluations help, but they do not eliminate the risk of overfitting. Risk overlays such as stop losses or volatility filters can reduce drawdowns, but they may also cut the biggest winners.
paragraphs.zh: 参数敏感性也是其弱点之一。某组交叉参数在特定历史窗口中看似完美，但若窗口选择对该时期拟合过紧，样本外表现可能迅速失效。滚动前瞻测试和多窗口评估虽然有帮助，但并不能彻底消除过拟合风险。止损或波动率过滤等风险覆盖层可以降低回撤，但也可能同时截断那些最重要的大盈利交易。

heading.en: How it differs from other trend rules
heading.zh: 它与其他趋势规则有何不同

paragraphs.en: Compared to Donchian breakouts, EMA crossovers react to average price rather than to extreme highs or lows. This makes them smoother but sometimes slower to catch sudden breakouts. Compared to Keltner or Bollinger channel systems, EMA crossovers ignore volatility expansion and focus purely on direction. That makes them simpler but less adaptive to volatility regimes.
paragraphs.zh: 与唐奇安突破相比，EMA 交叉关注的是平均价格变化，而不是极端高点或低点，因此通常更平滑，但在应对突发突破时有时会更慢。与肯特纳或布林带通道系统相比，EMA 交叉忽略波动率扩张，只聚焦方向本身。这使它更简单，但对不同波动率环境的适应性较弱。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive moving averages such as KAMA aim to adjust their speed based on market efficiency. They can outperform a fixed EMA in some regimes, but they are harder to interpret and tune. The EMA crossover remains a baseline because it is transparent and robust across assets. It is a useful reference point when testing more complex trend systems.
paragraphs.zh: 像 KAMA 这样的自适应移动平均线试图根据市场效率动态调整响应速度。在某些市场状态下，它们可能优于固定 EMA，但解释和调参都更复杂。EMA 交叉之所以仍被视为基准，是因为它足够透明，并能在多类资产上保持稳健。在测试更复杂的趋势系统时，它是一个非常有价值的参考起点。

heading.zh: 实务变体与组合中的角色

paragraphs.en: Researchers often adapt EMA lengths to the instrument. FX pairs may respond better to faster averages, while equity indices may benefit from slower settings that filter out noise. Other variations require the fast EMA to be rising, or the price to be above a longer trend filter, before entering. These small additions can reduce whipsaws without changing the core logic.
paragraphs.zh: 研究者通常会根据标的调整 EMA 长度。外汇货币对可能更适合较快均线，而股票指数则可能更受益于能过滤噪音的较慢参数。其他常见变体包括要求快 EMA 本身正在上行，或要求价格位于更长期趋势过滤器上方后才允许入场。这些小幅调整能在不改变核心逻辑的前提下减少反复震荡。

paragraphs.en: In diversified portfolios, EMA crossovers are usually one sleeve among others. Trend exposure can be sized by volatility or capped by correlation so that one regime does not dominate risk. Pairing trend systems with mean reversion or carry models can smooth returns and reduce long drawdown stretches. The crossover works best when it is allowed to do one job: capture trends when they appear.
paragraphs.zh: 在分散化投资组合中，EMA 交叉通常只是其中一个策略分层。趋势敞口可以按波动率分配，或通过相关性上限进行约束，以避免单一市场状态主导组合风险。将趋势系统与均值回归或 carry 模型配合，往往有助于平滑收益并缩短长期回撤阶段。EMA 交叉最适合承担一项清晰任务：当趋势出现时负责捕捉它。

paragraphs.en: A practical workflow is to treat the crossover as a regime filter and then apply more refined entries within that regime. For example, a trader might only take pullback entries when the fast EMA stays above the slow EMA. This preserves the trend bias while allowing more precise timing, and it can reduce the frustration of late entries without changing the underlying philosophy.
paragraphs.zh: 一种实用流程是先把交叉视为市场状态过滤器，再在该状态内叠加更精细的入场规则。例如，交易者可以仅在快 EMA 位于慢 EMA 上方时做回调买入。这样既保留了趋势偏向，又能获得更精确的择时，同时减少“追得太晚”的挫败感，而无需改变策略的底层哲学。

title.en: Parabolic SAR vs Supertrend: Which Trailing Stop Did Better?
title.zh: 抛物线 SAR 对比 Supertrend：哪种移动止损表现更好？

summary.en: Parabolic SAR (SAR-01) earned a positive annual return on nine of ten markets over its full history, before trading costs, with EUR/USD the best at a 1.17 Sharpe ratio. But its maximum drawdown was deeper than Supertrend's (SUPER-01) on eight of ten markets.
summary.zh: 在未扣交易成本的前提下，抛物线 SAR（SAR-01）在 10 个市场的完整历史中有 9 个年化收益为正，其中欧元/美元表现最好，夏普 1.17；但它的最大回撤在 10 个市场中有 8 个比 Supertrend（SUPER-01）更深。

paragraphs.en: Parabolic SAR (SAR-01) keeps a stop below price that creeps upward every day. It starts with an acceleration factor of 0.02, adds 0.02 each time the trend makes a new high, and caps it at 0.20, so the stop moves faster the longer a trend runs. When the day's low touches the stop, the system flips.
paragraphs.zh: 抛物线 SAR（SAR-01）在价格下方维持一条每天向上靠拢的止损线。加速因子从 0.02 起步，趋势每创新高就加 0.02，上限 0.20，所以趋势走得越久，止损线移动得越快。当天最低价触及止损线时，系统翻转。

paragraphs.en: On this site it is long only: an up-trend means fully invested and a down-trend means cash. It reads each day's high and low, decides at the close, and earns the following day's return. Everything here is before trading costs. The last five years run to 2026-11-11; the full period starts on 2010-01-04 for most markets, 2014-09-17 for bitcoin and 2017-11-09 for ether.
paragraphs.zh: 在本站它只做多：上升趋势满仓，下降趋势空仓。它读取每天的最高价和最低价，在收盘时做决定，赚取下一个交易日的收益。以下全部为未扣交易成本的结果。近五年截至 2026-11-11；完整区间对多数市场从 2010-01-04 开始，比特币从 2014-09-17，以太坊从 2017-11-09。

paragraphs.en: The idea is that the longer a move runs, the closer the stop sits to price, so a profit is locked in before a reversal can take it all back. The price is paid in sideways markets, where the stop keeps getting touched. Across the ten markets the system made 3,491 entries since 2010, against 1,973 for Supertrend, and it stayed in the market on a median of 51% of days (range 43% to 62%).
paragraphs.zh: 它的想法是：行情走得越久，止损线离价格越近，利润在反转吞掉之前就已锁定。代价出现在横盘市场里，止损线会被反复触及。10 个市场自 2010 年以来共产生 3,491 次入场，Supertrend 为 1,973 次；它在中位数 51% 的交易日持仓（范围 43% 到 62%）。

paragraphs.en: The first three years of each market use the default settings above. After that the parameters are re-picked every six months from a small grid around them.
paragraphs.zh: 每个市场的前三年使用上述默认参数；之后每六个月在默认值附近的一小组参数里重新挑选。

paragraphs.en: Each line gives CAGR / Sharpe / maximum drawdown for the last five years, then for the full period.
paragraphs.zh: 每行依次为年化收益 / 夏普 / 最大回撤，先是近五年，然后是完整区间。

en: **US stocks:** 1.2% / 0.17 / −22.7%; full 5.1% / 0.53 / −24.3%. In the market 62% of days.

paragraphs.en: EUR/USD was the best market on both windows, and the only one where the five-year maximum drawdown stayed in single digits. Natural gas was the worst on both: a 96.2% maximum drawdown over the full period. Seven markets had a positive annual return over the last five years and nine over the full period.
paragraphs.zh: 欧元/美元在两个窗口中都是表现最好的市场，也是唯一一个近五年最大回撤保持在个位数的市场。天然气在两个窗口中都最差：完整区间最大回撤达 96.2%。近五年有 7 个市场年化收益为正，完整区间有 9 个。

paragraphs.en: The crypto numbers show how much the window matters. Bitcoin and ether made 40.0% and 42.5% a year over their full histories but lost money over the last five years. A drawdown of 71.4% on bitcoin is what that full-period figure cost.
paragraphs.zh: 加密货币的数字说明了窗口选择有多重要。比特币和以太坊在完整历史中年化 40.0% 和 42.5%，但近五年都是亏的。比特币完整区间的最大回撤为 71.4%，这就是那个收益数字的代价。

heading.en: The worst calendar year in each market
heading.zh: 每个市场的最差日历年

paragraphs.en: Taking each market's worst full calendar year, SAR lost less than the market in nine of ten and lost money in nine of ten. The exception was US stocks in 2022: the market fell 18.2% and the system fell 19.5%, being in the market on 49% of days that year.
paragraphs.zh: 取每个市场自己最差的完整日历年，SAR 在 10 个市场中有 9 个亏得比市场少，同样有 9 个市场出现亏损。例外是 2022 年的美股：市场下跌 18.2%，系统下跌 19.5%，那一年它的持仓天数占 49%。

paragraphs.en: The best cases were deep one-way falls. In oil's 2020 (the market fell 67.8%) the system gained 9.4%; in silver's 2013 (−36.3%) it lost 6.7%; in gold's 2013 (−28.3%) it lost 12.6%; in bitcoin's 2018 (−73.6%) it lost 14.7%. In natural gas's 2023 (−64.0%) it still lost 50.3%: a stop that is touched often cannot protect a market that keeps bouncing.
paragraphs.zh: 最好的几例是单边深跌。原油 2020 年（市场下跌 67.8%）系统盈利 9.4%；白银 2013 年（−36.3%）亏 6.7%；黄金 2013 年（−28.3%）亏 12.6%；比特币 2018 年（−73.6%）亏 14.7%。天然气 2023 年（−64.0%）它仍亏了 50.3%：止损线被频繁触及，保护不了一个不断反弹的市场。

paragraphs.en: Supertrend (SUPER-01) is the closest relative: also long only, also a flipping stop, but built from a smoothed average true range (EMA span 10, multiplier 2.5) around the day's midpoint, and it flips only when the close crosses the band. On a given day the two agree on whether to hold or not on a median 78% of days.
paragraphs.zh: Supertrend（SUPER-01）是最接近的同类：同样只做多，同样是翻转式止损，但它用平滑后的真实波幅均值（EMA 跨度 10，倍数 2.5）围绕当天中价构建通道，并且只在收盘价穿越通道时才翻转。两者在持仓与否的判断上，中位数有 78% 的交易日一致。

paragraphs.en: Sharpe is close to a coin flip: SAR was higher on five markets over five years and on four over the full period, although its mean Sharpe was higher in both (0.34 vs 0.25, and 0.49 vs 0.38), pulled up by EUR/USD and gold. Drawdown is where Supertrend wins: shallower on nine of ten markets in five years and eight of ten in the full period (mean −36.7% vs −43.2% over five years).
paragraphs.zh: 夏普几乎是五五开：近五年 SAR 在 5 个市场更高，完整区间在 4 个市场更高，不过两个窗口里它的平均夏普都更高（0.34 对 0.25，以及 0.49 对 0.38），主要由欧元/美元和黄金拉高。回撤方面 Supertrend 占优：近五年有 9 个市场更浅，完整区间有 8 个（近五年平均 −36.7% 对 −43.2%）。

paragraphs.en: In those same years Supertrend did better than the market in all ten. On US stocks in 2022 it fell 5.1% against SAR's 19.5%. But SAR did better in only four of ten of those years, and the two disagreed sharply on ether in 2018, which was inside the default-settings period: Supertrend gained 47.8% in the year the market fell 82.4%, including 30.3% in January alone.
paragraphs.zh: 同样在这些年份里，Supertrend 在全部 10 个市场都跑赢了市场。2022 年美股它下跌 5.1%，而 SAR 为 19.5%。不过 SAR 只在 10 个最差年份中的 4 个里表现更好；两者在 2018 年的以太坊上分歧最大，那一年处于默认参数阶段：市场下跌 82.4%，Supertrend 却盈利 47.8%，其中仅 1 月份就贡献了 30.3%。

paragraphs.en: Whipsaw is the cost of a close stop. With 3,491 entries, even small trading costs would take a bite that this backtest does not show. The numbers also cannot say that a good full-period result will repeat; they mix very different stretches, and the 2018 ether gain above includes a single 30.3% month.
paragraphs.zh: 被频繁触及的止损，代价是反复来回。3,491 次入场意味着即使很小的交易成本也会明显侵蚀收益，而这个回测并未体现。这些数字也不能说明一个不错的完整区间结果会重复出现；它们混合了截然不同的行情，上面 2018 年以太坊的收益包含 1 月份单月 30.3% 的涨幅。

paragraphs.en: Both systems here are long only, so none of the results say anything about shorting a down-trend. Natural gas shows what that leaves: it was out of the market on more than half the days, and still had a 96.2% maximum drawdown.
paragraphs.zh: 这里的两个系统都只做多，所以结果完全不能说明做空下跌趋势会怎样。天然气就是例子：它超过一半的交易日不持仓，但最大回撤仍达 96.2%。

en: SAR is a faster, more active stop than Supertrend: more entries, deeper drawdowns, similar Sharpe.
On the ten markets, EUR/USD and gold suited it best; natural gas, bitcoin and ether over five years did not.
It softened most calendar-year falls (nine of ten), but not by enough to avoid losses (nine of ten still lost).
Backtested, before trading costs; the first three years of each market use default settings, not walk-forward choices.
zh: SAR 是比 Supertrend 更快、更活跃的止损：入场更多，回撤更深，夏普相近。
在这十个市场里，欧元/美元和黄金最适合它；天然气以及近五年的比特币、以太坊则不适合。
它缓和了大多数日历年的下跌（10 个中的 9 个），但不足以避免亏损（仍有 9 个亏损）。
回测结果未扣交易成本；每个市场前三年使用默认参数，而不是滚动前推的选择。
