title.en: Does a Volatility Breakout Strategy Work? A Ten-Market Test
title.zh: 波动率突破策略有效吗？10 个市场回测

summary.en: Volatility Breakout (VOL-01) buys after an unusually large up day and sells at the first down day, so it was invested on only 14% of days on US stocks over five years: 1.1% a year against 11.9% for holding, with a 10.1% maximum drawdown instead of 24.5%. Keltner Channel Breakout (KC-01) stayed in the market about twice as long and traded far less.
summary.zh: 波动率突破（VOL-01）在出现异常大涨的一天之后买入，遇到第一个下跌日就卖出，所以近五年在美股上只有 14% 的交易日持仓：年化 1.1%，持有只有 11.9%，最大回撤 10.1%，持有则是 24.5%。肯特纳通道突破（KC-01）的持仓时间约为它的两倍，交易次数则少得多。

heading.en: What the rule does, from the code

paragraphs.en: Volatility Breakout (VOL-01) looks at one number each day: the close-to-close return. It also computes the standard deviation of the last 20 daily returns. If today's return is above 1.5 times that standard deviation, the strategy is long tomorrow. If it is not, and today's return is negative, the strategy is flat. Otherwise it keeps yesterday's position.
paragraphs.zh: 波动率突破（VOL-01）每天只看一个数：收盘到收盘的收益率，同时计算最近 20 个日收益率的标准差。如果今天的收益率高于该标准差的 1.5 倍，明天持有多头；如果没有，且今天收益率为负，就空仓；其余情况保持昨天的仓位。

paragraphs.en: That is the whole rule. The strategy page mentions an ATR threshold, smaller positions in high volatility and a stop after a 10% drawdown; the code has none of them. It uses the standard deviation of returns, a fixed 100% position and no stop. It also exposes no parameters, so the walk-forward step used on the other strategies has nothing to choose here: every fold of the log on all ten markets uses the same empty configuration. All figures below are before trading costs, with a position decided at the close of day t earning the return of day t+1.
paragraphs.zh: 规则就是这些。策略页面提到了 ATR 阈值、高波动时缩小仓位和回撤 10% 后停止交易，但代码里一样都没有：它用的是收益率标准差，固定满仓，没有止损。它也没有可调参数，所以其他策略使用的滚动前推步骤在这里无事可做：十个市场的日志里每一折用的都是同一个空配置。以下所有数字均未扣交易成本，收盘时决定的仓位获得下一个交易日的收益。

paragraphs.en: Because any down day switches the strategy off, it is almost never invested. Averaged over the ten markets for the full history, it held a position on 12.4% of days. The average holding period was 2.1 days, 47% of all holds lasted a single day and the longest was 11 days.
paragraphs.zh: 因为任何一个下跌日都会让策略离场，它几乎总是空仓。在十个市场的完整历史上取平均，它只有 12.4% 的交易日持仓。平均持仓 2.1 天，47% 的持仓只持续了一天，最长的一次是 11 天。

paragraphs.en: The implied bet is that a big up day is followed by another non-negative day. The data are mixed. On US stocks there were 320 trigger days, and the next day was up 51.9% of the time, against 55.2% for all days; the average next-day return was -0.10%, against +0.06% for all days. On silver the average next day after a trigger was +0.29% (all days +0.04%), on oil +0.25% (all days +0.01%), and on natural gas -0.34% (all days -0.07%). Follow-through depends on the market, and it was not there on US stocks.
paragraphs.zh: 它隐含的赌注是：大涨之后的下一天不会下跌。数据的结论并不一致。美股上共有 320 个触发日，下一天上涨的比例为 51.9%，而所有交易日为 55.2%；触发后次日平均收益为 -0.10%，所有交易日为 +0.06%。白银触发后次日平均 +0.29%（所有交易日 +0.04%），原油 +0.25%（所有交易日 +0.01%），天然气 -0.34%（所有交易日 -0.07%）。大涨之后有没有惯性取决于具体市场，在美股上没有。

paragraphs.en: Over the five years to 11 November 2026, and before costs, Volatility Breakout had a positive Sharpe ratio on 8 of 10 markets but beat the Sharpe ratio of simply holding on only two:
paragraphs.zh: 在截至 2026 年 11 月 11 日的五年里，未扣成本，波动率突破在 10 个市场中有 8 个夏普为正，但只在两个市场上夏普高于单纯持有：

en: **Silver:** 9.4% a year, Sharpe 0.78, maximum drawdown -15.1%, against 14.8%, 0.56 and -57.8% for holding.
**Ether:** 7.1% a year, Sharpe 0.34, maximum drawdown -36.6%, while holding lost 15.4% a year with a -79.0% drawdown.
**US stocks:** 1.1% a year, Sharpe 0.21, drawdown -10.1%, against 11.9%, 0.74 and -24.5%.
**Natural gas:** -21.7% a year, Sharpe -0.79, drawdown -80.0%, although holding did worse (-31.6% a year).

paragraphs.en: The drawdown was smaller than holding's on all 10 markets, but that is largely arithmetic: a strategy that is invested one day in eight cannot lose much in a fall. Over the full period (since January 2010 for US stocks, September 2014 for bitcoin and November 2017 for ether) it beat holding's Sharpe on 5 of 10 markets. Ether returned 22.8% a year with a -37.8% drawdown, level with holding's 22.9% but with a -94.0% drawdown for the holder; bitcoin returned 17.1% a year against 52.0% for holding.
paragraphs.zh: 10 个市场的最大回撤都比持有小，但这在很大程度上只是算术问题：一个八天里只有一天持仓的策略，在下跌中本来就亏不了多少。看完整历史（美股自 2010 年 1 月，比特币自 2014 年 9 月，以太坊自 2017 年 11 月），它的夏普在 10 个市场中有 5 个高于持有。以太坊年化 22.8%，回撤 -37.8%，与持有的 22.9% 持平，但持有者要承受 -94.0% 的回撤；比特币年化 17.1%，持有则是 52.0%。

heading.en: A bad stretch, and a good one
heading.zh: 最糟的一段，和最好的一段

paragraphs.en: The worst stretch was natural gas. From the peak on 18 April 2022 to the trough on 11 August 2026 the strategy fell 80.0%; holding the fund over the same dates fell 90.7%. It was invested on only 101 of those 1,083 trading days, consistent with an average next-day return of -0.34% after a trigger on this market.
paragraphs.zh: 最糟的一段是天然气。从 2022 年 4 月 18 日的高点到 2026 年 8 月 11 日的低点，策略下跌 80.0%；同一时期持有这只基金下跌 90.7%。在这 1,083 个交易日里它只有 101 天持仓，这与它在该市场触发后次日平均 -0.34% 的表现一致。

paragraphs.en: The best stretch for its drawdown profile was 2022 (3 January to 12 October). US stocks fell 24.5% and Volatility Breakout gained 0.3%. On bitcoin it lost 16.4% while holding lost 58.8%, and on ether it gained 15.6% while holding lost 65.6%. The same flatness cost it in rising markets: on oil it made 5.3% while holding made 29.4%, and on natural gas 8.5% against 73.1%.
paragraphs.zh: 回撤表现最好的一段是 2022 年（1 月 3 日到 10 月 12 日）。美股下跌 24.5%，波动率突破上涨 0.3%。比特币上它亏损 16.4%，持有亏损 58.8%；以太坊上它上涨 15.6%，持有亏损 65.6%。同样的空仓也让它错过了上涨：原油上它赚了 5.3%，持有赚了 29.4%；天然气上是 8.5% 对 73.1%。

heading.en: Keltner Channel Breakout, the slower relative
heading.zh: 肯特纳通道突破，更慢的对照

paragraphs.en: Keltner Channel Breakout (KC-01) works on a different timescale. It builds a channel from an exponential moving average of the close, plus and minus 2.0 times the average true range. It goes long when the close is above the upper band and exits when the close falls below the middle line (or below the lower band). It is long only. In the walk-forward test the moving-average and ATR lengths were chosen from 16, 20 and 24 days; the multiplier stayed at 2.0.
paragraphs.zh: 肯特纳通道突破（KC-01）的时间尺度不同。它用收盘价的指数移动平均线加减 2.0 倍平均真实波幅构造通道，收盘价高于上轨时做多，跌破中线（或下轨）时离场，只做多。在滚动前推测试中，均线和 ATR 的周期在 16、20、24 天中选择，倍数固定为 2.0。

paragraphs.en: The two behave very differently. Averaged over the ten markets, KC-01 was invested 26% of days over five years against 12% for VOL-01, and made 44 trades per market against 166 (the site counts each entry and each exit as a trade). On Sharpe ratio the quick rule was ahead on 6 of 10 markets over five years, and the slow one on 6 of 10 over the full history (VOL-01 led on 4). KC-01 beat holding's Sharpe on 7 markets over the full period, against 5 for VOL-01.
paragraphs.zh: 两者表现差异很大。在十个市场上平均，近五年 KC-01 有 26% 的交易日持仓，VOL-01 为 12%；每个市场的交易次数分别是 44 次和 166 次（网站把每次入场和每次离场各算一笔）。夏普方面，近五年快的规则在 10 个市场中有 6 个领先，而完整历史上慢的规则领先 6 个（VOL-01 领先 4 个）。完整区间内，KC-01 在 7 个市场上夏普高于持有，VOL-01 为 5 个。

paragraphs.en: On bitcoin KC-01 made 14.6% a year over five years, with a -32.9% drawdown, against 2.6% and -75.9% for holding; over the full period it made 53.8% a year with a Sharpe ratio of 1.13 and a -45.5% drawdown. On US stocks it made 4.5% a year with an 8.5% drawdown (Sharpe 0.69). It is not a safe harbour: its drawdown was not smaller than holding's on oil, broad commodities or agriculture, and in 2022 it lost 24.2% on natural gas while holding gained 73.1%.
paragraphs.zh: 比特币上，KC-01 近五年年化 14.6%，回撤 -32.9%，持有为 2.6% 和 -75.9%；完整区间年化 53.8%，夏普 1.13，回撤 -45.5%。美股上它年化 4.5%，回撤 8.5%（夏普 0.69）。但它并非避风港：在原油、综合大宗商品和农产品上它的回撤并不比持有小，2022 年在天然气上亏损 24.2%，持有却赚了 73.1%。

heading.en: What the numbers cannot tell you
heading.zh: 这些数字说明不了什么

paragraphs.en: The most important caveat is cost. The site's cost-drag estimate assumes 10 basis points per unit of turnover. On US stocks that comes to 3.1% a year for VOL-01, more than its 1.1% return, against 0.7% for KC-01. A strategy that makes 166 trades per market in five years, on average, needs a large edge per trade, and these results do not include that cost.
paragraphs.zh: 最重要的限制是成本。网站的成本拖累估算假设每单位换手 10 个基点。在美股上，这相当于 VOL-01 每年 3.1%，比它 1.1% 的收益还高，而 KC-01 为 0.7%。平均每个市场五年交易 166 次的策略，每笔交易都需要有足够大的优势，而这些结果没有扣除这部分成本。

paragraphs.en: Statistical confidence is also thin. The probabilistic Sharpe ratio (the chance that the true Sharpe is above zero) was 0.97 for VOL-01 on silver and 0.83 on ether. After adjusting for how many strategies the site compares, the deflated Sharpe ratio fell to 0.55 and 0.27. The best-looking results are small samples of a strategy that is mostly in cash, and a different five-year window could rank the markets differently.
paragraphs.zh: 统计上的把握同样不足。概率夏普比率（真实夏普大于零的概率）在白银上为 0.97，以太坊上为 0.83；按网站比较的策略数量做调整后，折算夏普比率降到 0.55 和 0.27。最亮眼的结果来自一个大部分时间空仓的策略的小样本，换一个五年窗口，市场的排序可能就不同了。

en: Volatility Breakout (VOL-01) is a one-to-two-day bet on follow-through after a big up day; it was invested on about 12% of days and held 2.1 days on average.
Its low drawdown mostly reflects being out of the market, not skill at avoiding losses: it also gave up the strong rallies of 2022.
Follow-through after a big up day is market-specific: positive on silver and oil, negative on US stocks and natural gas.
Keltner Channel Breakout (KC-01) is slower, trades about a quarter as often and did better on bitcoin, but its drawdown protection is less consistent.
Trading costs would erase much of the quicker rule's return; check the cost assumption before drawing conclusions.
zh: 波动率突破（VOL-01）是押大涨之后一两天惯性的策略；约 12% 的交易日持仓，平均持有 2.1 天。
它回撤小，主要是因为大部分时间在场外，而不是擅长躲开亏损：2022 年的大幅上涨它同样错过了。
大涨之后的惯性因市场而异：白银和原油为正，美股和天然气为负。
肯特纳通道突破（KC-01）更慢，交易次数约为前者的四分之一，在比特币上表现更好，但回撤保护不够稳定。
交易成本会吃掉快规则的大部分收益；下结论之前先看成本假设。

title.en: Donchian 55/20 vs Turtle 20/10: A Ten-Market Backtest
title.zh: Donchian 55/20 对比 Turtle 20/10：十个市场回测

summary.en: Before trading costs, the slow Donchian Breakout (TREND-02, 55-day high in, 20-day low out) made 774 entries across ten markets against 1,979 for Turtle Trading (TURTLE-01, 20/10), and had the higher full-period Sharpe ratio on seven of the ten markets (mean 0.38 vs 0.34). Over the last five years the gap was wider: 0.41 vs 0.21.
summary.zh: 在未扣交易成本的前提下，较慢的 Donchian Breakout（TREND-02，突破 55 日高点入场、跌破 20 日低点离场）在十个市场共入场 774 次，Turtle Trading（TURTLE-01，20/10）为 1,979 次；完整区间里 Donchian 在 10 个市场中有 7 个夏普更高（平均 0.38 对 0.34）。近五年差距更大：0.41 对 0.21。

heading.en: The two rules, from the code

paragraphs.en: **Donchian Breakout (TREND-02)** goes long when the close is above the highest close of the previous 55 days, and goes to cash when the close is below the lowest close of the previous 20 days. Between the two signals it holds whatever it held before. **Turtle Trading (TURTLE-01)** is the same logic with entry and exit windows of 20 and 10 days.
paragraphs.zh: **Donchian Breakout（TREND-02）**在收盘价高于前 55 天最高收盘价时做多，在收盘价低于前 20 天最低收盘价时转为现金。两个信号之间保持原有仓位。**Turtle Trading（TURTLE-01）**逻辑相同，只是入场和离场窗口分别为 20 天和 10 天。

paragraphs.en: Three things worth knowing from the code. Both are long only. Both use closing prices only, not intraday highs and lows. And neither has the ATR position sizing or stops mentioned in the strategy descriptions: the code is simply 100% invested or 0%. Donchian has no adjustable settings, so it runs the same 55/20 throughout. Turtle's windows are re-chosen every six months from a grid around 20 and 10 (entry 16 to 24, exit 8 to 12), after an initial three years on 20/10.
paragraphs.zh: 从代码看有三点值得注意。两者都只做多；都只使用收盘价，不用日内最高最低价；也都没有策略描述里提到的 ATR 仓位管理或止损：代码只是 100% 持仓或空仓。Donchian 没有可调参数，始终使用 55/20。Turtle 的窗口每六个月在 20 和 10 附近的一组参数里重新挑选（入场 16 到 24，离场 8 到 12），最初三年使用 20/10。

paragraphs.en: Results are before trading costs, for the last five years to 2026-11-11 and for the full period (2010-01-04 for most markets, 2014-09-17 for bitcoin, 2017-11-09 for ether).
paragraphs.zh: 结果均未扣交易成本，统计近五年（截至 2026-11-11）和完整区间（多数市场从 2010-01-04 起，比特币 2014-09-17，以太坊 2017-11-09）。

paragraphs.en: Each line gives CAGR / Sharpe / maximum drawdown for the last five years, then the full period, for Donchian and then Turtle, followed by the share of days in the market for each.
paragraphs.zh: 每行依次为年化收益 / 夏普 / 最大回撤，先是近五年，再是完整区间，先 Donchian 后 Turtle，最后是两者的持仓天数占比。

paragraphs.en: Donchian's best market was broad commodities over five years (Sharpe 0.79) and bitcoin over the full period (0.98). Its worst was natural gas over five years and EUR/USD over the full period. Turtle's best were US stocks over five years (0.63 Sharpe, only a 13.3% drawdown) and bitcoin over the full period (1.05); its worst was natural gas on both windows (−13.6% a year and a 91.6% drawdown over the full period).
paragraphs.zh: Donchian 最好的市场，近五年是综合大宗商品（夏普 0.79），完整区间是比特币（0.98）；最差的是近五年的天然气和完整区间的欧元/美元。Turtle 最好的是近五年的美股（夏普 0.63，回撤仅 13.3%）和完整区间的比特币（1.05）；最差的是天然气，两个窗口皆然（完整区间年化 −13.6%，回撤 91.6%）。

paragraphs.en: Donchian had the higher five-year Sharpe on eight of ten markets (mean 0.41 vs 0.21) and the shallower drawdown on eight (mean −28.5% vs −37.3%). Over the full period those counts were seven and seven, and the means 0.38 vs 0.34 and −38.8% vs −43.7%. Turtle's wins were on US stocks, bitcoin and ether over the full period. Eight markets had a positive annual return for Donchian on both windows; for Turtle it was seven over five years and eight over the full period.
paragraphs.zh: 近五年 Donchian 夏普在 10 个市场中有 8 个更高（平均 0.41 对 0.21），回撤有 8 个更浅（平均 −28.5% 对 −37.3%）。完整区间这两个数字都是 7 个，平均分别为 0.38 对 0.34 和 −38.8% 对 −43.7%。Turtle 在完整区间的胜场是美股、比特币和以太坊。Donchian 在两个窗口里都有 8 个市场年化为正；Turtle 近五年为 7 个，完整区间为 8 个。

paragraphs.en: The slow rule spends much less time invested. Donchian was in the market on a median 33% of days (range 20% to 54%) against Turtle's 38% (32% to 55%). Dividing days in the market by entries gives roughly 17.7 days per holding for Donchian and 8.3 for Turtle on average. On a given day they agree on being in or out a median 77% of the time.
paragraphs.zh: 慢速规则的持仓时间明显更少。Donchian 的持仓天数占比中位数为 33%（范围 20% 到 54%），Turtle 为 38%（32% 到 55%）。用持仓天数除以入场次数，平均每次持仓大约 Donchian 17.7 天，Turtle 8.3 天。两者在“持仓还是空仓”上，中位数有 77% 的交易日一致。

paragraphs.en: The two systems also differ in how they behave once a trend ends. A 20-day exit stays in a falling market for a long time, while a 10-day exit gets out sooner, at the price of more whipsaw.
paragraphs.zh: 两个系统在趋势结束后的表现也不同。20 日离场在下跌的市场里会停留很久，10 日离场则出场更早，代价是更多的来回折腾。

heading.en: The worst calendar year in each market
heading.zh: 每个市场的最差日历年

paragraphs.en: In each market's worst full calendar year, both beat the market in every case, and the market fell an average of 42.8% in those years. Donchian averaged −10.2% and lost money in nine of ten; Turtle averaged −3.3% and lost money in seven of ten.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个市场自己最差的完整日历年里，两者无一例外都跑赢了市场，这些年份里市场平均下跌 42.8%。Donchian 平均为 −10.2%，10 个中有 9 个亏损；Turtle 平均为 −3.3%，10 个中有 7 个亏损。

paragraphs.en: US stocks in 2022 shows the exit speed. The market fell 18.2%. Donchian was invested on only 14% of days that year and still lost 12.3%; Turtle, invested on 38% of days, lost 5.6%. Gold in 2013 (−28.3%) cost Donchian 5.7% and Turtle 4.5%, with Donchian in the market on 5% of days. Oil in 2020 (−67.8%) was good for both: Donchian gained 7.8% and Turtle 34.0%. Natural gas in 2023 (−64.0%) was not: −25.6% and −49.4%. On ether in 2018 (−82.4%), Turtle gained 39.3% while Donchian lost 21.0%; that year falls in the default-settings period of Turtle's walk-forward run.
paragraphs.zh: 2022 年的美股说明了离场速度的差别。市场下跌 18.2%，Donchian 那一年只有 14% 的交易日持仓，却仍亏了 12.3%；Turtle 持仓 38% 的交易日，亏 5.6%。2013 年的黄金（−28.3%）让 Donchian 亏 5.7%，Turtle 亏 4.5%，Donchian 当年只有 5% 的交易日持仓。2020 年的原油（−67.8%）对两者都有利：Donchian 盈利 7.8%，Turtle 盈利 34.0%。2023 年的天然气（−64.0%）则不然：−25.6% 和 −49.4%。2018 年的以太坊（−82.4%），Turtle 盈利 39.3%，Donchian 亏 21.0%；那一年处于 Turtle 滚动前推的默认参数阶段。

paragraphs.en: Breakouts need price to make a new high before they act. In a market that drifts, they buy near the top of a range and sell near the bottom of the next. EUR/USD shows it: neither system had a positive annual return over the full period (−0.9% and −1.3%), and natural gas lost money on both windows for both.
paragraphs.zh: 突破策略要等价格创出新高才行动。在来回漂移的市场里，它们在区间上沿附近买入，在下一个区间的下沿附近卖出。欧元/美元就是例子：完整区间两个系统年化都不是正的（−0.9% 和 −1.3%），天然气在两个窗口里两者也都亏钱。

paragraphs.en: The numbers also leave things out. Turtle made 1,979 entries and Donchian 774, and no trading costs are included. A long-only version also says nothing about the short side that the original Turtle system traded. Bitcoin and ether results come from short histories, so they rest on few market cycles.
paragraphs.zh: 这些数字也有遗漏。Turtle 入场 1,979 次，Donchian 774 次，而结果不含任何交易成本。只做多的版本也说明不了原始海龟系统交易的空头那一侧。比特币和以太坊的结果来自较短的历史，所以只覆盖很少的市场周期。

en: The slower 55/20 rule held up better than 20/10 on risk-adjusted terms on most markets, and traded about 39% as often (774 vs 1,979 entries).
Turtle's faster exit limited the damage in US stocks in 2022 and in oil in 2020, but did worse in natural gas in 2023 and EUR/USD in 2014.
Both are far less than fully invested (medians 33% and 38% of days), so they trail a rising market in return terms.
Neither adds position sizing or stops: the backtest is a plain in-or-out system, before trading costs.
zh: 较慢的 55/20 规则在大多数市场上风险调整后表现好于 20/10，而且交易次数只有后者的大约 39%（774 次对 1,979 次）。
Turtle 更快的离场在 2022 年美股和 2020 年原油上限制了损失，但在 2023 年的天然气和 2014 年的欧元/美元上表现更差。
两者都远非满仓（持仓天数中位数 33% 和 38%），所以在上涨市场里收益上会落后。
两者都没有仓位管理或止损：回测只是一个简单的“持仓或空仓”系统，且未扣交易成本。

title.en: Supertrend vs ATR Trailing Stop vs Chandelier Exit: Backtested
title.zh: Supertrend、ATR 移动止损与 Chandelier Exit 回测对比

summary.en: Supertrend (SUPER-01), the ATR trailing stop (RISK-04) and Chandelier Exit (TREND-17) ended with almost the same average full-period Sharpe ratio (0.38, 0.41 and 0.40) before trading costs, but they entered the market 1,973, 4,852 and 8,320 times. Much of the difference is how quickly each one re-enters after an exit.
summary.zh: 在未扣交易成本的前提下，Supertrend（SUPER-01）、ATR 移动止损（RISK-04）和 Chandelier Exit（TREND-17）完整区间的平均夏普几乎一样（0.38、0.41 和 0.40），但入场次数分别是 1,973、4,852 和 8,320 次。差别很大程度上在于它们离场后重新入场的速度。

paragraphs.en: All three follow a price with a stop set a few average daily ranges below it, and leave the market when the close falls through. All three are long only here: when stopped out they hold cash, not a short. Results are before trading costs, for the last five years to 2026-11-11 and the full period (2010-01-04 for most markets, 2014-09-17 for bitcoin, 2017-11-09 for ether).
paragraphs.zh: 三者都是跟随价格，在价格下方若干个平均日波幅处放一条止损线，收盘跌破就离场。在本站三者都只做多：被止损后持有现金，而不是做空。结果均未扣交易成本，统计近五年（截至 2026-11-11）和完整区间（多数市场从 2010-01-04 起，比特币 2014-09-17，以太坊 2017-11-09）。

paragraphs.en: The differences are in the details. They decide how often each one trades.
paragraphs.zh: 区别在细节里，而细节决定了它们交易的频率。

heading.zh: 每条规则实际做了什么

paragraphs.en: **Supertrend (SUPER-01)** reads real daily highs, lows and closes. It builds a band around the day's midpoint, 2.5 times a smoothed average true range (exponential average, span 10). The lower band can only rise. The system leaves when the close drops below it and comes back only when the close breaks above the upper band.
paragraphs.zh: **Supertrend（SUPER-01）**使用真实的日最高价、最低价和收盘价。它围绕当天的中价建立通道，宽度为平滑后平均真实波幅（指数平均，跨度 10）的 2.5 倍。下轨只升不降。收盘跌破下轨离场，收盘突破上轨才重新入场。

paragraphs.en: **ATR trailing stop (RISK-04)** enters whenever the close is above its 20-day average. The stop is the highest close since entry minus 2.5 times "ATR", and it only moves up. The code's ATR is a close-to-close version: the 14-day simple average of the absolute change from one close to the next, with no highs, lows or gaps. A day's true range is never smaller than that move, so this version measures a smaller range and the stop tends to sit tighter. After an exit it can re-enter the next day if the close is back above the average.
paragraphs.zh: **ATR 移动止损（RISK-04）**只要收盘价高于 20 日均线就入场。止损价为入场后最高收盘价减去 2.5 倍“ATR”，并且只上移不下移。代码里的 ATR 是收盘到收盘的版本：相邻两个收盘价之差绝对值的 14 日简单平均，不含最高价、最低价和跳空。某一天的真实波幅不会小于这个涨跌幅，所以这个版本衡量出的波幅更小，止损线往往也更近。离场后，只要收盘价重新站上均线，第二天就可以再入场。

paragraphs.en: **Chandelier Exit (TREND-17)** uses the same close-to-close ATR over 22 days. The stop is the 22-day highest close minus 3 times that ATR. It re-enters when the close rises above the 22-day lowest close plus 3 ATR, a low bar, which fits its 8,320 entries.
paragraphs.zh: **Chandelier Exit（TREND-17）**同样使用 22 日的收盘到收盘 ATR。止损价为 22 日最高收盘价减去 3 倍该 ATR。当收盘价升到 22 日最低收盘价加 3 倍 ATR 之上时重新入场，门槛很低，这与它 8,320 次入场相符。

paragraphs.en: Each line gives CAGR / Sharpe / maximum drawdown, for the last five years and then the full period, for Supertrend and the ATR stop, with the share of days in the market.
paragraphs.zh: 每行依次为年化收益 / 夏普 / 最大回撤，先是近五年，再是完整区间，分别给出 Supertrend 和 ATR 止损，最后是持仓天数占比。

heading.en: Best, worst and the three-way tally

paragraphs.en: Supertrend's best market was gold over five years and ether over the full period (Sharpe 1.00); its worst were EUR/USD over five years and natural gas over the full period (−15.3% a year, −94.2% drawdown). The ATR stop's best were gold over five years and bitcoin over the full period (Sharpe 1.09); its worst were natural gas and EUR/USD respectively. Supertrend had a positive annual return on eight markets over five years and seven over the full period; the ATR stop on nine and eight.
paragraphs.zh: Supertrend 表现最好的市场，近五年是黄金，完整区间是以太坊（夏普 1.00）；最差的是近五年的欧元/美元和完整区间的天然气（年化 −15.3%，回撤 −94.2%）。ATR 止损最好的是近五年的黄金和完整区间的比特币（夏普 1.09），最差的分别是天然气和欧元/美元。Supertrend 近五年有 8 个市场年化为正，完整区间有 7 个；ATR 止损分别是 9 个和 8 个。

paragraphs.en: Head to head, the ATR stop had the higher five-year Sharpe on eight of ten markets (mean 0.38 vs 0.25), but over the full period the gap shrank to 0.41 vs 0.38, with Supertrend ahead on four. Supertrend's edge was drawdown: shallower on nine of ten markets over the full period (mean −43.2% vs −48.1%). Chandelier had a five-year mean Sharpe of 0.42 and a full-period mean of 0.40.
paragraphs.zh: 直接对比，ATR 止损近五年夏普在 10 个市场中有 8 个更高（平均 0.38 对 0.25），但完整区间差距缩小到 0.41 对 0.38，Supertrend 在 4 个市场领先。Supertrend 的优势是回撤：完整区间有 9 个市场更浅（平均 −43.2% 对 −48.1%）。Chandelier 近五年平均夏普 0.42，完整区间平均 0.40。

heading.en: Why the trade counts differ so much
heading.zh: 为什么交易次数差这么多

paragraphs.en: Across the ten markets, entries since 2010 were 1,973 for Supertrend, 4,852 for the ATR stop and 8,320 for Chandelier. Dividing days in the market by entries gives roughly 10.9 days per holding for Supertrend, 4.8 for the ATR stop and 2.7 for Chandelier on average. On gold, Chandelier made 954 entries.
paragraphs.zh: 10 个市场自 2010 年以来的入场次数：Supertrend 为 1,973，ATR 止损为 4,852，Chandelier 为 8,320。用持仓天数除以入场次数，平均每次持仓大约 Supertrend 10.9 天、ATR 止损 4.8 天、Chandelier 2.7 天。仅黄金一个市场，Chandelier 就入场了 954 次。

paragraphs.en: The reason is the re-entry rule. Supertrend needs a close above a band that sits 2.5 ATR above the midpoint. The other two re-enter on a lower bar, so a stop-out is often followed by another entry within days. On a given day Supertrend and the ATR stop agree on being in or out a median 81% of the time; the ATR stop and Chandelier agree 87%.
paragraphs.zh: 原因在于重新入场的规则。Supertrend 需要收盘价突破一条位于中价上方 2.5 倍 ATR 的通道；另外两个重新入场的门槛更低，所以止损之后几天内再次入场很常见。Supertrend 与 ATR 止损在“持仓还是空仓”上，中位数有 81% 的交易日一致；ATR 止损和 Chandelier 的一致比例是 87%。

heading.en: The worst calendar year in each market
heading.zh: 每个市场的最差日历年

paragraphs.en: In each market's worst full calendar year, all three beat the market in every case; the average market fell 42.8% in those years against average results of −10.0% for Supertrend, −15.9% for the ATR stop and −3.0% for Chandelier. On US stocks in 2022, when the market fell 18.2%, they lost 5.1%, 4.6% and 2.8%.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个市场自己最差的完整日历年里，三者无一例外都跑赢了市场；这些年份里市场平均下跌 42.8%，而 Supertrend、ATR 止损和 Chandelier 的平均结果分别是 −10.0%、−15.9% 和 −3.0%。美股 2022 年市场下跌 18.2%，三者分别亏 5.1%、4.6% 和 2.8%。

paragraphs.en: Oil in 2020 (−67.8%) shows the spread: the ATR stop gained 2.4%, Chandelier 12.4% and Supertrend lost 28.2%. Natural gas in 2023 (−64.0%) hurt all three: −42.7%, −52.3% and −17.4%. Ether in 2018 (−82.4%) is the odd one: Supertrend gained 47.8% and Chandelier 40.8%, while the ATR stop lost 38.2%. That year falls in each market's first three years, which use default parameters, and Supertrend's gain includes 30.3% in January alone.
paragraphs.zh: 2020 年的原油（−67.8%）展示了差距：ATR 止损盈利 2.4%，Chandelier 盈利 12.4%，Supertrend 却亏 28.2%。2023 年的天然气（−64.0%）对三者都不友好：−42.7%、−52.3% 和 −17.4%。2018 年的以太坊（−82.4%）最特别：Supertrend 盈利 47.8%，Chandelier 盈利 40.8%，ATR 止损却亏 38.2%。这一年处于每个市场前三年的默认参数阶段，且 Supertrend 的收益中仅 1 月份就有 30.3%。

heading.en: What the numbers cannot tell you
heading.zh: 这些数字说明不了什么

paragraphs.en: Costs are the first caveat. The ATR stop and Chandelier trade far more often than Supertrend (4,852 and 8,320 entries against 1,973), and none of that friction is in these results. Average holdings of 4.8 and 2.7 days also mean these two behave less like trailing a trend and more like a fast filter.
paragraphs.zh: 首先是成本。ATR 止损和 Chandelier 的交易远比 Supertrend 频繁（入场 4,852 次和 8,320 次，对比 1,973 次），而这些摩擦都不在结果里。平均持仓 4.8 天和 2.7 天，也意味着这两个更像快速过滤器，而不是跟随趋势。

paragraphs.en: The second is that three very similar-looking results on average can hide large differences by market, and bitcoin and ether have short histories, starting 2014-09-17 and 2017-11-09. None of this is a promise of what the next stretch will show.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，三个看上去平均水平非常接近的结果，在不同市场上可能差别很大；比特币和以太坊的历史也不长，分别始于 2014-09-17 和 2017-11-09。这些都不能保证下一段行情会怎样。

en: Average Sharpe was nearly identical across the three stops; the differences are in trading frequency and drawdown.
Supertrend traded least and had a shallower full-period drawdown than the ATR stop on nine of ten markets.
The ATR stop's "ATR" is a close-to-close version, which makes its stop tighter and its trading faster.
All three cut the loss in each market's worst calendar year, but still lost money in most of them.
zh: 三种止损的平均夏普几乎一样，差别在于交易频率和回撤。
Supertrend 交易最少，完整区间回撤在 10 个市场中有 9 个比 ATR 止损更浅。
ATR 止损里的“ATR”是收盘到收盘的版本，所以它的止损线更近、交易更快。
三者在各市场最差日历年里都减少了亏损，但多数情况下仍然亏钱。

title.zh: Supertrend 带与翻转

caption.en: ATR based bands trail price and flip when the trend changes.
caption.zh: 基于 ATR 的带状结构跟随价格，并在趋势变化时翻转。

title.en: Ichimoku Cloud vs a 50/200 Moving Average: Ten-Market Test
title.zh: Ichimoku 云图对比 50/200 均线：十个市场回测

summary.en: Before trading costs, the Ichimoku Cloud (TREND-10) as coded here had a higher full-period Sharpe ratio than the 50/200 Dual Moving Average (TREND-05) on six of ten markets and a shallower maximum drawdown on eight (mean −39.4% vs −50.4%), but it made 1,460 entries against 218.
summary.zh: 在未扣交易成本的前提下，按本站代码实现的 Ichimoku Cloud（TREND-10）在完整区间里 10 个市场中有 6 个夏普高于 50/200 双均线（TREND-05），8 个的最大回撤更浅（平均 −39.4% 对 −50.4%），但入场次数为 1,460 次，双均线只有 218 次。

paragraphs.en: Ichimoku Kinko Hyo was devised by Goichi Hosoda in 1930s Japan and is normally drawn from daily highs, lows and closes. The version on this site uses closes only: every "high" and "low" in the formulas is replaced by the close. The Tenkan line is therefore the midpoint of the highest and lowest close of the last 9 days, the Kijun line the same over 26 days, and the two cloud edges are built from the Tenkan/Kijun midpoint and from the 52-day midpoint, both shifted 26 days forward.
paragraphs.zh: 一目均衡表（Ichimoku Kinko Hyo）由细田悟一（Goichi Hosoda）在 1930 年代的日本提出，通常基于日最高价、最低价和收盘价绘制。本站的版本只使用收盘价：公式里所有的“最高价”和“最低价”都被收盘价替代。因此转换线（Tenkan）是最近 9 天最高收盘价与最低收盘价的中点，基准线（Kijun）是 26 天的同样计算，云图的两条边分别由转换线和基准线的中点、以及 52 天中点构成，并且都向前平移 26 天。

paragraphs.en: The rule: go long when the close is above the top of the cloud and Tenkan is above Kijun. Go to cash when the close falls below the bottom of the cloud or Tenkan is no longer above Kijun. If the close is inside the cloud with Tenkan above Kijun, it keeps its previous position. The Chikou (lagging) line is computed but not used, and it is long only. The first 78 days are flat while the lines warm up.
paragraphs.zh: 规则是：收盘价在云图上沿之上且转换线高于基准线时做多；收盘价跌到云图下沿之下，或转换线不再高于基准线时转为现金；如果收盘价在云图之内而转换线仍高于基准线，则维持原有仓位。滞后线（Chikou）虽然被计算出来，但没有使用，策略只做多。最初 78 天用于指标预热，保持空仓。

paragraphs.en: The 9 and 26 are re-chosen every six months from a grid around them (Tenkan 7 to 11, Kijun 21 to 31), after an initial three years on the defaults. Results are before trading costs, for the last five years to 2026-11-11 and for the full period (2010-01-04 for most markets, 2014-09-17 for bitcoin, 2017-11-09 for ether).
paragraphs.zh: 9 和 26 每六个月在其附近的一组参数里重新挑选（转换线 7 到 11，基准线 21 到 31），最初三年使用默认值。结果均未扣交易成本，统计近五年（截至 2026-11-11）和完整区间（多数市场从 2010-01-04 起，比特币 2014-09-17，以太坊 2017-11-09）。

paragraphs.en: Each line gives CAGR / Sharpe / maximum drawdown for the last five years, then the full period, and the share of days in the market (days with a non-zero return).
paragraphs.zh: 每行依次为年化收益 / 夏普 / 最大回撤，先是近五年，再是完整区间，以及持仓天数占比（收益非零的天数）。

en: **US stocks:** 6.3% / 0.71 / −9.7%; full 6.1% / 0.68 / −15.1%. In the market 60% of days.

paragraphs.en: Gold was the best market over five years (Sharpe 0.90, drawdown 13.9%) and bitcoin over the full period (1.11, at a 48.5% drawdown). Natural gas was the worst on both windows: −15.9% a year over five years and −11.6% with an 88.1% drawdown over the full period. Nine markets had a positive annual return over five years and eight over the full period.
paragraphs.zh: 黄金是近五年表现最好的市场（夏普 0.90，回撤 13.9%），比特币是完整区间最好的（1.11，回撤 48.5%）。天然气在两个窗口中都最差：近五年年化 −15.9%，完整区间年化 −11.6%，回撤 88.1%。近五年有 9 个市场年化为正，完整区间有 8 个。

paragraphs.en: The system was invested on a median 37% of days (range 24% to 60%). On US stocks, where a buy-and-hold investor is always in, it was in the market 60% of days with a 15.1% full-period drawdown.
paragraphs.zh: 系统的持仓天数占比中位数为 37%（范围 24% 到 60%）。美股上，买入持有者始终在场，而它只有 60% 的交易日持仓，完整区间回撤为 15.1%。

heading.en: The worst calendar year in each market
heading.zh: 每个市场的最差日历年

paragraphs.en: In each market's worst full calendar year the system lost less than the market in all ten, and lost money in nine. The market fell an average of 42.8% in those years; Ichimoku averaged −6.1%.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个市场自己最差的完整日历年里，系统在 10 个市场中全部亏得比市场少，其中 9 个仍然亏损。这些年份里市场平均下跌 42.8%，Ichimoku 平均为 −6.1%。

paragraphs.en: The cases: US stocks in 2022, market −18.2%, Ichimoku −5.9% (in the market on 26% of days). Gold in 2013 (−28.3%): −4.6%, in the market 9% of days. Silver in 2013 (−36.3%): −1.9%. Oil in 2020 (−67.8%): a gain of 3.8%. Bitcoin in 2018 (−73.6%): −26.0%, in the market 10% of days. Natural gas in 2023 (−64.0%) cost it 16.6%. Ether's 2018 (−82.4%) cost only 5.0%, but that year sits inside the first three years of the history, and the system needed 78 days of warm-up.

Dual Moving Average (TREND-05) goes long when the 50-day average is above the 200-day, and is in cash otherwise. It has no other filter in the code, despite its description, and no adjustable settings. It is far slower: 218 entries across ten markets against Ichimoku's 1,460, about 101.3 days per holding on average against 11.0. It was in the market on a median 48% of days (24% to 80%). On a given day the two agree on being in or out a median 62% of the time.
paragraphs.zh: 双均线（Dual Moving Average，TREND-05）在 50 日均线高于 200 日均线时做多，否则空仓。尽管策略描述不止于此，代码里没有其他过滤条件，也没有可调参数。它慢得多：10 个市场共入场 218 次，Ichimoku 为 1,460 次；平均每次持仓约 101.3 天，Ichimoku 为 11.0 天。它的持仓天数占比中位数为 48%（24% 到 80%）。两者在“持仓还是空仓”上，中位数有 62% 的交易日一致。

paragraphs.en: Sharpe was close: Ichimoku was higher on six of ten markets in both windows, with means of 0.37 vs 0.35 over five years and 0.41 vs 0.34 over the full period. Ichimoku's edge was drawdown: shallower on seven markets over five years and eight over the full period. On US stocks, the moving average earned more (9.6% vs 6.3% over five years, 9.2% vs 6.1% over the full period) with a deeper drawdown (−33.7% vs −15.1% over the full period). Both are long only.
paragraphs.zh: 夏普相近：两个窗口里 Ichimoku 都在 10 个市场中的 6 个更高，平均值近五年为 0.37 对 0.35，完整区间为 0.41 对 0.34。Ichimoku 的优势在回撤：近五年有 7 个市场更浅，完整区间有 8 个。美股上，均线赚得更多（近五年 9.6% 对 6.3%，完整区间 9.2% 对 6.1%），但回撤更深（完整区间 −33.7% 对 −15.1%）。两者都只做多。

paragraphs.en: In their worst calendar years, Ichimoku did better on six of ten markets (mean −6.1% vs −10.0%). The moving average stayed entirely in cash in three: natural gas in 2023, agriculture in 2015 and ether in 2018, though ether's case is partly the 200 days of data it needs before it can signal. In bitcoin's 2018 it lost 51.3% against Ichimoku's 26.0%.
paragraphs.zh: 在各自最差的日历年里，Ichimoku 在 10 个市场中有 6 个表现更好（平均 −6.1% 对 −10.0%）。双均线有三次整年空仓：2023 年的天然气、2015 年的农产品和 2018 年的以太坊，不过以太坊这一例部分是因为它需要 200 天数据才能发出信号。2018 年比特币上它亏了 51.3%，Ichimoku 为 26.0%。

paragraphs.en: Replacing highs and lows with closes changes the indicator, so these results should not be read as a test of Ichimoku as usually drawn on a candlestick chart. Natural gas and EUR/USD show what a market without a lasting trend does to it: 148 and 158 entries, and negative annual returns over the full period (−11.6% and −1.0%).
paragraphs.zh: 用收盘价替代最高价和最低价改变了这个指标，所以这些结果不应被当作对蜡烛图上常见画法的 Ichimoku 的检验。天然气和欧元/美元显示了没有持续趋势的市场会怎样：分别入场 148 次和 158 次，完整区间年化收益为负（−11.6% 和 −1.0%）。

paragraphs.en: Costs matter here. The 1,460 entries are about 6.7 times the moving average's, and none of that is in the numbers. Bitcoin and ether histories are short, so their full-period figures rest on few cycles, and the first three years of each market run on default settings rather than walk-forward ones.
paragraphs.zh: 成本在这里很重要。1,460 次入场约是双均线的 6.7 倍，而这些都不在数字里。比特币和以太坊的历史较短，完整区间数字只覆盖很少的周期；每个市场的前三年也使用默认参数，而不是滚动前推的选择。

en: Coded on closes only, Ichimoku was a faster, shallower-drawdown relative of a 50/200 cross, not a different signal; both are long only.
It was in the market a median 37% of days and kept the worst calendar year to −6.1% on average, against −42.8% for the markets.
The simple 50/200 cross made about 15% as many entries and earned more on US stocks, at a deeper drawdown.
Natural gas and EUR/USD were the markets where neither system worked on the full period.
zh: 只用收盘价实现的 Ichimoku，是 50/200 交叉的一个更快、回撤更浅的近亲，而不是一个完全不同的信号；两者都只做多。
它的持仓天数占比中位数为 37%，各市场最差日历年的平均损失为 −6.1%，而市场本身是 −42.8%。
简单的 50/200 交叉的入场次数约为前者的 15%，在美股上赚得更多，但回撤更深。
天然气和欧元/美元是两个系统在完整区间都没能奏效的市场。

title.en: Does Buying When RSI Is Below 30 Work? A Ten-Market Backtest
title.zh: RSI 低于 30 就买入有效吗？10 个市场回测

summary.en: RSI Mean Reversion (MR-01) is long only on days when RSI is below 30; the code never holds a position until RSI recovers. That left it invested on 5.9% of days on US stocks over five years, with a 5.2% annual return and a 7.2% maximum drawdown, against 11.9% and 24.5% for holding.
summary.zh: RSI 均值回归（MR-01）只在 RSI 低于 30 的当天持有多头，代码里并不会一直持有到 RSI 回升。因此它近五年在美股上只有 5.9% 的交易日持仓，年化 5.2%，最大回撤 7.2%；持有的数字是 11.9% 和 24.5%。

paragraphs.en: RSI Mean Reversion (MR-01) computes a 14-day RSI from simple averages of the daily gains and losses. On any day when that RSI is below 30, the position for the next day is long, at 100%. On every other day the position is zero.
paragraphs.zh: RSI 均值回归（MR-01）用日涨跌幅的简单平均计算 14 日 RSI。只要某天的 RSI 低于 30，次日就持有 100% 多头；其余日子仓位为零。

paragraphs.en: The strategy page describes a different rule: buy when RSI is below 30 and volatility is low, then exit when RSI rises above 50. The code has no memory and no volatility filter. It does contain a line that sets the position to zero when RSI is above 50, but a day with RSI above 50 is already flat, so that line never changes anything. The strategy is therefore long only while RSI is still below 30, and it steps out as soon as RSI ticks back to 30 or higher. It has no parameters, so the walk-forward step has nothing to choose. All results here are before trading costs, and a position decided at the close of day t earns the return of day t+1.
paragraphs.zh: 策略页面描述的是另一套规则：RSI 低于 30 且波动率较低时买入，RSI 升到 50 以上再卖出。代码没有记忆，也没有波动率过滤。代码里确实有一行“RSI 高于 50 就把仓位设为零”，但 RSI 高于 50 的那天本来就空仓，这一行从未改变任何结果。所以策略只在 RSI 仍低于 30 时持仓，RSI 一回到 30 以上就离场。它没有可调参数，滚动前推无从选择。所有结果均未扣交易成本，收盘时决定的仓位获得下一个交易日的收益。

heading.en: How few days it is invested

paragraphs.en: On US stocks RSI was below 30 on only 4.6% of days over the full history. That produced 78 entries, averaging 2.5 days each, and 41% of them lasted a single day. On the other nine markets RSI was below 30 on between 10.1% (bitcoin) and 16.3% (natural gas) of days. Pooled across the ten markets, the average holding period was 4.0 days, 37% of holds lasted one day and the longest was 38 days. Over the last five years the average share of days invested was 9.7%.
paragraphs.zh: 美股在完整历史中只有 4.6% 的交易日 RSI 低于 30，共产生 78 次入场，平均每次 2.5 天，其中 41% 只持续一天。其他九个市场里，RSI 低于 30 的交易日占比从 10.1%（比特币）到 16.3%（天然气）不等。十个市场合并，平均持仓 4.0 天，37% 的持仓只有一天，最长 38 天。近五年平均持仓日占比为 9.7%。

paragraphs.en: For comparison, we also ran the rule the description implies: buy below 30 and hold until RSI is above 50. This is not a strategy the site tests, and it is our own calculation. On US stocks it would have held for 12.2 days on average and been invested on 18% of days over five years, returning 4.8% a year with a Sharpe ratio of 0.48 and a -12.9% maximum drawdown. The coded rule did better on all three: 5.2%, 0.77 and -7.2%.
paragraphs.zh: 作为对照，我们还计算了描述里暗示的规则：低于 30 买入，持有到 RSI 高于 50。这不是网站测试的策略，是我们自己的计算。在美股上，它平均持有 12.2 天，近五年有 18% 的交易日持仓，年化 4.8%，夏普 0.48，最大回撤 -12.9%。代码里的规则在三项上都更好：5.2%、0.77 和 -7.2%。

paragraphs.en: Over the five years to 11 November 2026, and before costs, the coded rule had a positive Sharpe ratio and a positive annual return on all 10 markets, beat the Sharpe ratio of holding on 7 (US stocks, gold, oil, natural gas, EUR/USD, bitcoin and ether), and had a smaller maximum drawdown than holding on all 10.
paragraphs.zh: 在截至 2026 年 11 月 11 日的五年里，未扣成本，代码里的规则在全部 10 个市场上夏普和年化收益都为正，其中 7 个市场夏普高于持有（美股、黄金、原油、天然气、欧元/美元、比特币和以太坊），10 个市场的最大回撤都比持有小。

en: **Oil:** 9.1% a year, Sharpe 0.99, maximum drawdown -8.4%, against 20.3%, 0.68 and -36.2% for holding.
**Gold:** 4.8% a year, Sharpe 0.91, drawdown -6.0%, against 16.0%, 0.87 and -28.3%.
**Ether:** 12.2% a year, Sharpe 0.46, drawdown -38.0%, while holding lost 15.4% a year.
**Broad commodities and agriculture:** the weakest, at 0.1% and 0.6% a year.
zh: **综合大宗商品和农产品：**最弱，年化分别是 0.1% 和 0.6%。

paragraphs.en: Much of the five-year appeal is the small drawdown, and the longer record is much weaker. Over the full period (from January 2010 for US stocks, September 2014 for bitcoin and November 2017 for ether) the Sharpe ratio was positive on only 6 of 10 markets and above holding's on 2. US stocks returned 3.5% a year with a Sharpe of 0.51 and a -12.3% drawdown, against 13.9%, 0.85 and -33.7%. Bitcoin returned 5.9% a year against 52.0% for holding.
paragraphs.zh: 近五年的吸引力很大一部分来自回撤小，而更长的记录要弱得多。看完整区间（美股自 2010 年 1 月，比特币自 2014 年 9 月，以太坊自 2017 年 11 月），夏普只在 10 个市场中的 6 个为正，只在 2 个市场高于持有。美股年化 3.5%，夏普 0.51，回撤 -12.3%；持有为 13.9%、0.85 和 -33.7%。比特币年化 5.9%，持有为 52.0%。

heading.zh: 糟糕的一段：原油，2014 到 2020 年

paragraphs.en: The worst drawdown was on oil. From the peak on 12 May 2014 to the trough on 28 April 2020 the strategy fell 77.5%; holding the fund over the same dates fell 94.2%. It was invested on 291 of those 1,502 trading days.
paragraphs.zh: 最大的回撤出现在原油上。从 2014 年 5 月 12 日的高点到 2020 年 4 月 28 日的低点，策略下跌 77.5%；同一时期持有这只基金下跌 94.2%。在这 1,502 个交易日里，它只有 291 天持仓。

paragraphs.en: In sharp crashes, buying oversold readings early is costly. In the 2020 sell-off (19 February to 23 March) the strategy lost 4.8% on US stocks, against 33.7% for holding, and 25.3% on bitcoin, against 33.4%. In 2022 (3 January to 12 October) it gained 8.9% on US stocks while holding lost 24.5%, and gained 11.7% on bitcoin while holding lost 58.8%. A rule that is invested one day in ten can look very different depending on whether the few days it chooses fall in a crash.
paragraphs.zh: 在急剧下跌中，过早买入超卖读数代价很高。2020 年的暴跌（2 月 19 日到 3 月 23 日）里，策略在美股上亏损 4.8%，持有亏损 33.7%；在比特币上亏损 25.3%，持有亏损 33.4%。2022 年（1 月 3 日到 10 月 12 日），它在美股上赚了 8.9%，持有亏损 24.5%；在比特币上赚了 11.7%，持有亏损 58.8%。一个十天里只持仓一天的规则，结果取决于它选中的那几天是否恰好落在暴跌里。

heading.en: Connors RSI and Bollinger Band Reversion, which do hold
heading.zh: 真正会持仓的 Connors RSI 和布林带回归

paragraphs.en: Connors RSI (MR-16) averages a 3-day RSI, an RSI of the up/down streak length and a percentile rank of the daily return over 100 days. It buys when that composite is below 10 and exits when it is above 50 or after 10 days. Bollinger Band Reversion (MR-02) buys when the close is at or below the lower band and the bands are wider than their 20-day average, and exits at the middle band, after a maximum holding period, or on a stop 3% below the lower band.
paragraphs.zh: Connors RSI（MR-16）把 3 日 RSI、连涨连跌天数的 RSI 以及日收益率在 100 天内的百分位排名取平均，综合值低于 10 买入，高于 50 或持有满 10 天卖出。布林带回归（MR-02）在收盘价触及或跌破下轨、且带宽大于其 20 日均值时买入，在回到中轨、达到最长持仓期，或跌破下轨 3% 的止损线时卖出。

paragraphs.en: Their holding behaviour differs. Pooled over the ten markets, Connors RSI held 2.3 days on average (the maximum is 10) and Bollinger Band Reversion 8.0 days, with only 6% of its holds lasting one day. Over five years the average number of trades per market (each entry and each exit counts as one) was 80 for MR-01, 156 for Connors RSI and 38 for Bollinger Band Reversion; the share of days invested was 9.7%, 12.8% and 10.6%.
paragraphs.zh: 它们的持仓行为不同。十个市场合并，Connors RSI 平均持有 2.3 天（上限 10 天），布林带回归 8.0 天，只有 6% 的持仓仅持续一天。近五年每个市场的平均交易次数（每次入场和每次离场各算一笔），MR-01 是 80 次，Connors RSI 是 156 次，布林带回归是 38 次；持仓日占比分别为 9.7%、12.8% 和 10.6%。

paragraphs.en: On US stocks over five years Connors RSI was the strongest of the three: 7.9% a year, Sharpe 1.03, drawdown -7.6%, against 5.2%, 0.77 and -7.2% for MR-01 and 3.3%, 0.42 and -9.0% for Bollinger Band Reversion. Across all ten markets it was weaker: a positive Sharpe on 6, against 10 for MR-01 and 8 for Bollinger Band Reversion. At the site's cost assumption of 10 basis points per unit of turnover, Connors RSI costs 3.0% a year on US stocks, against 1.2% for MR-01 and 0.7% for Bollinger Band Reversion.
paragraphs.zh: 近五年在美股上，Connors RSI 是三者中最强的：年化 7.9%，夏普 1.03，回撤 -7.6%；MR-01 是 5.2%、0.77 和 -7.2%，布林带回归是 3.3%、0.42 和 -9.0%。但放到十个市场上它更弱：夏普为正的有 6 个，MR-01 是 10 个，布林带回归是 8 个。按网站每单位换手 10 个基点的成本假设，Connors RSI 在美股上每年成本 3.0%，MR-01 是 1.2%，布林带回归是 0.7%。

heading.en: What the numbers cannot tell you
heading.zh: 这些数字说明不了什么

paragraphs.en: Small samples dominate. MR-01 made 60 trades on US stocks in five years, counting each entry and each exit, which is about 30 round trips. The probabilistic Sharpe ratio (the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero) was 0.99 for US stocks, but the deflated Sharpe ratio, which adjusts for the number of strategies compared, was 0.63. The five-year window was also kinder than the full history, in which the result on oil was a loss of 3.2% a year.
paragraphs.zh: 样本很小。MR-01 近五年在美股上只交易了 60 次（入场和离场各算一次），约 30 个来回。概率夏普比率（真实夏普大于零的概率）在美股上是 0.99，但按比较的策略数量调整的折算夏普比率只有 0.63。近五年的窗口也比完整历史友好：完整区间里它在原油上年化亏损 3.2%。

paragraphs.en: The site's ranking also treats such a strategy awkwardly. The Arena Score only counts a strategy with a non-zero return on at least 5% of days, and on the full-period US stocks cohort MR-01 was invested on 4.6%, so its score there is 0.0. On the five-year window, with 5.9% invested, the same strategy scores 77.34. A rule that is rarely invested can post a small drawdown simply by being absent.
paragraphs.zh: 网站的排名也很难处理这类策略。Arena Score 只计入至少 5% 的交易日收益不为零的策略，而在完整区间的美股组里，MR-01 只有 4.6% 的日子持仓，所以得分为 0.0；在持仓 5.9% 的近五年窗口里，同一个策略得分是 77.34。一个很少持仓的规则，单靠“不在场”就可以得到很小的回撤。

en: MR-01 is a rebound bet on days when RSI is below 30. The code never holds a position until RSI recovers to 50, whatever the strategy page says.
It was invested on about 10% of days over five years, so its small drawdowns say more about time in cash than about timing.
The five-year record is better than the full history: positive Sharpe on 10 markets in five years but 6 in the full period.

The two relatives that hold positions behave differently: Connors RSI trades about twice as often and had the best US stock result of the three, but a positive Sharpe on only 6 markets; Bollinger Band Reversion trades least.
zh: MR-01 是 RSI 低于 30 当天的反弹押注。无论策略页面怎么写，代码从不持有到 RSI 回升至 50。
近五年它约有 10% 的交易日持仓，所以回撤小更多说明它大部分时间空仓，而不是择时能力强。
近五年的记录好于完整历史：五年里 10 个市场夏普为正，完整区间只有 6 个。
两个真正持仓的同类策略表现不同：Connors RSI 交易频率约为它的两倍，在美股上表现是三者中最好，但只有 6 个市场夏普为正；布林带回归交易最少。

title.en: How the Arena Score Ranks Trading Strategies (and What It Misses)
title.zh: Arena Score 如何给交易策略排名？它看不到什么

summary.en: The Arena Score ranks each strategy by percentile within its own market and window, using five weighted components. On US stocks over five years it moves 7 of 59 strategies by more than 10 places compared with ranking by return, but only 1 compared with ranking by Sharpe ratio, and none of 525 five-year results clears a deflated Sharpe ratio of 0.95.
summary.zh: Arena Score 在每个市场、每个窗口内按百分位给策略排名，由五个加权分项组成。在美股近五年里，与按收益排名相比，它让 59 个策略中的 7 个名次变化超过 10 位，与按夏普排名相比只有 1 个；而 525 个五年结果中，没有一个的折算夏普比率超过 0.95。

heading.en: A rank among peers, not a grade
heading.zh: 同类之间的名次，而不是绝对评分

paragraphs.en: The Arena Score is calculated separately for every market and every time window (1 month, 3 months, 6 months, 1 year, 3 years, 5 years and the full history). Within one market and window, each strategy is compared with all the others. Each metric is turned into a percentile from 0 to 100, with the lowest value at 0, the highest at 100 and ties sharing their average rank.
paragraphs.zh: Arena Score 对每个市场、每个时间窗口（1 个月、3 个月、6 个月、1 年、3 年、5 年和全部历史）分别计算。在同一个市场、同一个窗口内，每个策略和其余所有策略比较。每个指标被换算成 0 到 100 的百分位，最低值为 0，最高值为 100，并列者取平均名次。

paragraphs.en: Two consequences follow. A score says where a strategy stands among its peers, not how good it is in absolute terms. And a strategy that was in the market, meaning it had a non-zero return, on fewer than 5% of days in that window is not ranked at all and gets a score of 0. On US stocks over five years, two strategies were left out for that reason.
paragraphs.zh: 由此有两点。分数只说明策略在同类中的位置，不说明它在绝对意义上有多好。其次，如果某个策略在该窗口内持仓（收益不为零）的交易日不足 5%，它根本不参与排名，得分为 0。美股近五年里有两个策略因此被排除。

paragraphs.en: The score is a weighted average of five parts:
paragraphs.zh: 分数是五个部分的加权平均：

en: **Return quality, 30%:** the average of the percentiles for the Sharpe ratio and the Sortino ratio. Both use daily returns, annualised, with a risk-free rate of zero; Sortino divides by the deviation of losing days only.

**Drawdown control, 25%:** the average of the percentiles for the Calmar ratio (annual return divided by the maximum drawdown) and the Ulcer index (the root-mean-square drawdown, where lower is better).
**Consistency, 20%:** the average of the percentiles for the share of calendar months with a gain and the share of days spent below a previous equity peak (lower is better).
**Robustness, 15%:** the percentile of the worst Sharpe ratio among the 1-year, 3-year, 5-year and full-history windows. The same number is used whichever window is being ranked.
**Significance, 10%:** the probabilistic Sharpe ratio times 100. This is the only part that is not a percentile.
zh: **收益质量，30%：**夏普比率和索提诺比率百分位的平均值。两者都用年化的日收益率，无风险利率为零；索提诺只用亏损日的波动做分母。
**回撤控制，25%：**卡玛比率（年化收益除以最大回撤）和 Ulcer 指数（回撤的均方根，越低越好）百分位的平均值。
**稳定性，20%：**正收益月份占比和处于前期净值高点以下的天数占比（越低越好）百分位的平均值。
**稳健性，15%：**1 年、3 年、5 年和全部历史四个窗口中最差的夏普比率的百分位。无论排的是哪个窗口，这个数字都相同。
**统计可信度，10%：**概率夏普比率乘以 100。这是唯一不是百分位的部分。

paragraphs.en: If a part cannot be computed, for example because a window is too short, the weights of the remaining parts are rescaled. There are no caps and no explicit penalties apart from the 5% rule, and trading costs are not in the score. We recomputed the score from the stored metrics: the result matches exactly for US stocks over five years and is within 0.93 points in all 40 cohorts of the 1-, 3- and 5-year and full-history windows.
paragraphs.zh: 如果某个分项无法计算，比如窗口太短，其余分项的权重会按比例放大。除了 5% 规则之外，没有封顶，也没有明确的惩罚项，交易成本也不在分数里。我们用已存储的指标重新计算了分数：美股近五年的结果完全一致，1 年、3 年、5 年和全部历史四个窗口共 40 组比较中，误差都在 0.93 分以内。

heading.en: The older formula that still picks parameters
heading.zh: 仍用于选择参数的旧公式

paragraphs.en: An earlier linear score is still in the code: 40 times Sharpe, plus 20 times Sortino, plus 10 times Calmar, plus 100 times the annual return, minus 50 times the absolute maximum drawdown, clipped to the range 0 to 100. It is stored as the version-1 score, and it is the formula the walk-forward step uses to choose parameters. Each fold picks the setting with the best old-style score over the previous 3 years and trades it for the next 6 months.
paragraphs.zh: 代码里还保留着早期的线性评分：40 乘以夏普，加 20 乘以索提诺，加 10 乘以卡玛，加 100 乘以年化收益，减 50 乘以最大回撤的绝对值，结果限制在 0 到 100 之间。它被存为第一版得分，滚动前推步骤用它来选择参数：每一折在过去 3 年里选出旧评分最高的参数，再交易接下来的 6 个月。

paragraphs.en: For ranking, the two versions agree closely: the rank correlation between them on US stocks over five years is 0.96. They disagree at the top. The older formula puts Cross-Asset Momentum (MACRO-01) first; the current one puts Connors RSI (MR-16) first.
paragraphs.zh: 用于排名时，两个版本相当一致：美股近五年两者的排名相关系数是 0.96。分歧在榜首：旧公式把跨资产动量（MACRO-01）排第一，现在的公式则是 Connors RSI（MR-16）。

heading.en: Score, return and Sharpe compared on US stocks
heading.zh: 美股上的得分、收益和夏普对比

paragraphs.en: We ranked the 59 US stock strategies that the score ranks over the last five years, before trading costs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们把近五年里参与排名的 59 个美股策略分别按三种方式排序，未扣交易成本。

en: **By Arena Score:** Connors RSI (MR-16), Trend + Macro Filter (EVENT-01), Cross-Asset Momentum (MACRO-01), Multi-Factor Composite (FACTOR-05), Z-Score Mean Reversion (MR-06).
**By annual return:** Cross-Asset Momentum (11.3%), Multi-Factor Composite (10.6%), Trend + Macro Filter (10.0%), Triple Moving Average (TREND-13, 10.0%), Dual Moving Average (TREND-05, 9.6%).
**By Sharpe ratio:** Cross-Asset Momentum (1.06), Connors RSI (1.03), Trend + Macro Filter (0.93), Z-Score Mean Reversion (0.89), Accelerating Momentum (MOM-10, 0.83).
zh: **按 Arena Score：**Connors RSI（MR-16）、趋势加宏观过滤（EVENT-01）、跨资产动量（MACRO-01）、多因子综合（FACTOR-05）、Z-Score 均值回归（MR-06）。
**按年化收益：**跨资产动量（11.3%）、多因子综合（10.6%）、趋势加宏观过滤（10.0%）、三重移动平均（TREND-13，10.0%）、双均线（TREND-05，9.6%）。
**按夏普比率：**跨资产动量（1.06）、Connors RSI（1.03）、趋势加宏观过滤（0.93）、Z-Score 均值回归（0.89）、加速动量（MOM-10，0.83）。

paragraphs.en: The top five by score shares 3 names with the top five by return and 4 with the top five by Sharpe. Seven strategies change rank by more than 10 places between score and return; only one does between score and Sharpe. Across all ten markets over five years the counts are 41 of 525 against return and 8 of 525 against Sharpe. The first-place strategy by score is also first by return in 5 of 10 markets and first by Sharpe in 3.
paragraphs.zh: 按得分的前五名与按收益的前五名有 3 个重合，与按夏普的前五名有 4 个重合。得分和收益之间有 7 个策略的名次相差超过 10 位；得分和夏普之间只有 1 个。放到十个市场的五年窗口里，数字分别是 525 个中的 41 个（对收益）和 8 个（对夏普）。按得分排第一的策略，在 10 个市场中有 5 个同时是收益第一，有 3 个同时是夏普第一。

paragraphs.en: The winner on score, Connors RSI, was invested on 12% of days, earned 7.9% a year (13th by return) with a Sharpe ratio of 1.03 and a maximum drawdown of -7.6%. RSI Mean Reversion (MR-01) ranks 27th by return but 9th by score: 5.2% a year, a -7.2% drawdown and 5.9% of days invested. In this cohort the score behaves like a Sharpe ranking with extra weight on drawdown and consistency, which lifts low-exposure strategies such as Connors RSI and RSI Mean Reversion.
paragraphs.zh: 得分第一的 Connors RSI 只有 12% 的交易日持仓，年化 7.9%（按收益排第 13），夏普 1.03，最大回撤 -7.6%。RSI 均值回归（MR-01）按收益排第 27，按得分排第 9：年化 5.2%，回撤 -7.2%，持仓日占比 5.9%。在这一组里，这个分数的表现就像夏普排名再加上回撤和稳定性的权重，因此抬高了 Connors RSI 和 RSI 均值回归这类持仓很少的策略。

heading.en: How many results clear a luck threshold
heading.zh: 有多少结果能越过“运气”门槛

paragraphs.en: The probabilistic Sharpe ratio (PSR) is the probability that the true Sharpe ratio is above zero, adjusted for the skew and kurtosis of the returns. The deflated Sharpe ratio (DSR) raises the bar: it tests the Sharpe ratio against the best result expected by chance from N skill-less strategies, where N is the number of strategies compared in the same market and window (in the code, the cohort size).
paragraphs.zh: 概率夏普比率（PSR）是真实夏普大于零的概率，并按收益的偏度和峰度做了调整。折算夏普比率（DSR）门槛更高：它把夏普与 N 个没有技能的策略中预期能靠运气得到的最好结果相比，N 是同一市场、同一窗口里参与比较的策略数量。

paragraphs.en: Over five years, 58 of the 525 ranked strategy and market results (11%) have a PSR above 0.95. None has a DSR above 0.95, and 61 have a DSR above 0.5. The median PSR is 0.77 and the median DSR 0.18. The highest DSR is Vortex Indicator (TREND-20) on EUR/USD at 0.86. Over the full history, 166 results (32%) have a PSR above 0.95 and exactly one has a DSR above 0.95: Parabolic SAR (SAR-01) on EUR/USD, at 0.99. Of the 44 five-year results that scored 80 or more, none clears 0.95 on DSR.
paragraphs.zh: 近五年，525 个进入排名的策略与市场组合中，有 58 个（11%）PSR 高于 0.95。没有一个 DSR 高于 0.95，有 61 个 DSR 高于 0.5。PSR 的中位数是 0.77，DSR 的中位数是 0.18。最高的 DSR 是欧元/美元上的涡旋指标（TREND-20），为 0.86。在完整历史上，有 166 个结果（32%）PSR 高于 0.95，恰好有一个 DSR 高于 0.95：欧元/美元上的抛物线 SAR（SAR-01），为 0.99。五年窗口里得分在 80 以上的 44 个结果中，没有一个 DSR 能超过 0.95。

paragraphs.en: On US stocks the five highest-scoring strategies all have a PSR above 0.95 and none has a DSR above 0.95, and the same is true of the top five by return and by Sharpe. Treating every strategy in the cohort as an independent trial is a strict assumption when many are variants of one idea, so the DSR may be too severe; but a high score is clearly not evidence of skill.
paragraphs.zh: 在美股上，得分最高的五个策略 PSR 全部高于 0.95，DSR 没有一个高于 0.95，按收益和按夏普的前五名也是如此。把同一组里的每个策略都当作独立试验，在许多策略是同一思路的变体时是个严格的假设，所以 DSR 可能偏严；但高分显然不等于有能力的证据。

heading.en: What the score cannot tell you

en: **It is relative.** On natural gas over five years only 3 of 50 ranked strategies had a positive annual return. The top score, 86.02, went to RSI Mean Reversion (MR-01), which earned 2.7% a year with a -46.3% drawdown; holding lost 31.6% a year with a -93.3% drawdown.

**It depends on the window.** On US stocks, Trend + Macro Filter is second over five years and 27th over the full history; Z-Score Mean Reversion falls from fifth to 38th. Only 3 of the top 5 stay in the top 10 (rank correlation between the two windows: 0.73).

**It ignores costs.** At the site's assumption of 10 basis points per unit of turnover, Connors RSI would give up 3.0% a year on US stocks against its 7.9% return, and Cross-Asset Momentum, with 1,253 trades (entries plus exits), 2.7% against 11.3%.
**It is not significance.** Significance is only 10% of the weight.
zh: **它是相对的。**天然气近五年，50 个参与排名的策略里只有 3 个年化收益为正。最高分 86.02 给了 RSI 均值回归（MR-01），它年化 2.7%，回撤 -46.3%；持有则年化亏损 31.6%，回撤 -93.3%。
**它取决于窗口。**在美股上，趋势加宏观过滤近五年排第 2，完整历史排第 27；Z-Score 均值回归从第 5 掉到第 38。前五名中只有 3 个仍在前十（两个窗口的排名相关系数：0.73）。
**它不含成本。**按网站每单位换手 10 个基点的假设，Connors RSI 在美股上每年要付出 3.0%，而它的收益是 7.9%；跨资产动量交易 1,253 次（入场加离场），每年 2.7%，收益是 11.3%。
**它不等于统计显著。**统计可信度在权重里只占 10%。

en: The Arena Score is a weighted percentile rank: 30% quality, 25% drawdown control, 20% consistency, 15% robustness, 10% significance, within one market and window.
It is close to a Sharpe ranking (1 of 59 strategies moves by more than 10 places) and far from a return ranking (7 of 59).
Use it to shortlist, then check the deflated Sharpe ratio, the time in market, the trade count and a second window.
With a luck-adjusted test, almost nothing clears the bar over five years: none of 525 results does.
zh: Arena Score 是加权百分位排名：质量 30%、回撤控制 25%、稳定性 20%、稳健性 15%、统计可信度 10%，限定在同一个市场和窗口内。
它很接近夏普排名（59 个策略中 1 个名次变化超过 10 位），离收益排名较远（59 个中 7 个）。
用它来初筛，再看折算夏普、持仓时间、交易次数，并换一个窗口验证。
用扣除运气的检验来看，近五年几乎没有结果能过关：525 个中一个也没有。
