title.en: Does the 200-Day Moving Average Rule Work? Ten Markets Tested
title.zh: 200 日均线规则有效吗？10 个市场实测

summary.en: Holding only while price is above its 200-day average had a smaller maximum drawdown than buy-and-hold in all ten markets and a higher Sharpe ratio in nine, but it trailed on return in US stocks, gold and bitcoin and switched 1,140 times in total, before costs.
summary.zh: 只在价格位于 200 日均线之上时持有，在 10 个市场里最大回撤都比买入持有小，9 个市场夏普更高；但在美股、黄金和比特币上收益落后，而且合计切换了 1,140 次（未扣交易成本）。

paragraphs.en: The saying is that you should own a market only while its price is above its 200-day moving average and step aside when it is below. The claim checker turns this into a mechanical rule: when a day closes above the 200-day simple average, hold the market from the next day; when a day closes below it, hold cash from the next day. Cash earns nothing, there is no stop-loss, and trading costs are not included.
paragraphs.zh: 这句老话是：价格在 200 日均线之上才持有，跌到均线之下就离场。Claim Checker 把它写成机械规则：某天收盘高于 200 日简单均线，次日起持有该市场；某天收盘低于均线，次日起持有现金。现金不计收益，没有止损，也不含交易成本。

paragraphs.en: The only variant in the claims data is the same rule with a 1% band, which needs a close more than 1% above the average to buy and more than 1% below to sell. A 10-month average variant is not in the claims data and was not tested. The site's Faber TAA (MOM-05) applies a 200-day test once a month across a four-market portfolio; it is not part of this comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 声明数据里唯一的变体是同一规则加 1% 缓冲带：收盘高出均线 1% 以上才买入，低于均线 1% 以上才卖出。声明数据里没有 10 个月均线的变体，所以没有测试。本站的 Faber TAA（MOM-05）是每月在四个市场的组合上用 200 日均线做一次判断，不属于这次比较。

paragraphs.en: The rule was run on US stocks, gold, silver, oil, natural gas, broad commodities, agriculture, EUR/USD, bitcoin and ether, using daily closes up to 2026-11-11. A position decided at the close of day t earns the return of day t+1, and the average on day t uses closes up to day t only. After the 200-day warm-up the tested periods start on 2010-10-18 for most markets, 2010-10-07 for EUR/USD, 2015-04-04 for bitcoin and 2018-05-27 for ether.
paragraphs.zh: 规则在美股、黄金、白银、原油、天然气、综合大宗商品、农产品、欧元/美元、比特币和以太坊上运行，使用截至 2026-11-11 的日线收盘价。第 t 日收盘做出的持仓赚取第 t+1 日的收益，第 t 日的均线只用到第 t 日为止的收盘价。扣除 200 日预热期后，大多数市场的测试从 2010-10-18 开始，欧元/美元从 2010-10-07，比特币从 2015-04-04，以太坊从 2018-05-27。

paragraphs.en: The checker counts the rule as working only if it cuts the maximum drawdown by at least a quarter and improves the Sharpe ratio, in the full period and in both halves of it. The switch counts, whipsaw years and worst-stretch figures below were computed for this article from the same data and the same convention.
paragraphs.zh: 检验器只有在规则把最大回撤至少缩小四分之一、同时夏普比率更高，并且在完整区间及前后两半都成立时，才算它有效。下文的切换次数、反复被洗出的年份和最糟阶段的数字，是为本文用同一份数据、同一套约定算出来的。

heading.en: Return, drawdown and time in the market

paragraphs.en: Against buy-and-hold over the same dates, the rule had a smaller maximum drawdown in all 10 markets, at least a quarter smaller in 7, a higher Sharpe ratio in 9 and a higher annual return in 7. It was in the market between 25% of days (natural gas) and 85% (US stocks).
paragraphs.zh: 和同一区间的买入持有相比，规则在全部 10 个市场里最大回撤更小，其中 7 个至少小四分之一，9 个夏普更高，7 个年化收益更高。它在场内的时间占比从 25%（天然气）到 85%（美股）不等。

en: **US stocks:** 10.6% a year against 14.3%, Sharpe 0.92 against 0.87, maximum drawdown -19.8% against -33.7%, in the market 85% of days.
**Gold:** 5.4% against 6.4% a year, drawdown -33.5% against -45.6%, in the market 61% of days.
**Bitcoin (from 2015-04-04):** 59.0% against 63.1% a year, drawdown -69.9% against -83.4%, in the market 61% of days.
**Ether (from 2018-05-27):** 40.0% against 16.3% a year, drawdown -70.9% against -86.4%.
**Agriculture:** 3.0% against 0.4% a year, drawdown -31.3% against -61.9%, in the market 47% of days.
**Natural gas:** -7.2% against -23.2% a year, in the market 25% of days.
zh: **天然气：** 年化 -7.2%，买入持有 -23.2%；25% 的交易日在场内。

paragraphs.en: The three return shortfalls are US stocks, gold and bitcoin. The rule's largest gains over buy-and-hold are in markets where holding did badly or lost money, such as natural gas and agriculture.
paragraphs.zh: 收益落后的三个市场是美股、黄金和比特币。规则相对买入持有收获最大的，是持有本身表现很差甚至亏钱的市场，例如天然气和农产品。

paragraphs.en: For each market, take the peak-to-trough fall that gave buy-and-hold its maximum drawdown and ask what the rule did over the same dates. In US stocks that was 2020-02-19 to 2020-03-23: buy-and-hold lost 33.7%, the rule lost 17.4%. It first went flat on 2020-02-28 and was long on only 8 of the 23 trading days.
paragraphs.zh: 对每个市场，取让买入持有出现最大回撤的那段高点到低点，看规则在同样日期里做了什么。美股是 2020-02-19 至 2020-03-23：买入持有亏 33.7%，规则亏 17.4%。它在 2020-02-28 首次转为空仓，23 个交易日里只有 8 天持多。

paragraphs.en: EUR/USD, from 2011-04-29 to 2022-09-28, fell 35.4% for buy-and-hold against 2.3% for the rule. Broad commodities, from 2011-04-08 to 2020-04-27, fell 66.1% against 25.9%. The rule lost less than buy-and-hold in that window in all 10 markets. Bitcoin in calendar 2022 is the extreme case: the rule was in cash all year with no switches, returning 0.0% against -64.3% for buy-and-hold.
paragraphs.zh: 欧元/美元在 2011-04-29 至 2022-09-28，买入持有跌 35.4%，规则只跌 2.3%。综合大宗商品在 2011-04-08 至 2020-04-27，买入持有跌 66.1%，规则跌 25.9%。在这个窗口里，10 个市场中规则亏得都比买入持有少。比特币 2022 自然年是极端例子：规则全年持有现金、没有切换，收益 0.0%，买入持有 -64.3%。

paragraphs.en: Across the ten markets the rule changed position 1,140 times, from 46 for ether to 185 for oil. In 107 of 149 market-years (years with at least 200 days of data) it switched four or more times, and in 63 of those it earned less than buy-and-hold. These are what traders call whipsaws: a close just above the average, a close just below, and a loss each way.
paragraphs.zh: 10 个市场合计，规则变换了 1,140 次仓位，以太坊最少 46 次，原油最多 185 次。在 149 个市场年（至少有 200 个交易日数据的年份）中，有 107 个切换了 4 次或更多，其中 63 个收益低于买入持有。这就是交易者说的反复被洗：收盘刚好在均线上方，再收到下方，每个来回都亏一点。

paragraphs.en: US stocks show it year by year. In 2011 the rule switched 12 times and returned -9.1% against +1.9%; in 2015 it switched 8 times and returned -4.4% against +1.2%. In four years (2013, 2017, 2021 and 2024) it never switched and matched buy-and-hold exactly. In 2019 and 2023 it was in and out and earned 16.6% and 15.4% against 31.2% and 26.2%. None of this includes spread, commission or slippage, which would be paid on every one of those 1,140 switches.
paragraphs.zh: 美股逐年看最清楚。2011 年规则切换了 12 次，收益 -9.1%，买入持有 +1.9%；2015 年切换 8 次，收益 -4.4%，买入持有 +1.2%。有四年（2013、2017、2021 和 2024）一次都没切换，与买入持有完全一致。2019 年和 2023 年，它进进出出，收益是 16.6% 和 15.4%，买入持有是 31.2% 和 26.2%。以上都没有计入点差、佣金和滑点，而这 1,140 次切换每一次都要付。

paragraphs.en: The 1% band halves the trading: 556 switches in total instead of 1,140. But the benefit shrinks too. The band version beat buy-and-hold on annual return in 6 markets instead of 7, on Sharpe in 6 instead of 9, and cut the drawdown by a quarter in 6 instead of 7. US stocks fell to 9.5% a year with Sharpe 0.83, below buy-and-hold's 0.87.
paragraphs.zh: 1% 缓冲带把交易减半：合计 556 次切换，而不是 1,140 次。但好处也随之缩水。带缓冲的版本在年化收益上跑赢买入持有的市场有 6 个（原来是 7 个），夏普上有 6 个（原来是 9 个），把回撤缩小四分之一的有 6 个（原来是 7 个）。美股降到年化 9.5%，夏普 0.83，低于买入持有的 0.87。

paragraphs.en: By the checker's rules the plain rule is "partly" holding, with 3 markets clearly passing (natural gas, agriculture and EUR/USD), and the band version is "does not hold", with 1. A band avoids some false signals but also enters and exits later, and on these ten histories that trade-off did not pay.
paragraphs.zh: 按检验器的规则，普通版本是“部分成立”，明确通过的市场有 3 个（天然气、农产品和欧元/美元）；缓冲带版本是“不成立”，通过 1 个。缓冲带躲开了一部分假信号，但进出场也更晚，在这 10 段历史里，这种取舍并不划算。

heading.en: What the numbers cannot tell you
heading.zh: 这些数字说明不了什么

paragraphs.en: The three clear passes are all markets where buy-and-hold was poor (natural gas -23.2% a year, EUR/USD -1.4%, agriculture 0.4%). In US stocks the rule's edge is concentrated in a few episodes: in the first half of the sample (2010-10-18 to 2018-10-26) its drawdown was -17.0% against -18.6% and its Sharpe 0.91 against 0.92, essentially no difference; its drawdown advantage appears in the second half (-19.8% against -33.7%), which contains the 2020 crash.
paragraphs.zh: 三个明确通过的，全是买入持有表现很差的市场（天然气年化 -23.2%，欧元/美元 -1.4%，农产品 0.4%）。在美股上，规则的优势集中在少数几段行情：样本前半段（2010-10-18 至 2018-10-26）它的回撤是 -17.0%，买入持有 -18.6%，夏普 0.91 对 0.92，基本没有区别；回撤上的优势出现在后半段（-19.8% 对 -33.7%），而后半段包含了 2020 年的暴跌。

paragraphs.en: Each market is one price path, with 38 entries for bitcoin and 23 for ether. Results depend on a few crash episodes, the periods start in 2010 or later, and the ten markets are not independent of one another. Everything is before costs.
paragraphs.zh: 每个市场只是一条价格路径，比特币只有 38 次入场，以太坊 23 次。结果依赖少数几次暴跌，区间最早从 2010 年开始，十个市场之间也并不独立。所有数字均未扣成本。

en: The 200-day rule's reliable effect in this test was smaller drawdowns (all 10 markets), not higher returns (7 of 10, with US stocks, gold and bitcoin behind).
Its price was 1,140 switches and 63 whipsaw market-years out of 149; costs are not included.
A 1% band halved the trading but lost much of the benefit, so reducing whipsaws is not free.
zh: 在这次测试里，200 日规则可靠的作用是缩小回撤（10 个市场全部），而不是提高收益（10 个里有 7 个，美股、黄金和比特币落后）。
它的代价是 1,140 次切换，以及 149 个市场年里有 63 个被反复洗出；成本尚未计入。
1% 缓冲带把交易减半，却丢掉了不少好处，所以减少反复被洗并不是免费的。

title.en: Does Buying the Dip Work? Four Dip Rules on Ten Markets
title.zh: 抄底有用吗？4 种抄底规则在 10 个市场的实测

summary.en: After a fall of 3% or more in five days, inside an uptrend, the average 21-day return was +1.0% against +0.7% on all days (medians over nine markets, 2010-2026): higher in 8 of 9 markets but statistically clear in only one, and the worst case, US stocks on 2020-02-24, lost 24.1% over the next 21 days.
summary.zh: 在上升趋势中，5 日跌幅达到 3% 以上之后，未来 21 日的平均收益是 +1.0%，全部交易日是 +0.7%（9 个市场的中位数，2010–2026）：9 个市场中有 8 个高于平均，但统计上清晰的只有 1 个；最糟的一次是 2020-02-24 的美股，之后 21 日亏了 24.1%。

heading.en: One saying, four ways to test it

paragraphs.en: "Buy the dip" has no single definition, so the claim checker tests several. The main one is a fall of 3% or more over five trading days while the close is still above its 200-day average. Three related sayings are tested alongside it: three down closes in a row, RSI(14) below 30, and a 20-day fall of 10% or more below the 200-day average (the "falling knife"). A fifth idea, buying when the drawdown from the peak reaches -20%, was also run.
paragraphs.zh: “抄底”没有统一的定义，所以 Claim Checker 测了几种。主要的一种是：收盘价仍在 200 日均线之上，5 个交易日内下跌 3% 以上。另外三句相关的说法一起测试：连续三天收跌、RSI(14) 低于 30，以及 20 日跌幅达到 10% 以上且在 200 日均线之下（“接飞刀”）。还跑了第五种思路：从高点回撤达到 -20% 时买入。

paragraphs.en: Each is an event study on ten markets: US stocks, gold, silver, oil, natural gas, broad commodities, agriculture, EUR/USD, bitcoin and ether. Daily closes run from 2010-01-04 to 2026-11-11, with bitcoin from 2014-09-17 and ether from 2017-11-09. Everything is measured before trading costs.
paragraphs.zh: 每一种都是在 10 个市场上做事件研究：美股、黄金、白银、原油、天然气、综合大宗商品、农产品、欧元/美元、比特币和以太坊。日线收盘价从 2010-01-04 到 2026-11-11，比特币从 2014-09-17 开始，以太坊从 2017-11-09 开始。所有结果均未扣交易成本。

paragraphs.en: When the signal appears at a close, the test records the return over the next 21 trading days. Events must be at least 21 trading days apart, so that one slump is not counted many times, and the result is compared with the average 21-day return of the same market on all days. That comparison matters: it removes the fact that most of these markets rose over the period.
paragraphs.zh: 信号在某天收盘出现后，记录接下来 21 个交易日的收益。事件之间至少间隔 21 个交易日，避免同一轮下跌被重复计算，然后与同一市场所有交易日的平均 21 日收益比较。这个比较很重要，因为它剔除了这些市场在样本期内大多上涨这一事实。

paragraphs.en: Across the nine markets with enough events (436 events in total), the median 21-day return after the signal was +1.0% against +0.7% on all days. It was above the market's own average in 8 of 9 markets, and statistically clear, with at least 20 events and the same sign in both halves of the history, in 1.
paragraphs.zh: 在事件足够多的 9 个市场（共 436 次事件）中，信号之后 21 日收益的中位数是 +1.0%，全部交易日是 +0.7%。高于本市场自身平均的有 8 个，统计上清晰（至少 20 次事件，且前后两半历史方向一致）的有 1 个。

en: **US stocks (38 events):** +2.1% against +1.2%; 71% of events positive against 69% of all windows.
**Broad commodities (39 events):** +2.1% against +0.4%, 74% positive against 54%. This is the one clear result.
**Bitcoin (82 events) and ether (56 events):** +5.1% against +4.0% and +4.4% against +3.6%.
**Silver (56 events) and oil (60 events):** no different from usual, +0.9% against +0.9% and +0.3% against +0.3%.
**Agriculture (24 events):** +0.1% against +0.2%, the only market below its average.
zh: **美股（38 次事件）：** +2.1%，全部交易日 +1.2%；71% 的事件为正，全部窗口为 69%。
**综合大宗商品（39 次事件）：** +2.1%，全部交易日 +0.4%；74% 为正，全部为 54%。这是唯一清晰的结果。
**白银（56 次事件）和原油（60 次事件）：** 与平时没有区别，分别为 +0.9% 对 +0.9% 和 +0.3% 对 +0.3%。
**农产品（24 次事件）：** +0.1% 对 +0.2%，是唯一低于自身平均的市场。

paragraphs.en: EUR/USD had only 4 events and could not be judged.
paragraphs.zh: 欧元/美元只有 4 次事件，无法判断。

heading.en: The same fall below the 200-day average
heading.zh: 同样的下跌，但在 200 日均线之下

paragraphs.en: The same 3% five-day fall, but with the close below the 200-day average, looks very different. Across 10 markets and 609 events the median was +0.4% against +0.5% on all days; it was above the market's average in 4 markets and below in 6, with none clear and stable. For crypto the gap was large: bitcoin +1.7% against +4.0% (68 events) and ether +0.5% against +3.6% (62 events).
paragraphs.zh: 同样是 5 日跌 3%，但收盘在 200 日均线之下，结果就很不一样。10 个市场、609 次事件，中位数是 +0.4%，全部交易日是 +0.5%；高于自身平均的有 4 个市场，低于的有 6 个，没有一个清晰且稳定。加密货币的差距很大：比特币 +1.7% 对 +4.0%（68 次事件），以太坊 +0.5% 对 +3.6%（62 次事件）。

paragraphs.en: EUR/USD was the exception, +1.3% against -0.1% with a t-statistic of 2.72 over 17 events, but it did not hold in both halves of the history, so the checker does not count it. The trend filter is doing some work, though a sample of this size cannot say how much.
paragraphs.zh: 欧元/美元是例外：+1.3% 对 -0.1%，17 次事件，t 值 2.72，但它在前后两半历史中没有同时成立，所以检验器不计入。趋势过滤确实起了一些作用，但这个样本量说不清作用有多大。

paragraphs.en: **Three down closes in a row,** measured over the next 3 days (2,580 events, ten markets): the median was 0.0% against +0.1% on all days, above usual in only 3 markets. In gold (234 events) and silver (230 events) the result was clearly worse than usual, at -0.1% and -0.4% against +0.1% for both.
paragraphs.zh: **连续三天收跌**，看之后 3 天（10 个市场共 2,580 次事件）：中位数是 0.0%，全部交易日是 +0.1%，只有 3 个市场高于平时。黄金（234 次事件）和白银（230 次事件）明显比平时更差，分别是 -0.1% 和 -0.4%，而两者的全部交易日均值都是 +0.1%。

paragraphs.en: **RSI(14) below 30,** measured over 10 days (441 events): the median was +0.1% against +0.2%, split 5 markets above and 5 below. US stocks looked good at +1.9% against +0.6% (22 events), bitcoin too at +3.4% against +1.8% (48 events), but oil was -2.1% against +0.1% (55 events) and ether -2.1% against +1.6% (32 events). Nothing was clear.
paragraphs.zh: **RSI(14) 低于 30**，看之后 10 天（441 次事件）：中位数 +0.1%，全部交易日 +0.2%，5 个市场高于、5 个低于。美股看上去不错，+1.9% 对 +0.6%（22 次事件），比特币也是，+3.4% 对 +1.8%（48 次事件）；但原油是 -2.1% 对 +0.1%（55 次事件），以太坊是 -2.1% 对 +1.6%（32 次事件）。没有一个清晰的结果。

paragraphs.en: **The falling knife** (a 20-day fall of 10% or more below the 200-day average, 21-day return) is the opposite saying. Across the six markets with enough events (253 events) the median was -0.7% against +0.7%, lower than usual in 5 of 6, but none clear. Ether was -1.0% against +3.6% (46 events). Buying when the drawdown reached -20% produced at most 9 events in any market, too few to judge.
paragraphs.zh: **接飞刀**（20 日跌幅达到 10% 以上且在 200 日均线之下，看 21 日收益）是相反的说法。事件足够的 6 个市场（253 次事件）中位数是 -0.7%，全部交易日是 +0.7%，6 个中有 5 个低于平时，但没有一个清晰。以太坊是 -1.0% 对 +3.6%（46 次事件）。回撤达到 -20% 时买入，任何市场最多只有 9 次事件，太少，无法判断。

heading.en: The worst stretches for dip buyers

paragraphs.en: Averages hide the bad cases. The largest loss after a signal in US stocks came on 2020-02-24, the first dip signal of the pandemic fall, which was followed by -24.1% over 21 trading days, while the market fell 33.7% from 2020-02-19 to 2020-03-23. The next three signals in 2020 returned +5.2%, +2.7% and +11.3%.
paragraphs.zh: 平均数会掩盖坏的情况。美股信号之后亏损最大的一次出现在 2020-02-24，是疫情下跌中的第一个抄底信号，之后 21 个交易日亏了 24.1%，而市场在 2020-02-19 至 2020-03-23 总共跌了 33.7%。2020 年接下来的三个信号分别是 +5.2%、+2.7% 和 +11.3%。

paragraphs.en: Bitcoin's worst event was 2020-02-26, at -40.6%. Averaged over each market's five worst events, the next 21 days lost 26.9% in bitcoin, 27.4% in ether, 23.4% in natural gas (worst: -31.9% on 2022-05-31) and 8.8% in US stocks. The share of events followed by a loss was 29% in US stocks and 26% in broad commodities, but 53% in oil, 54% in agriculture and 57% in natural gas.
paragraphs.zh: 比特币最糟的一次是 2020-02-26，-40.6%。把每个市场最差的五次事件取平均，之后 21 天比特币亏 26.9%，以太坊亏 27.4%，天然气亏 23.4%（最差一次是 2022-05-31 的 -31.9%），美股亏 8.8%。信号之后出现亏损的事件占比，美股是 29%，综合大宗商品是 26%，而原油是 53%，农产品 54%，天然气 57%。

heading.en: A dip-buying strategy on the site

paragraphs.en: The nearest site strategy is RSI Mean Reversion (MR-01). Its code holds the market only on days when the 14-day RSI, calculated with simple averages, is below 30; it does not wait for RSI to recover. Over the full stored history, which for US stocks starts in 2010, it was in the market between 4.6% of days (US stocks) and 16.1% (natural gas). Its Sharpe ratio was above buy-and-hold in only 2 of 10 markets, natural gas and agriculture.
paragraphs.zh: 本站最接近的策略是 RSI Mean Reversion（MR-01）。它的代码只在 14 日 RSI（用简单平均计算）低于 30 的那些天持有，并不会等 RSI 回升再离场。在完整的存档历史（美股从 2010 年开始）中，它在场内的天数占比从 4.6%（美股）到 16.1%（天然气）。它的夏普只在 10 个市场中的 2 个高于买入持有：天然气和农产品。

paragraphs.en: In US stocks it earned 3.5% a year against 13.9% for buy-and-hold, with a maximum drawdown of -12.3% against -33.7%. Mostly sitting in cash lowers risk, but it also gives up the return of a market that mostly rose.
paragraphs.zh: 在美股上，它年化 3.5%，买入持有 13.9%，最大回撤 -12.3% 对 -33.7%。大部分时间持有现金降低了风险，但也放弃了一个大多数时间在上涨的市场的收益。

heading.en: What the numbers cannot tell you
heading.zh: 这些数字说明不了什么

paragraphs.en: The main test and the falling-knife test are rated "partly" by the checker, the three-down-days and RSI tests "does not hold", and the -20% drawdown test is too small to judge. One clear result among nine markets is within what chance can produce when this many tests are run. The period 2010-2026 includes long rises in US stocks, crypto and gold, which flatters any rule that buys.
paragraphs.zh: 检验器把主要测试和“接飞刀”测试评为“部分成立”，连续三天收跌和 RSI 两项评为“不成立”，-20% 回撤那项样本太小，无法判断。测试这么多次，9 个市场里出现 1 个清晰的结果，在偶然可以产生的范围内。2010–2026 这段时间里美股、加密货币和黄金都有长期上涨，这会让任何买入规则看起来更好。

paragraphs.en: Events from one slump are not independent. The 2020 and 2022 sell-offs account for several of the worst outcomes. All figures are before costs, and the "dip" is defined at the close, so no intraday entry is assumed.
paragraphs.zh: 同一轮下跌里的事件并不独立。2020 年和 2022 年的下跌贡献了好几个最糟的结果。所有数字均未扣成本，“抄底”以收盘价定义，不假设盘中入场。

en: A 3% five-day fall in an uptrend was followed by a slightly better-than-usual month in 8 of 9 markets (+1.0% against +0.7% median), but only broad commodities were clear.
The same fall below the 200-day average, three down closes in a row and RSI below 30 did not beat the usual return.
The worst outcomes were large (-24.1% in US stocks, -40.6% in bitcoin), so the average is a poor guide to a single trade.
zh: 上升趋势中 5 日跌 3%，之后一个月比平时略好的有 9 个市场中的 8 个（中位数 +1.0% 对 +0.7%），但只有综合大宗商品是清晰的。
在 200 日均线之下的同样下跌、连续三天收跌和 RSI 低于 30，都没有跑赢平时的收益。
最糟的结果很大（美股 -24.1%，比特币 -40.6%），所以平均数不能当作单笔交易的参考。

title.en: How Did 61 Strategies Handle the 2020 COVID Crash on US Stocks?
title.zh: 61 个策略如何度过 2020 年新冠暴跌？美股回放

summary.en: In the site's replay of 19 February to 23 March 2020, US stocks (SPY) fell 33.7%. Only 3 of 61 strategies made money, though 58 did better than buy-and-hold, but 38 were flat at the low and just 3 recaptured half of the 39.9% rebound that followed.
summary.zh: 在站内对 2020 年 2 月 19 日到 3 月 23 日的回放中，美股（SPY）下跌 33.7%。61 个策略里只有 3 个赚钱，58 个表现好于买入持有，但低点时有 38 个空仓，只有 3 个抓到了随后 39.9% 反弹的一半以上。

paragraphs.en: The site's event library defines the COVID-19 crash as a decline in SPY from 19 February to 23 March 2020. The data confirm the dates exactly: SPY fell 33.7% in 23 trading days, and its worst single day, 16 March, was -10.9%, the 18th trading day after the peak. The first close 10% below the peak came on 27 February, only 6 trading days in.
paragraphs.zh: 站内事件库把新冠暴跌定义为 SPY 从 2020 年 2 月 19 日到 3 月 23 日的下跌。数据验证了这两个日期：SPY 在 23 个交易日里下跌 33.7%，单日最大跌幅出现在 3 月 16 日，为 -10.9%，是高点之后的第 18 个交易日。收盘价第一次比高点低 10% 是 2 月 27 日，只过了 6 个交易日。

paragraphs.en: This article replays every strategy with SPY history over that window and asks four things: how many were already out before the worst of it, how deep each family's drawdown was, who was back in for the rebound, and what the same dates look like on gold and bitcoin. Results are walk-forward backtests on daily data, before trading costs. One strategy, COMBO-03, is left out because its code looks ahead, so the SPY sample is 61 strategies, not 62.
paragraphs.zh: 本文把有 SPY 历史的所有策略放进这个窗口回放，回答四个问题：有多少策略在最糟的阶段之前已经离场，各类策略的回撤有多深，谁在反弹时重新入场，以及同一时间窗口放到黄金和比特币上是什么样子。结果来自日线数据的滚动前推回测，未计交易成本。COMBO-03 的代码存在前视问题，所以被排除，SPY 样本是 61 个策略，而不是 62 个。

paragraphs.en: A strategy's return over the window is the change in its equity curve from the first to the last day. "In the market going in" is inferred, not recorded: the strategy's equity moved on at least one of the last three sessions up to the window start. "Rebound" means the 63 trading days after the low, the same window the site's event pages use. Families come from the strategy tags, and a strategy is counted in the first family that matches, in the order trend, momentum, mean reversion, volatility, other.
paragraphs.zh: 策略在窗口内的收益，是净值曲线从第一天到最后一天的变化。“起点时在场内”是推断出来的，不是记录：窗口起点之前最近三个交易日里，策略净值至少动过一次。“反弹”指低点之后的 63 个交易日，与站内事件页使用的窗口相同。策略类别来自策略标签，按趋势、动量、均值回归、波动率、其他的顺序，归入第一个匹配的类别。

paragraphs.en: I added two checkpoints with the same in-the-market test: the first close 10% below the peak (27 February) and the close before the worst day (13 March). Everything below is one event on one market, so treat it as a case study, not a statistical result.
paragraphs.zh: 我另外加了两个检查点，用同样的在场判断：收盘价第一次比高点低 10% 的那天（2 月 27 日），以及单日最大跌幅前一天的收盘（3 月 13 日）。以下全部是一个市场上的一次事件，应当当作个案研究，而不是统计结论。

paragraphs.en: Going in, 37 of the 61 strategies were in the market and 24 were out or flat. By the 27 February checkpoint, 25 were out, and 16 of the 37 that started in had already left. By 13 March, the close before the worst day, 30 were out and 22 of the original 37 had left.
paragraphs.zh: 起点时，61 个策略里 37 个在场内，24 个空仓或离场。到 2 月 27 日这个检查点，25 个已离场，起点在场内的 37 个里有 16 个已经走了。到 3 月 13 日，也就是最大单日跌幅的前一天，30 个离场，原来的 37 个里有 22 个已经走了。

paragraphs.en: The outcome was lopsided. 58 of 61 did better than SPY's 33.7% fall, the median strategy lost 7.6%, and its median drawdown inside the window was 8.7%. 26 strategies lost less than 5% or gained. Three finished with a gain: Linear Regression Channel (TREND-14, +33.9%), Crisis Alpha (TAIL-01, +25.7%), which in the code is short-only in high volatility, and Connors RSI (MR-16, +9.4%). Three more ended exactly flat: ADX Trend Filter (ADX-01), Elder Triple Screen (TREND-19) and Hurst-Filtered Mean Reversion (MR-07). The last of these computes no Hurst exponent, only a z-score with a low-volatility filter. At the other end, 17 lost more than 20%, and the worst, CCI Mean Reversion (MR-05), lost 35.4%, slightly more than SPY itself.
paragraphs.zh: 结果高度不均。61 个里有 58 个表现好于 SPY 的 33.7% 跌幅，中位数策略亏 7.6%，窗口内的回撤中位数是 8.7%。26 个策略亏损不到 5% 或者赚了钱。有三个策略收益为正：线性回归通道（Linear Regression Channel，TREND-14，+33.9%）、Crisis Alpha（TAIL-01，+25.7%，代码里只在高波动时做空），以及 Connors RSI（MR-16，+9.4%）。另外三个收益恰好为零：ADX Trend Filter（ADX-01）、Elder Triple Screen（TREND-19）和 Hurst-Filtered Mean Reversion（MR-07）。最后这个策略并不计算 Hurst 指数，只是 z-score 加低波动率过滤。另一端，17 个亏损超过 20%，最差的 CCI Mean Reversion（MR-05）亏了 35.4%，比 SPY 本身还略多。

heading.zh: 各类策略的回撤有多深

paragraphs.en: Median window return and median drawdown inside the window, with the number of strategies in each family:
paragraphs.zh: 各类别的窗口收益中位数和窗口内回撤中位数，括号里是该类的策略数量：

en: Trend (24 strategies): -4.7% and -6.1%; 4 were out going in; worst drawdown -33.7%.
Volatility (6): -6.7% and -6.7%; 2 out going in.
Other, including regime and tail-risk rules (12): -8.3% and -13.5%; 3 out going in.
Momentum (4): -12.1% and -14.5%; 1 out going in.
Mean reversion (15): -18.3% and -19.6%; 14 out going in; worst drawdown -35.4%.
zh: 波动率（6 个）：-6.7% 和 -6.7%；起点时 2 个在场外。
其他，包括状态识别和尾部风险规则（12 个）：-8.3% 和 -13.5%；起点时 3 个在场外。

paragraphs.en: Two things stand out. Trend strategies were mostly in on 19 February (20 of 24) yet lost the least: 15 of those 20 had left by 13 March. Mean reversion shows the opposite pattern. 14 of 15 were out at the start, yet this family lost the most, and 9 of 15 were holding at the low. Being out going in did not protect them: with 9 of 15 holding at the low, their entries evidently triggered during the fall.
paragraphs.zh: 有两点值得注意。趋势策略在 2 月 19 日大多在场内（24 个里 20 个），亏得却最少：这 20 个里有 15 个在 3 月 13 日之前已经离场。均值回归正好相反：15 个里 14 个起点时在场外，这一类却亏得最多，低点时还有 9 个持仓。起点时在场外并没有保护它们：低点时 15 个里有 9 个持仓，说明它们的入场信号显然是在下跌过程中触发的。

paragraphs.en: At the low, 23 strategies were in the market and 38 were flat. By 10 sessions later, 8 of the 38 had re-entered; by 21 sessions, 20 had, and 18 were still flat. Over the next 63 sessions, the median of those that re-entered by 21 sessions gained 9.8%, the median of those still flat gained 0.0%, and the median of those already holding at the low gained 12.2%. SPY gained 39.9%.
paragraphs.zh: 低点时，23 个策略在场内，38 个空仓。10 个交易日后，这 38 个里有 8 个重新入场；21 个交易日后有 20 个，仍有 18 个空仓。之后的 63 个交易日里，21 个交易日内重新入场的策略收益中位数是 9.8%，仍然空仓的是 0.0%，低点时就持仓的是 12.2%。SPY 涨了 39.9%。

paragraphs.en: So nobody caught the rebound. 3 strategies captured at least half of it (Kalman Filter Mean Reversion MR-03, Monthly Seasonality SEAS-01 and Triple Moving Average TREND-13), and two of those, SEAS-01 and TREND-13, had lost 33.7% on the way down, the same as SPY, so they had effectively stayed fully invested. 24 captured between a quarter and a half, and 34 captured under a quarter, including 8 that made exactly nothing and 7 that lost money. Only 1 beat the market's rebound. The trend family had 1 of 24 above half and 15 under a quarter.
paragraphs.zh: 所以没有人真正抓住这轮反弹。只有 3 个策略抓到了至少一半（Kalman Filter Mean Reversion MR-03、Monthly Seasonality SEAS-01 和 Triple Moving Average TREND-13），其中 SEAS-01 和 TREND-13 下跌时已经亏了 33.7%，与 SPY 相同，等于一直满仓。24 个抓到四分之一到一半，34 个不到四分之一，其中 8 个一分没赚，7 个还亏了钱。只有 1 个跑赢了市场的反弹。趋势类 24 个里 1 个超过一半，15 个不到四分之一。

paragraphs.en: The two best crash performers paid for it: TREND-14 went from +33.9% to -16.4% in the 63 sessions after the low, and TAIL-01 from +25.7% to -27.9%. Measured from the peak to 63 sessions after the low, SPY was down 7.2%; 38 of 61 strategies beat that, with a median of -3.0%.
paragraphs.zh: 两个危机期间表现最好的策略付出了代价：TREND-14 在低点后的 63 个交易日里从 +33.9% 变成 -16.4%，TAIL-01 从 +25.7% 变成 -27.9%。从高点算到低点后 63 个交易日，SPY 是 -7.2%；61 个策略里 38 个比这个好，中位数是 -3.0%。

heading.en: The same replay on gold and bitcoin
heading.zh: 同样的回放放到黄金和比特币上

paragraphs.en: Same calendar dates, 55 strategies on each market (COMBO-03 again excluded).
paragraphs.zh: 日期相同，每个市场 55 个策略（同样排除 COMBO-03）。

paragraphs.en: Gold fell only 3.6% over the window, though its drawdown inside it reached 12.5%, and it rose 12.8% over the next 63 sessions. 34 strategies were in going in and 21 out. 13 made money, the median lost 3.6%, nobody lost more than 8.7%, and only 29 of 55 lost less than buy-and-hold. The trend family's median was -6.1%, worse than gold itself, while mean reversion's median was +1.1% with 13 of 14 out at the start. 23 of 34 flat-at-the-low strategies re-entered within 21 sessions; 18 of 55 captured half or more of gold's rebound, and 3 beat it.
paragraphs.zh: 黄金在窗口内只跌了 3.6%，不过窗口内的回撤达到 12.5%，之后 63 个交易日上涨 12.8%。起点时 34 个策略在场内，21 个在场外。13 个赚了钱，中位数亏 3.6%，没有人亏超过 8.7%，55 个里只有 29 个亏得比买入持有少。趋势类的中位数是 -6.1%，比黄金本身还差；均值回归类的中位数是 +1.1%，起点时 14 个里有 13 个在场外。低点时空仓的 34 个里有 23 个在 21 个交易日内重新入场；55 个里有 18 个抓到了黄金反弹的一半以上，3 个跑赢了反弹。

paragraphs.en: Bitcoin fell 33.4% over the window with a drawdown inside it of 49.9%, then rose 38.8% over the next 63 sessions. 31 were in going in and 24 out; only 22 were in before SPY's worst day. 7 made money (TREND-14 +24.0%, Volatility Regime Strategy VOL-13 +23.4%, TAIL-01 +18.8% led), the median lost 5.8%, 16 lost more than 20% and the worst lost 40.8%. Mean reversion again fared worst (median -24.7%, 11 of 14 out going in). Re-entry mattered more here: the 11 of 30 flat-at-the-low strategies that re-entered within 21 sessions gained a median 22.1% afterwards, against 0.0% for those still flat. 14 of 55 captured half or more of the rebound and none beat it.
paragraphs.zh: 比特币在窗口内下跌 33.4%，窗口内的回撤达 49.9%，随后 63 个交易日上涨 38.8%。起点时 31 个在场内，24 个在场外；SPY 最大单日跌幅之前只有 22 个在场内。7 个赚了钱（TREND-14 +24.0%、Volatility Regime Strategy VOL-13 +23.4%、TAIL-01 +18.8% 居前），中位数亏 5.8%，16 个亏超过 20%，最差的亏了 40.8%。均值回归类再次表现最差（中位数 -24.7%，14 个里 11 个起点时在场外）。这里重新入场更重要：低点时空仓的 30 个里，21 个交易日内重新入场的 11 个，之后的收益中位数是 22.1%，仍然空仓的是 0.0%。55 个里 14 个抓到了反弹的一半以上，没有一个跑赢反弹。

heading.en: What the numbers cannot tell you
heading.zh: 这些数字说明不了什么

paragraphs.en: This is one event on one set of dates, set by the site rather than chosen by each strategy. A different start, a few days earlier or later, would change which strategies count as in the market. The in-the-market test is inferred from equity moves, and a strategy that holds a position that happens not to move would be misread. Family medians hide wide ranges inside families: the trend family contains both the best result and several that lost the full 33.7%. And the replay uses walk-forward results with no trading costs.
paragraphs.zh: 这只是一个事件、一组日期，而且日期由站内设定，而不是每个策略自己选的。起点早几天或晚几天，就会改变哪些策略算在场内。“在场”是靠净值变化推断的，持仓但净值恰好没有变动的策略会被误判。类别中位数掩盖了类内的巨大差异：趋势类里既有最好的结果，也有几个亏了整整 33.7% 的。另外，回放用的是滚动前推结果，不含交易成本。

en: On SPY, 58 of 61 strategies did better than buy-and-hold in the window, but only 3 gained and median loss was 7.6%.
Family matters: trend lost a median 4.7%, mean reversion 18.3%, even though 14 of 15 mean-reversion strategies were out at the start.
Leaving early cost the rebound: 38 strategies were flat at the low, and only 3 recaptured half of the 39.9% bounce.
The best crash results were followed by the worst rebounds (TREND-14, TAIL-01).
On gold the same rules protected less than on stocks (29 of 55 beat buy-and-hold); on bitcoin the drawdown inside the window was 49.9%, deeper than the 33.4% end-to-end figure.
zh: 在 SPY 上，61 个策略里 58 个窗口内表现好于买入持有，但只有 3 个赚钱，亏损中位数是 7.6%。
类别差异很大：趋势类中位数亏 4.7%，均值回归类亏 18.3%，尽管 15 个均值回归策略里 14 个起点时在场外。
提前离场损失了反弹：低点时 38 个策略空仓，只有 3 个抓到了 39.9% 反弹的一半。
危机中最好的结果之后是最差的反弹表现（TREND-14、TAIL-01）。
在黄金上，同样的规则保护更少（55 个里 29 个跑赢买入持有）；在比特币上，窗口内回撤达 49.9%，比首尾 33.4% 的跌幅更深。

title.en: 60/40, All Weather, Dual Momentum: 22 Famous Rules Replicated
title.zh: 60/40、全天候、双动量：22 个著名组合与规则的复刻

summary.en: Replicated on the site's markets since 2010, the best return per unit of drawdown among the 22 famous portfolios and rules came from a Stage 2 trend rule (0.89), but without its bitcoin slot it falls to 0.39. The fixed-weight 60/40-style, All Weather-style and 90/10 mixes all landed at 0.41 to 0.42, the same as holding SPY.
summary.zh: 把 22 个著名组合与规则放到站内的市场上，从 2010 年起复刻，每单位回撤换来的收益最高的是一个 Stage 2 趋势规则（0.89），但去掉它的比特币仓位后降到 0.39。60/40 式、全天候式和 90/10 式的固定权重组合都落在 0.41 到 0.42，与持有 SPY 相同。

paragraphs.en: Famous portfolios are usually quoted with their original ingredients: bonds, futures, stock selection, leverage. The site only trades ten markets (SPY, gold, silver, oil, natural gas, broad commodities, agriculture, EUR/USD, bitcoin, ether) and has no bond market. So what do these portfolios look like once they are rebuilt from what is available?
paragraphs.zh: 著名组合通常连同原始成分一起被引用：债券、期货、选股、杠杆。站内只交易十个市场（SPY、黄金、白银、原油、天然气、综合大宗商品、农产品、欧元/美元、比特币、以太坊），没有债券市场。那么，用现有材料重建之后，这些组合会是什么样子？

paragraphs.en: The site's data file defines 22 of them. Each is run as a fixed-weight allocation or as a daily rule on SPY or on several markets, before trading costs, with positions decided at the close earning the next day's return. The fixed-weight mixes built on SPY start on 4 January 2010 (16.9 years, 4,241 days); the rule sets start when their first signal is valid, from 2010 to April 2015. Results run to 11 November 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 站内的数据文件定义了其中 22 个。每个要么按固定权重配置，要么按每日规则运行在 SPY 或多个市场上，未计交易成本，收盘时决定的仓位获得次日收益。以 SPY 为基础的固定权重组合从 2010 年 1 月 4 日开始（16.9 年，4,241 个交易日）；规则类组合从第一个有效信号开始，起点在 2010 年到 2015 年 4 月之间。结果截至 2026 年 11 月 11 日。

paragraphs.en: The site labels every replication. Five are "full": Connors RSI(2) (the site's RSI(2) pullback rule on SPY), a 100% SPY buy-and-hold, bitcoin buy-and-hold, the Halloween rule (SPY from the end of October to the end of April, cash otherwise) and a turn-of-the-month rule. Fourteen are "adapted": 60/40, All Weather, Permanent Portfolio, Golden Butterfly, Buffett 90/10, Faber's 10-month rule, a one-leg dual momentum, both Turtle systems, O'Neil's new-high rule, Weinstein's Stage 2, Clenow's trend rule, 12-month time-series momentum and 10% volatility targeting. Three are "interpretation", meaning the site's own reading of a loosely specified method: Livermore, a 200-day average attributed to Paul Tudor Jones, and the Mayer multiple on bitcoin.
paragraphs.zh: 站内给每个复刻都打了标签。5 个是“完整”（full）：Connors RSI(2)（站内在 SPY 上的 RSI(2) 回撤规则）、100% SPY 买入持有、比特币买入持有、万圣节规则（10 月底到次年 4 月底持有 SPY，其余时间持有现金）以及月初月末规则。14 个是“改造”（adapted）：60/40、全天候、永久组合、金蝴蝶、巴菲特 90/10、Faber 的 10 个月规则、单腿双动量、两个海龟系统、O'Neil 的新高规则、Weinstein 的 Stage 2、Clenow 的趋势规则、12 个月时间序列动量和 10% 目标波动率。3 个是“解读”（interpretation），指站内对说法含糊的方法所做的自己的理解：Livermore、归于 Paul Tudor Jones 的 200 日均线规则，以及比特币的 Mayer 倍数。

paragraphs.en: All descriptions are as defined on the site. Two kinds of adaptation matter most. First, bonds become cash earning 0%: 40% of the 60/40 mix, 55% of All Weather, 50% of Permanent Portfolio, 40% of Golden Butterfly and 10% of Buffett 90/10. Second, futures strategies are rebuilt on ten ETF, FX and crypto markets with long-only positions and a fixed slot per market, instead of volatility-based sizing.
paragraphs.zh: 所有描述都以站内的定义为准。最重要的改造有两类。第一，债券换成收益为 0% 的现金：60/40 里占 40%，全天候占 55%，永久组合占 50%，金蝴蝶占 40%，巴菲特 90/10 占 10%。第二，期货策略被重建到十个 ETF、外汇和加密市场上，只做多，每个市场固定一份仓位，而不是按波动率定仓。

paragraphs.en: Each is rebalanced at the last close of every year; figures are annualised return (CAGR), volatility, maximum drawdown and worst calendar year, 2010 to 2026, with 16 full years:
paragraphs.zh: 每个组合在每年最后一个交易日收盘时再平衡；数字依次是年化收益（CAGR）、波动率、最大回撤和最差日历年，区间 2010 到 2026 年，共 16 个完整年份：

en: All Weather-style (30% SPY, 7.5% gold, 7.5% broad commodities, 55% cash): 5.3%, 5.9%, -12.5%, -4.1%.
Permanent Portfolio-style (25% SPY, 25% gold, 50% cash): 5.8%, 6.3%, -10.3%, -4.7%.
Golden Butterfly-style (40% SPY, 20% gold, 40% cash): 7.5%, 7.7%, -14.6%, -7.4%.

paragraphs.en: In every case the worst year was 2022. These are dilutions of SPY with cash and gold, so smaller drawdowns mostly reflect how much of the portfolio sat in cash.
paragraphs.zh: 每个组合最差的一年都是 2022 年。这些组合本质上是把 SPY 用现金和黄金稀释，回撤变小主要反映的是现金占了多少。

paragraphs.en: Rules on one market: the one-leg dual momentum (SPY or cash on a positive 12-month return, from January 2011) returned 10.8% with a -33.7% drawdown, the same as SPY, so it did not avoid the 2020 crash. The 200-day average rule returned 10.6% with a -19.8% drawdown and a -14.9% worst year. The 10% volatility target returned 9.6% with -12.8%. Connors RSI(2) was invested only 11.9% of the time on average and returned 4.3% (-14.7%). The Halloween rule returned 7.8% (-33.7%) and the turn-of-the-month rule 3.3% (-13.8%).
paragraphs.zh: 单一市场规则：单腿双动量（12 个月收益为正则持有 SPY，否则持有现金，从 2011 年 1 月开始）收益 10.8%，最大回撤 -33.7%，与 SPY 相同，说明它没有躲过 2020 年的暴跌。200 日均线规则收益 10.6%，回撤 -19.8%，最差年份 -14.9%。10% 目标波动率收益 9.6%，回撤 -12.8%。Connors RSI(2) 平均只有 11.9% 的时间在持仓，收益 4.3%（回撤 -14.7%）。万圣节规则收益 7.8%（-33.7%），月初月末规则 3.3%（-13.8%）。

paragraphs.en: Rules on several markets: Weinstein's Stage 2 on six markets returned 13.8% (-15.5%, worst year -11.1%); Turtle System 1 and 2 returned 8.3% and 8.1% (-15.9% and -13.5%); Clenow's trend rule 5.5% (-8.9%, worst year -2.0%), investing on average just 14.6%; O'Neil's rule 10.1% (-26.5%); 12-month time-series momentum 8.6% (-21.4%); Faber's 10-month rule 5.9% (-16.3%); the Livermore interpretation 5.7% (-23.7%). Bitcoin buy-and-hold returned 52.0% with a -83.4% drawdown over 12.2 years, and the Mayer-multiple rule 63.0% with -78.7%.
paragraphs.zh: 多市场规则：六个市场上的 Weinstein Stage 2 收益 13.8%（-15.5%，最差年份 -11.1%）；海龟系统 1 和 2 分别为 8.3% 和 8.1%（-15.9% 和 -13.5%）；Clenow 趋势规则 5.5%（-8.9%，最差年份 -2.0%），平均仅持仓 14.6%；O'Neil 规则 10.1%（-26.5%）；12 个月时间序列动量 8.6%（-21.4%）；Faber 的 10 个月规则 5.9%（-16.3%）；Livermore 的解读版 5.7%（-23.7%）。比特币买入持有在 12.2 年里收益 52.0%，回撤 -83.4%；Mayer 倍数规则收益 63.0%，回撤 -78.7%。

heading.en: Best return per unit of drawdown
heading.zh: 每单位回撤的最佳收益

paragraphs.en: Dividing CAGR by the absolute maximum drawdown, SPY scores 0.41. On each portfolio's own history the top five were Weinstein's Stage 2 (0.89), the Mayer multiple (0.80, 11.6 years of bitcoin only), the volatility target (0.75), bitcoin buy-and-hold (0.62) and Clenow's rule (0.62). At the bottom were the Halloween rule (0.23), turn-of-the-month (0.24) and the Livermore interpretation (0.24).
paragraphs.zh: 用 CAGR 除以最大回撤的绝对值，SPY 得分 0.41。按各自的历史区间，前五名是 Weinstein Stage 2（0.89）、Mayer 倍数（0.80，只有 11.6 年的比特币数据）、目标波动率（0.75）、比特币买入持有（0.62）和 Clenow 规则（0.62）。垫底的是万圣节规则（0.23）、月初月末规则（0.24）和 Livermore 解读版（0.24）。

paragraphs.en: Because start dates differ, I also ran the 20 portfolios that do not rely on bitcoin alone from a common start of 31 January 2011 (15.8 years). Weinstein's Stage 2 still led (0.84), then the volatility target (0.72), Clenow's rule and Turtle System 2 (0.62 each), Turtle System 1 and Permanent Portfolio (0.55 each), the 200-day average (0.52) and Golden Butterfly (0.50). 60/40, All Weather and Buffett 90/10 scored 0.41, level with SPY. Of the 20 (SPY itself is one), 11 beat SPY on this measure, and none of the other 19 beat its CAGR. By label, the median score was 0.26 for the 4 "full" portfolios, 0.46 for the 14 "adapted" and 0.37 for the 2 "interpretation" ones, too few in each group to read a pattern.
paragraphs.zh: 因为起点不同，我又把不单靠比特币的 20 个组合放到共同的起点 2011 年 1 月 31 日重算（15.8 年）。Weinstein Stage 2 仍然第一（0.84），其后是目标波动率（0.72）、Clenow 规则和海龟系统 2（各 0.62）、海龟系统 1 和永久组合（各 0.55）、200 日均线（0.52）和金蝴蝶（0.50）。60/40、全天候和巴菲特 90/10 都是 0.41，与 SPY 持平。20 个（SPY 本身是其中之一）里有 11 个在这个指标上胜过 SPY，其余 19 个没有一个在 CAGR 上胜过它。按标签看，4 个“完整”组合的得分中位数是 0.26，14 个“改造”的是 0.46，2 个“解读”的是 0.37，每组样本太少，看不出规律。

heading.en: The part that depends on crypto
heading.zh: 依赖加密货币的那部分

paragraphs.en: Rules on ten markets include bitcoin and ether, which only entered the data in September 2014 and November 2017. Holding the crypto slots in cash and keeping everything else identical gives:
paragraphs.zh: 十个市场的规则里包含比特币和以太坊，它们分别从 2014 年 9 月和 2017 年 11 月才进入数据。把加密货币那份仓位改成现金，其余完全不变，结果是：

en: Weinstein's Stage 2 (1 crypto slot of 6): CAGR 13.8% falls to 5.8%, and return per drawdown from 0.89 to 0.39.
Turtle System 1 (2 of 10): 8.3% to 1.4%; Turtle System 2: 8.1% to 2.4%.
Clenow's rule: 5.5% to 1.5%. O'Neil's rule: 10.1% to 3.0%. 12-month momentum: 8.6% to 2.3%. Livermore interpretation: 5.7% to 1.0%.
zh: Weinstein Stage 2（6 份里 1 份是加密）：CAGR 从 13.8% 降到 5.8%，每单位回撤的收益从 0.89 降到 0.39。
Clenow 规则：5.5% 降到 1.5%。O'Neil 规则：10.1% 降到 3.0%。12 个月动量：8.6% 降到 2.3%。Livermore 解读版：5.7% 降到 1.0%。

paragraphs.en: So the high scores of the multi-market rules are largely a bitcoin and ether result over a sample that contains a few very large moves. Without them, the best of these scored 0.39.
paragraphs.zh: 所以多市场规则的高分，很大程度上是比特币和以太坊的结果，而这段样本里只有少数几次极大的行情。去掉它们之后，这些规则里最好的得分是 0.39。

heading.en: What the adaptations mean for comparing with the originals
heading.zh: 改造对和原版比较意味着什么

paragraphs.en: Replacing bonds with cash changes the character of a portfolio, so the figures for 60/40, All Weather and Permanent Portfolio are not the originals' figures, and the originals' bond income and their behaviour when stocks and bonds diverge are missing. The All Weather-style mix here is also unlevered. The 0.41 to 0.42 scores for 60/40, All Weather and Buffett 90/10 say only that diluting SPY with cash scaled return and drawdown together, not that those portfolios are equal. Gold lifted Permanent Portfolio (0.56) and Golden Butterfly (0.51) above that.
paragraphs.zh: 把债券换成现金，改变了组合的性格，所以 60/40、全天候和永久组合的数字并不是原版的数字，原版的债券收益，以及股债走势分化时的表现，在这里都缺失。这里的全天候式组合也没有杠杆。60/40、全天候和巴菲特 90/10 的 0.41 到 0.42，只能说明用现金稀释 SPY 会让收益和回撤一起缩小，并不说明这些组合彼此相当。黄金把永久组合（0.56）和金蝴蝶（0.51）抬到了这个水平之上。

paragraphs.en: Rule sets lose stock selection, shorting, futures breadth and volatility sizing, so Turtle, Clenow and O'Neil here are simplified relatives. The "interpretation" ones are the site's reading, not a published rule. The site's definitions were compiled from general knowledge and are used as given, not checked against the original sources.
paragraphs.zh: 规则类组合失去了选股、做空、期货的广度和按波动率定仓，所以这里的海龟、Clenow 和 O'Neil 都只是原版的简化亲戚。“解读”类是站内自己的理解，不是公开发表的规则。站内的定义整理自一般知识，这里照原样使用，没有对照原始来源核实。

en: Return per unit of drawdown (CAGR divided by maximum drawdown): SPY 0.41; 60/40-style 0.41; All Weather-style 0.42; Permanent-style 0.56; the best multi-market rule 0.89, falling to 0.39 without crypto.
Over the common 15.8 years, none of the other 19 portfolios beat SPY's 13.9% CAGR; the smoother ones gave up return for smaller drawdowns.
Bond-to-cash substitution makes the allocation results mostly SPY-with-cash and gold; read them as such.
Dual momentum here is one leg only and matched SPY's -33.7% maximum drawdown.
Labels matter: 5 full, 14 adapted, 3 interpretation. Most of the 22 are simplified relatives of the original.
zh: 每单位回撤的收益（CAGR 除以最大回撤）：SPY 0.41；60/40 式 0.41；全天候式 0.42；永久组合式 0.56；最好的多市场规则 0.89，去掉加密货币后降到 0.39。
在共同的 15.8 年里，其余 19 个组合没有一个跑赢 SPY 的 13.9% CAGR；更平滑的那些用收益换来了更小的回撤。
债券换成现金之后，配置类的结果基本就是“SPY 加现金和黄金”，应当这样理解。
这里的双动量只有一条腿，最大回撤 -33.7%，与 SPY 相同。
标签很重要：5 个完整，14 个改造，3 个解读。22 个里大多数是原版的简化版本。

title.en: Golden Cross and Death Cross Tested on Ten Markets
title.zh: 金叉与死叉在 10 个市场的实测

summary.en: A long-only 50/200 moving-average rule beat buy-and-hold on return in 7 of 10 markets and cut the maximum drawdown in 9, but it did not help US stocks, gold or bitcoin, and no market showed a statistically clear edge after either cross (107 golden and 106 death crosses in total, before costs).
summary.zh: 只做多的 50/200 均线规则在 10 个市场中有 7 个跑赢买入持有，9 个的最大回撤更小；但对美股、黄金和比特币没有帮助，两种交叉之后都没有任何市场出现统计上清晰的优势（共 107 次金叉、106 次死叉，未扣交易成本）。

paragraphs.en: A golden cross is the day the 50-day simple average of closing prices rises above the 200-day average. A death cross is the day it falls below. The popular reading is that a golden cross is bullish and a death cross is bearish.
paragraphs.zh: 金叉是指 50 日简单均线（收盘价）上穿 200 日均线的那一天，死叉则是下穿。通常的说法是：金叉看多，死叉看空。

paragraphs.en: To make that testable, the rule is: hold the market from the day after the 50-day average closes above the 200-day average, and hold cash from the day after it closes below. There is no stop-loss, no position sizing, cash earns nothing and trading costs are not included. The site's Dual Moving Average (TREND-05) uses the same 50/200 state in its code, although its description mentions volatility filters and ATR sizing that the code does not contain.
paragraphs.zh: 为了能检验，规则被写成：50 日均线收于 200 日均线之上的次日起持有，收于其下的次日起持有现金。没有止损，没有仓位管理，现金不计收益，也不含交易成本。本站的 Dual Moving Average（TREND-05）代码中用的是同一个 50/200 状态，尽管它的描述里提到了波动率过滤和 ATR 仓位，代码里并没有这些。

paragraphs.en: The claim checker runs the rule on ten markets: US stocks, gold, silver, oil, natural gas, broad commodities, agriculture, EUR/USD, bitcoin and ether. A position decided at the close of day t earns the return of day t+1, and the averages on day t use closes up to day t only.
paragraphs.zh: Claim Checker 在 10 个市场上运行这条规则：美股、黄金、白银、原油、天然气、综合大宗商品、农产品、欧元/美元、比特币和以太坊。第 t 日收盘做出的持仓赚取第 t+1 日的收益，第 t 日的均线只用到第 t 日为止的收盘价。

paragraphs.en: The first 200 days warm up the average, so the tested period is 2010-10-18 to 2026-11-11 for most markets, 2010-10-07 for EUR/USD, 2015-04-04 for bitcoin and 2018-05-27 for ether. Three questions were asked: how the long-only rule compares with buy-and-hold, whether days spent in the golden state earned more than days outside it, and what the 63 trading days after each cross looked like.
paragraphs.zh: 前 200 天用来预热均线，所以大多数市场的测试区间是 2010-10-18 至 2026-11-11，欧元/美元从 2010-10-07 开始，比特币从 2015-04-04，以太坊从 2018-05-27。检验了三个问题：只做多规则与买入持有相比如何；处于金叉状态的日子是否比其余日子赚得多；每次交叉之后的 63 个交易日是什么样子。

heading.zh: 与买入持有相比：收益与回撤

paragraphs.en: Over those periods the rule had a higher annual return than buy-and-hold in 7 of 10 markets and a higher Sharpe ratio in 6. The maximum drawdown was smaller in 9 of 10 markets and at least a quarter smaller in 5. All figures are before trading costs.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些区间内，规则的年化收益在 10 个市场中有 7 个高于买入持有，夏普比率有 6 个更高。最大回撤在 9 个市场更小，其中 5 个至少缩小了四分之一。以下数字均未扣交易成本。

en: **Natural gas (2010-10-18 to 2026-11-11):** buy-and-hold lost 23.2% a year with a -98.9% maximum drawdown; the rule lost 2.1% a year with a -49.7% drawdown, in the market only 25% of days, over 9 entries.
**Oil:** -1.4% a year against -4.4%, with a drawdown of -70.8% against -95.3%.
**Ether (2018-05-27 to 2026-11-11):** 23.5% a year against 16.3%, drawdown -78.0% against -86.4%, over 9 entries.
**US stocks:** 9.7% a year against 14.3%, Sharpe 0.72 against 0.87, and the same -33.7% drawdown. It was in the market 84% of days with 8 entries.
**Gold:** 5.0% against 6.4% a year, Sharpe 0.43 against 0.45, drawdown -35.1% against -45.6%.
**Bitcoin (2015-04-04 to 2026-11-11):** 52.3% against 63.1% a year, Sharpe 0.87 against 0.90, drawdown -69.2% against -83.4%.
zh: **美股：** 年化 9.7%，买入持有 14.3%；夏普 0.72 对 0.87；最大回撤同为 -33.7%。84% 的交易日在场内，共 8 次入场。

paragraphs.en: The pattern is that the rule helped most where buy-and-hold was poor (natural gas, oil, agriculture at 1.9% against 0.4%). In US stocks and bitcoin, where holding was rewarded, it trailed.
paragraphs.zh: 规律是：买入持有表现差的市场（天然气、原油、农产品的 1.9% 对 0.4%）规则帮助最大；在持有本身就有回报的美股和比特币上，规则落后。

paragraphs.en: Across the ten markets there were 107 golden crosses and 106 death crosses, from 7 to 17 per market and 7 of each for US stocks. For the forward-return test, events had to be at least 63 trading days apart, which left 104 golden and 103 death events (period 2010-01-01 to 2026-11-11; bitcoin from 2014-09-17, ether from 2017-11-09).
paragraphs.zh: 10 个市场合计出现 107 次金叉和 106 次死叉，每个市场 7 到 17 次，美股金叉、死叉各 7 次。做远期收益检验时，要求事件之间至少相隔 63 个交易日，因此剩下 104 次金叉和 103 次死叉事件（区间 2010-01-01 至 2026-11-11；比特币从 2014-09-17，以太坊从 2017-11-09）。

paragraphs.en: After a golden cross the average 63-day return was above the market's average 63-day return on all days in 6 of 10 markets and below it in 4. It was negative in 3: broad commodities (-3.3%, 11 events), agriculture (-1.5%, 9 events) and EUR/USD (-0.1%, 12 events). The best-looking cases were natural gas (+12.9% against -4.4% on all days, 9 events) and bitcoin (+23.0% against +13.5%, 11 events).
paragraphs.zh: 金叉之后，63 日平均收益高于该市场所有交易日平均 63 日收益的市场有 6 个，低于的有 4 个。其中 3 个为负：综合大宗商品（-3.3%，11 次事件）、农产品（-1.5%，9 次）和欧元/美元（-0.1%，12 次）。看上去最漂亮的是天然气（+12.9%，全部交易日为 -4.4%，9 次事件）和比特币（+23.0%，全部交易日为 +13.5%，11 次事件）。

paragraphs.en: After a death cross, the average 63-day return was above the all-days average in 4 markets and below it in 6, but 6 of 10 markets still averaged a positive 63-day return after the bearish signal. No market showed a statistically clear difference after either cross: none had the 20 events the checker requires, and the largest sample was 17 (oil, golden cross).
paragraphs.zh: 死叉之后，平均 63 日收益高于全部交易日均值的市场有 4 个，低于的有 6 个；但仍有 6 个市场在这个看空信号之后平均 63 日收益为正。两种交叉之后，都没有任何市场出现统计上清晰的差异：没有一个市场达到检验要求的 20 次事件，样本最大的是原油（金叉，17 次）。

heading.en: Where it clearly did not help
heading.zh: 它明显没帮上忙的地方

paragraphs.en: US stocks give the plainest case. The 2020 fall from 2020-02-19 to 2020-03-23 was -33.7%, and the rule was long on all 23 trading days of that window, so its maximum drawdown was identical to buy-and-hold. The death cross arrived on 2020-03-31, after the low, and the next 63 trading days returned +20.2%.
paragraphs.zh: 美股是最清楚的例子。2020-02-19 至 2020-03-23 的下跌为 -33.7%，规则在这个窗口的 23 个交易日里全程持多，所以最大回撤和买入持有完全一样。死叉出现在 2020-03-31，已在低点之后，随后 63 个交易日上涨 +20.2%。

paragraphs.en: That was not unusual. Of the 7 death crosses in US stocks (2011-08-17 to 2025-04-16), 6 were followed by gains over the next 63 trading days, averaging +8.3% across all seven; only the one on 2022-03-16 was followed by a fall (-12.7%). Calendar 2022 was where the rule did help: -8.3% against -18.2% for buy-and-hold.
paragraphs.zh: 这并不是个例。美股的 7 次死叉（2011-08-17 至 2025-04-16）中，有 6 次之后 63 个交易日是上涨的，7 次平均 +8.3%；只有 2022-03-16 那次之后下跌（-12.7%）。规则真正起作用的是 2022 自然年：-8.3%，买入持有 -18.2%。

paragraphs.en: The second problem is short-lived signals. Of the 107 golden states, 28 lasted fewer than 63 trading days (a state still running at the end of the data is counted by its length so far). Each of those is a round trip that in practice would cost spread and commission, which this test leaves out.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个问题是短命的信号。107 个金叉状态中，有 28 个持续不到 63 个交易日（数据结束时仍在持续的状态按目前已持续的长度计算）。每一个都是一次来回，实际交易中要付出点差和佣金，而本测试没有计入。

heading.en: What the numbers cannot tell you
heading.zh: 这些数字说明不了什么

paragraphs.en: The claim checker's verdict is "partly". In 8 of 10 markets, days in the golden state earned more than days outside it, with a median gap of +7.9% a year, but in none was the gap statistically clear (|t| of at least 2). Over all ten markets the rule made 112 entries, between 8 and 17 per market, so every market result rests on a handful of regime changes.
paragraphs.zh: Claim Checker 的结论是“部分成立”。8 个市场里，处于金叉状态的日子收益高于其余日子，年化差距中位数为 +7.9%，但没有一个市场的差距在统计上清晰（|t| 至少为 2）。10 个市场合计入场 112 次，每个市场 8 到 17 次，所以每个市场的结果都只建立在寥寥几次行情转换上。

paragraphs.en: The ten markets are not independent, they share one 2010-2026 history with a long US bull market and a long commodity slump, and bitcoin and ether cover only the periods listed above. The site's own Dual Moving Average (TREND-05) lands in the same place on its full stored history: its Sharpe ratio is above buy-and-hold in 6 of 10 markets, the same count as this test.
paragraphs.zh: 这 10 个市场并不独立：它们共享 2010–2026 这段历史，其中有漫长的美股牛市和漫长的大宗商品低迷，比特币和以太坊只覆盖上面列出的区间。本站自己的 Dual Moving Average（TREND-05）在其完整的存档历史上也是同一个结论：夏普高于买入持有的市场有 6 个，与本测试的数量相同。

en: As a long-only filter, 50/200 mostly reduced drawdown in markets that fell (natural gas, oil, agriculture), not in US stocks, where the -33.7% 2020 drawdown was untouched.
Neither cross was a reliable forecast: after a golden cross, 4 of 10 markets did worse than their average, and 6 of 10 still gained on average after a death cross.
With 7 to 17 crosses per market, no result here is statistically clear, and trading costs are not included.
zh: 作为只做多的过滤器，50/200 主要降低了下跌市场（天然气、原油、农产品）的回撤，对美股没有作用，2020 年 -33.7% 的回撤原封不动。
两种交叉都不是可靠的预测：金叉之后有 4 个市场表现不如自身平均水平，死叉之后仍有 6 个市场平均上涨。
每个市场只有 7 到 17 次交叉，这里没有任何结果在统计上清晰，而且未计入交易成本。

title.en: Which Trading Sayings Hold Up? A Scorecard of 34 Claims
title.zh: 哪些交易谚语经得起检验？34 条说法的成绩单

summary.en: Of 34 popular trading sayings tested on up to ten markets (2010-2026, before costs), 1 holds, 11 partly hold, 19 do not hold and 3 lack data; most of the survivors describe risk, not a way to predict returns.
summary.zh: 34 条流行的交易谚语在最多 10 个市场上测试（2010–2026，未扣成本）：1 条成立，11 条部分成立，19 条不成立，3 条数据不足；留下来的大多描述的是风险，而不是预测收益的办法。

paragraphs.en: The site's claim checker turns 34 trading sayings into mechanical tests: golden crosses, the 200-day average, buying dips, RSI levels, calendar effects, dollar-cost averaging, gold as a hedge, bitcoin as digital gold, and so on. Each is run on up to ten markets: US stocks, gold, silver, oil, natural gas, broad commodities, agriculture, EUR/USD, bitcoin and ether, using daily data from 2010 where available (bitcoin and ether start later) up to 2026-11-11.
paragraphs.zh: 本站的 Claim Checker 把 34 条交易谚语变成机械化的检验：金叉、200 日均线、抄底、RSI 水平、日历效应、定投、黄金避险、比特币是数字黄金，等等。每一条都在最多 10 个市场上运行：美股、黄金、白银、原油、天然气、综合大宗商品、农产品、欧元/美元、比特币和以太坊，使用 2010 年起的日线数据（比特币和以太坊起点更晚），截至 2026-11-11。

paragraphs.en: All results are before trading costs, and cash earns nothing. A market counts as a clear and stable pass only if the effect is statistically visible (|t| of at least 2, with at least 20 independent events) and points the claimed way in both halves of its history. A claim "holds" if at least 60% of its usable markets pass, with few contradictions.
paragraphs.zh: 所有结果均未扣交易成本，现金不计收益。只有当效应在统计上可见（|t| 至少为 2，且至少 20 次独立事件），并且在该市场历史的前后两半都指向所说的方向时，这个市场才算“清晰且稳定”地通过。一条说法要“成立”，需要至少 60% 的可用市场通过，且反例很少。

en: **Partly holds:** 11 of 34 (32%)
**Does not hold:** 19 of 34 (56%)
**Not enough data:** 3 of 34 (9%)
zh: **数据不足：** 34 条中的 3 条（9%）

paragraphs.en: By type of test: all 8 calendar sayings fail or lack data (7 do not hold, 1 has too few observations). Five of the 6 rule backtests are "partly" (moving averages, MACD, Turtle breakouts, trend following), against 3 of 10 event studies and 2 of 6 relationship claims. In 25 of 34 claims no market was both clear and stable; in 9 at least one was.
paragraphs.zh: 按检验类型看：8 条日历类谚语全部不成立或缺数据（7 条不成立，1 条观测值太少）。6 条规则回测里有 5 条是“部分成立”（均线、MACD、海龟突破、趋势跟随），10 条事件研究里有 3 条，6 条关系类里有 2 条。34 条里有 25 条没有任何市场既清晰又稳定，9 条至少有一个。

paragraphs.en: The three "not enough data" claims are the bitcoin four-year halving cycle (at most 3 independent events), "blood in the streets" (at most 9 events in any market) and the Uptober crypto effect (at most 13 observations).
paragraphs.zh: 三条“数据不足”的是：比特币四年减半周期（最多 3 次独立事件）、“血流成河时买入”（任何市场最多 9 次事件）和 Uptober 加密货币效应（最多 13 个观测值）。

paragraphs.en: The only claim that holds is "stairs up, elevator down": daily returns are negatively skewed. Over 2010-01-01 to 2026-11-11 (4,240 daily returns per market) it passed clearly in US stocks (skewness -0.34), gold (-0.54), silver (-1.14) and broad commodities (-0.52). Agriculture pointed the same way (-0.08), and EUR/USD showed none (0.00). Notably it is a statement about the shape of returns, not a forecast.
paragraphs.zh: 唯一成立的一条是“上楼梯，下电梯”：日收益呈负偏度。在 2010-01-01 至 2026-11-11（每个市场 4,240 个日收益）中，它在美股（偏度 -0.34）、黄金（-0.54）、白银（-1.14）和综合大宗商品（-0.52）上清晰通过。农产品方向一致（-0.08），欧元/美元没有这个现象（0.00）。值得注意的是，这是对收益分布形状的描述，不是预测。

paragraphs.en: Next come the trend rules. The 200-day average rule passed clearly in 3 of 10 markets (median maximum drawdown -51% against -71% for buy-and-hold); the 252-day time-series momentum rule ("the trend is your friend") beat buy-and-hold on Sharpe in 6 of 10 and passed clearly in natural gas, broad commodities and bitcoin. MACD and Turtle breakouts passed in 2 markets each. "Time in the market beats timing" is partly supported: missing the best 10 days cost a median 36% of total growth across five markets.
paragraphs.zh: 其次是趋势规则。200 日均线规则在 10 个市场里有 3 个清晰通过（最大回撤中位数 -51%，买入持有 -71%）；252 日时间序列动量（“趋势是你的朋友”）在 10 个市场中有 6 个夏普超过买入持有，并在天然气、综合大宗商品和比特币上清晰通过。MACD 和海龟突破各有 2 个市场通过。“持有时间胜过择时”得到部分支持：错过最好的 10 天，在 5 个市场里中位数损失了 36% 的总增长。

paragraphs.en: Dollar-cost averaging against lump sum is the clearest miss. Over 12-month windows from 2010-01-01 to 2026-11-11, DCA ended ahead on a median 50% of start dates, and in 3 of 10 markets the lump sum clearly won. "Bitcoin is digital gold" is the reverse of the claim: on the 99 days (2014-09-18 to 2026-11-11) when US stocks fell 2% or more, bitcoin returned -3.07% on average against +0.25% on all days (t = -4.6).
paragraphs.zh: 定投对一次性投入是最清楚的落空。在 2010-01-01 至 2026-11-11 的 12 个月窗口中，定投中位数在 50% 的起点日领先，10 个市场里有 3 个一次性投入明显更好。“比特币是数字黄金”则与说法相反：在美股下跌 2% 以上的 99 天里（2014-09-18 至 2026-11-11），比特币平均收益 -3.07%，全部交易日是 +0.25%（t = -4.6）。

paragraphs.en: The "bounce after three down days" was contradicted in 2 markets and confirmed in none. Calendar sayings were flat: May to October in US stocks returned +1.0% a month against +1.4% for the other months (102 months, t = -0.7). The Monday effect, the Santa Claus rally and turn-of-the-month all failed on US stocks, which is the only market their verdicts rest on.
paragraphs.zh: “连续三天下跌后反弹”在 2 个市场里被反驳，没有一个市场支持。日历谚语一片平淡：美股 5 月到 10 月平均每月 +1.0%，其余月份 +1.4%（102 个月，t = -0.7）。周一效应、圣诞行情和月初效应在美股上都不成立，而它们的结论就只建立在美股一个市场上。

heading.en: What the survivors have in common
heading.zh: 留下来的有什么共同点

paragraphs.en: Twelve claims hold or partly hold. Sorted by what they test, 5 are trend rules (golden cross, 200-day, trend following, MACD, Turtle), 4 describe how returns or markets behave (stairs up, time in the market, oil and stocks, correlations in a crisis) and 3 are "what happens next" event studies (buy the dip, new highs, falling knife).
paragraphs.zh: 有 12 条说法成立或部分成立。按检验的内容分：5 条是趋势规则（金叉、200 日均线、趋势跟随、MACD、海龟），4 条描述收益或市场的行为（上楼梯下电梯、持有时间、原油与股市、危机中相关性上升），3 条是“接下来会怎样”的事件研究（抄底、新高、接飞刀）。

paragraphs.en: Four of the five trend rules are judged on risk-adjusted terms or drawdown, not raw return. For the 200-day rule the clear passes were natural gas, agriculture and EUR/USD, where buy-and-hold made -23.2%, 0.4% and -1.4% a year. The three event studies each have at most 1 clear market. So the sayings that survive mostly say something about risk or structure; none gives a clear, repeated way to forecast returns.
paragraphs.zh: 五条趋势规则中有四条是按风险调整后的收益或回撤来评判的，而不是原始收益。以 200 日规则为例，清晰通过的是天然气、农产品和欧元/美元，买入持有的年化分别是 -23.2%、0.4% 和 -1.4%。三项事件研究各自最多只有 1 个清晰的市场。所以留下来的谚语大多说的是风险或结构；没有一条给出清晰、可重复的收益预测办法。

heading.en: Some will look good by chance

paragraphs.en: With 34 claims and up to ten markets each, some results will look good by luck. Of the 71 market-level t-tests (the main condition of each event study plus the calendar tests), 5 (7.0%) reached |t| of at least 2 with enough events, and only 2 (2.8%) did so in the claimed direction. A threshold of 2 is passed by roughly 4.6% of pure-noise tests, which would be about 3.2 of 71, or 1.6 in the claimed direction. The count of significant results is close to what luck alone could give.
paragraphs.zh: 34 条说法、每条最多 10 个市场，总会有一些结果凭运气看起来不错。在 71 个市场级 t 检验（每项事件研究的主要条件加上日历检验）中，有 5 个（7.0%）达到 |t| 至少为 2 且事件足够，其中只有 2 个（2.8%）方向与说法一致。纯噪声的检验大约有 4.6% 会超过 2 这个门槛，也就是 71 个里大约 3.2 个，方向一致的约 1.6 个。显著结果的数量与单凭运气可能得到的数量相近。

paragraphs.en: That is why the checker adds the stability test across two halves and requires a majority of markets, and why a single clear market, such as broad commodities in the buy-the-dip test, should be read as a lead rather than a finding.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是检验器还要加上前后两半的稳定性检验、并要求多数市场通过的原因，也是为什么单独一个清晰的市场（例如抄底测试里的综合大宗商品）应当被看作线索，而不是结论。

en: **Sample size.** 15 of 34 verdicts rest on a single market (most calendar and relationship claims), and event studies need at least 10 events per market to be usable. A market with 7 golden crosses or 38 dips is a small sample.
**Before costs.** Cash earns nothing and no spread or commission is charged, so rules that trade often, such as three down days, look better here than they would in practice.
**What "partly" means.** Of 11 partly verdicts, 5 are direction only (most markets point the right way, none is clear), 4 are "some markets" (a few clear passes) and 2 are weak effects.
**The period.** 2010-2026 includes long rises in US stocks, gold and crypto, and the results are only as general as that history.
zh: **样本量。** 34 条里有 15 条的结论只建立在一个市场上（多数日历类和关系类），事件研究每个市场至少需要 10 次事件才可用。只有 7 次金叉或 38 次抄底的市场，样本很小。
**未扣成本。** 现金不计收益，也不收点差和佣金，所以交易频繁的规则（例如连续三天下跌）在这里的表现比实际交易时要好看。
**“部分成立”是什么意思。** 11 条“部分成立”里，5 条只是方向一致（多数市场指向正确方向，但没有一个清晰），4 条是“部分市场成立”（有几个清晰通过），2 条是弱效应。
**时间区间。** 2010–2026 包含了美股、黄金和加密货币的长期上涨，结果只能代表这段历史。

en: 1 of 34 sayings holds and 19 do not; 12 hold at least in part, mostly trend rules and facts about risk.
No calendar saying survived, and none of the "what happens next" sayings was clear in more than 1 market.
Judge a saying by its sample size, its costs and how many others were tested alongside it, not by one good-looking number.
zh: 34 条谚语里 1 条成立，19 条不成立；12 条至少部分成立，主要是趋势规则和关于风险的事实。
没有一条日历谚语通过，“接下来会怎样”类的说法也没有一条在超过 1 个市场上清晰。
评价一句谚语，要看样本量、成本，以及同时测了多少句，而不是看某一个好看的数字。

title.en: Do Trend Followers Exit Before Stock Crashes? 12 Events Tested
title.zh: 趋势策略会在股灾前离场吗？12 次美股下跌的检验

summary.en: Across 12 US stock sell-offs in the site's event replays, trend strategies were already out when the fall began only 29.9% of the time on average, less often than on a normal day (38.6%). They still lost just 4.7% against the market's 15.0%, because they left during the fall.
summary.zh: 在站内 12 次美股下跌的事件回放中，下跌开始时趋势策略平均只有 29.9% 已经离场，比平常的 38.6% 还低。但它们平均只亏 4.7%，市场是 15.0%，原因是在下跌过程中离场。

paragraphs.en: A common claim is that trend-following rules "get you out before the crash". The site's event replays let us check it on stock-market data. Each event fixes a window from a peak to a trough in US stocks (SPY), and the engine records for every strategy whether it was in the market going in, what it returned over the window and what it returned over the following 63 trading days.
paragraphs.zh: 常见的说法是，趋势跟踪规则“会让你在崩盘前出来”。站内的事件回放可以用美股数据检验这一点。每个事件都固定了美股（SPY）从高点到低点的窗口，引擎记录每个策略起点时是否在场内、窗口内的收益，以及之后 63 个交易日的收益。

paragraphs.en: The question here is narrower than the claim: in the 12 stock sell-offs on the site, how often were trend-following strategies already out when the fall began, compared with mean-reversion strategies, and what did each family lose and then earn back?
paragraphs.zh: 这里的问题比那个说法更窄：站内的 12 次美股下跌里，下跌开始时趋势跟踪策略有多少已经离场，和均值回归策略相比如何，两类策略各亏了多少、之后又赚回多少？

paragraphs.en: The sample is every curated event on the site whose primary market is US stocks and whose direction is down: 12 events, from the spring 2010 correction to the 2025 tariff sell-off. The market fell 15.0% on average in the windows (median 12.8%). Five events fell more than 15%, and seven fell between 5% and 15%. The deepest three were the 2020 crash (-33.7%), the 2022 bear market (-24.5%) and the late-2018 sell-off (-19.3%). Windows range from 6 to 195 trading days, and no two overlap. An ongoing, automatically detected episode is not included, and neither are events on other markets.
paragraphs.zh: 样本是站内所有主市场为美股、方向为下跌的人工整理事件：12 个，从 2010 年春季回调到 2025 年的关税抛售。窗口内市场平均下跌 15.0%（中位数 12.8%）。5 个事件跌幅超过 15%，7 个在 5% 到 15% 之间。最深的三个是 2020 年暴跌（-33.7%）、2022 年熊市（-24.5%）和 2018 年底下跌（-19.3%）。窗口从 6 到 195 个交易日不等，彼此没有重叠。正在进行中、由系统自动识别的那次下跌没有计入，其他市场的事件也没有计入。

paragraphs.en: Families come from strategy tags, with each strategy placed in the first matching family in the order trend, momentum, mean reversion, volatility, other. That gives 24 trend strategies (288 strategy-event pairs) and 14 or 15 mean-reversion strategies per event (176 pairs). COMBO-03 is excluded because its code looks ahead. "Already out" is the engine's inference: the strategy's equity did not move on any of the last three sessions up to the window start. Results are walk-forward backtests on daily data, before trading costs.
paragraphs.zh: 策略类别来自策略标签，每个策略按趋势、动量、均值回归、波动率、其他的顺序归入第一个匹配的类别。每次事件里有 24 个趋势策略（共 288 个策略—事件对）和 14 或 15 个均值回归策略（共 176 对）。COMBO-03 因为代码存在前视而被排除。“已经离场”是引擎的推断：窗口起点之前最近三个交易日里策略净值都没有变动。结果来自日线数据的滚动前推回测，未计交易成本。

paragraphs.en: All averages below are simple means across the 12 events, with each event counting once, of the family's mean result in that event.
paragraphs.zh: 下面的平均值都是 12 次事件的简单平均，每次事件算一次，取的是该类别在这次事件中的平均结果。

heading.en: How often each family was already out
heading.zh: 各类策略有多少已经离场

paragraphs.en: Trend strategies were out at the start 29.9% of the time on average (median 25.0%); pooled, that is 86 of 288 pairs. In only 2 of the 12 events were most of them out: the early-2016 sell-off (67%) and the 2025 tariff sell-off (58%). Mean-reversion strategies were out 96.7% of the time (170 of 176 pairs), and in all 12 events most of them were out.
paragraphs.zh: 趋势策略在起点时平均有 29.9% 已经离场（中位数 25.0%）；合并来看是 288 对里的 86 对。12 次事件中，只有 2 次多数趋势策略已经离场：2016 年初下跌（67%）和 2025 年关税抛售（58%）。均值回归策略有 96.7% 已经离场（176 对里的 170 对），12 次事件里多数都在场外。

paragraphs.en: Neither number is foresight. Averaged over all days since each strategy's start, the engine would class trend strategies as out 38.6% of the time and mean-reversion strategies 82.6% of the time. So at the start of a sell-off trend strategies were out 8.8 points less often than normal, which fits a market that was rising until its peak, and mean-reversion strategies were out 14.1 points more often, which fits rules that buy only after declines. The claim that trend following gets you out before the fall is not supported at the moment the fall begins.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个数字都不是先见之明。把每个策略自启动以来的所有交易日平均，引擎会把趋势策略判为场外的时间占 38.6%，均值回归策略占 82.6%。所以下跌开始时，趋势策略离场的比例比平时低 8.8 个百分点，这符合市场在见顶之前一直上涨的情形；均值回归策略则高了 14.1 个百分点，这符合只在下跌之后买入的规则。“趋势跟踪会在下跌前让你离场”这个说法，在下跌开始的那一刻并没有得到支持。

heading.en: Losses during the events and what followed
heading.zh: 事件中的亏损与之后的表现

paragraphs.en: In the event windows, trend strategies lost 4.7% on average (median across events 3.9%) and mean-reversion strategies lost 4.0% (median 2.8%), against the market's 15.0%. Both families beat the market on average in all 12 events, by 10.4 points for trend and 11.0 for mean reversion.
paragraphs.zh: 在事件窗口内，趋势策略平均亏 4.7%（各事件中位数 3.9%），均值回归策略平均亏 4.0%（中位数 2.8%），市场是 15.0%。两类策略在全部 12 次事件中平均都跑赢了市场，趋势领先 10.4 个百分点，均值回归领先 11.0 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Within trend, the pairs that were in at the start lost 6.1% on average (202 pairs) and those that were out lost 1.2% (86 pairs). Being out at the start did help, but most were in and then left. For mean reversion, only 6 pairs were in at the start, too few to compare.
paragraphs.zh: 在趋势策略内部，起点时在场内的对子平均亏 6.1%（202 对），场外的亏 1.2%（86 对）。起点时在场外确实有帮助，但多数策略是先在场内、之后才离场。均值回归策略起点时在场内的只有 6 对，太少，无法比较。

paragraphs.en: Over the following 63 trading days, trend strategies averaged +3.0% (median 2.6%, positive in 11 of 12 events), mean-reversion strategies +4.8% (median 4.4%, positive in all 12), and the market +15.9% (median 12.9%). Both families caught a small part of the rebound.
paragraphs.zh: 之后 63 个交易日里，趋势策略平均 +3.0%（中位数 2.6%，12 次中 11 次为正），均值回归策略平均 +4.8%（中位数 4.4%，12 次全部为正），市场是 +15.9%（中位数 12.9%）。两类策略都只抓到了反弹的一小部分。

paragraphs.en: The averages hide how concentrated the results are. The three deepest events (2020, 2022, late 2018) account for 39% of the summed window loss for trend strategies and 50% for mean reversion. The 2020 crash alone cost mean-reversion strategies 15.5% on average, and without it the family's average loss falls from 4.0% to 3.0%. Trend strategies lost most in the 2022 bear market (8.4%), then 2020 (7.8%) and the 2011 sell-off (7.3%); without 2020 their average is 4.4%, and without 2020 and 2022 it is 4.0%.
paragraphs.zh: 平均值掩盖了结果的集中程度。最深的三次事件（2020、2022、2018 年底）占趋势策略窗口亏损总和的 39%，占均值回归的 50%。仅 2020 年暴跌一次，就让均值回归策略平均亏 15.5%，去掉它之后这一类的平均亏损从 4.0% 降到 3.0%。趋势策略亏得最多的是 2022 年熊市（8.4%），其次是 2020 年（7.8%）和 2011 年的下跌（7.3%）；去掉 2020 年后平均为 4.4%，同时去掉 2020 和 2022 后为 4.0%。

paragraphs.en: The rebound is even more concentrated. For trend strategies, the 2025 tariff sell-off (+8.3%) and the 2020 crash (+7.6%) make up 44% of the summed 63-day returns, and the average of the other ten events is only 2.0%. For mean reversion, the top two events (2020, +9.8%, and the 2011 sell-off, +6.7%) make up 29%, and the other ten average 4.1%.
paragraphs.zh: 反弹更加集中。对趋势策略，2025 年关税抛售（+8.3%）和 2020 年暴跌（+7.6%）占 63 日收益总和的 44%，其余十次事件的平均只有 2.0%。对均值回归，最大的两次（2020 年 +9.8%，2011 年下跌 +6.7%）占 29%，其余十次平均 4.1%。

paragraphs.en: Split by depth, the five events worse than -15% show the same families losing 6.5% (trend) and 6.0% (mean reversion), with 26.7% and 97.3% out at the start; the seven shallower events show 3.3% and 2.7%, with 32.1% and 96.2% out. With five and seven events, these splits describe, they do not test.
paragraphs.zh: 按深度划分，跌幅超过 15% 的五次事件中，趋势和均值回归分别亏 6.5% 和 6.0%，起点时离场的比例是 26.7% 和 97.3%；较浅的七次事件里分别亏 3.3% 和 2.7%，离场比例 32.1% 和 96.2%。只有五次和七次事件，这样的划分只能描述，不能检验。

paragraphs.en: The two families differ sharply in positioning, yet ended up with similar losses. Mean-reversion strategies were almost always flat at the start, yet lost 4.0% on average, close to the 4.7% of trend strategies that were mostly invested. Mean reversion lost only 1.2% in 2022, against 8.4% for trend, and lost most in 2020, 15.5% against 7.8%.
paragraphs.zh: 两类策略的持仓状态差别很大，亏损却相近。均值回归策略起点时几乎都是空仓，平均仍亏了 4.0%，接近多半满仓的趋势策略的 4.7%。均值回归在 2022 年只亏 1.2%，趋势策略亏 8.4%；在 2020 年亏得最多，为 15.5%，趋势策略是 7.8%。

paragraphs.en: What protected trend strategies was not being out early but moving out as prices fell. That cost them part of the rebound (+3.0% against +15.9%). For mean reversion the figures suggest, without proving it, that protection depends on the rule having no buy signal when the fall starts, and in 2020 the family lost 15.5%.
paragraphs.zh: 趋势策略的保护来自价格下跌时的退出，而不是提前离场。代价是错过了一部分反弹（+3.0%，市场是 +15.9%）。对均值回归，这些数字提示（但不能证明）它的保护取决于下跌开始时规则恰好没有买入信号，而在 2020 年这一类平均亏了 15.5%。

paragraphs.en: Twelve events is a small sample, and the largest few drive every average. The events were chosen by the site for their size, so the sample leaves out the many dips that never became sell-offs. The "already out" test is inferred from equity curves, and a rarely trading mean-reversion rule will often look out. The windows start at the peak, which is known in hindsight: a strategy cannot know it is at the start of a fall. Family means treat each strategy equally, so they say little about any one rule. Results are before trading costs and for the site's walk-forward setup only.
paragraphs.zh: 12 次事件是个小样本，最大的几次决定了每一个平均值。这些事件是站内按幅度挑选的，所以没有包括大量没有演变成大跌的回调。“已经离场”是用净值曲线推断的，交易很少的均值回归规则看起来常常处在场外。窗口从高点开始，而高点只有事后才知道：策略无法知道自己正处在下跌的开端。类别平均对每个策略一视同仁，所以对单个规则说明不了什么。结果未计交易成本，仅适用于站内的滚动前推设置。

en: Trend strategies were out at the start of the fall in 29.9% of cases (12 events), below their 38.6% all-days norm, so "out before the crash" is not what the replays show.
They lost 4.7% against the market's 15.0% by exiting during the fall, and rebounded +3.0% against the market's +15.9% over the next 63 days.
Mean-reversion strategies were out 96.7% of the time yet lost 4.0%, with 2020 alone costing them 15.5%.
The 2020 crash, 2022 bear market and late 2018 account for 39% to 50% of summed losses; the two largest rebounds make up 44% of the trend family's rebound total.
Twelve events cannot separate skill from circumstance. Read these figures as a description of what happened, not a forecast.
zh: 12 次事件中，下跌开始时趋势策略平均 29.9% 已离场，低于其全部交易日 38.6% 的常态，所以回放并不支持“崩盘前离场”。
它们靠下跌过程中离场，平均亏 4.7%，市场亏 15.0%；之后 63 天反弹 +3.0%，市场是 +15.9%。
均值回归策略 96.7% 已在场外，却仍平均亏 4.0%，仅 2020 年一次就亏了 15.5%。
2020 年暴跌、2022 年熊市和 2018 年底合计占亏损总和的 39% 到 50%；最大的两次反弹占趋势类反弹总和的 44%。
12 次事件无法区分能力和运气。这些数字只是对已发生情况的描述，不是预测。

title.en: What Follows High Volatility? 21-Day Returns in 10 Markets
title.zh: 高波动之后会怎样？10 个市场的 21 日收益

summary.en: After high-volatility days, the next 21 days beat the market's own average in 5 of 10 markets and lagged it in the other 5, and no gap exceeds two standard errors. The one consistent pattern is wider outcomes: 9 of 10 markets had a larger spread of 21-day returns after high volatility.
summary.zh: 在高波动日之后，未来 21 天的收益在 10 个市场中有 5 个高于该市场自身的平均水平，另外 5 个更低，而且没有一个差距超过两个标准误。唯一稳定的规律是结果更分散：10 个市场里有 9 个在高波动之后 21 日收益的离散度更大。

paragraphs.en: The site's market regime dashboard labels each market every day as steady up, volatile up, mixed, down or stress, and it shows what happened over the following month. A natural reading is that high volatility is a warning, or alternatively a buying opportunity. This article asks what the stored history says for each of the ten markets, and where it says nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 站内的市场状态仪表盘每天给每个市场贴上稳步上涨、震荡上涨、方向不明、下跌或高压下跌的标签，并显示之后一个月发生了什么。自然的解读是，高波动是个警告，或者反过来是个买入机会。本文看的是，历史数据对十个市场分别说了什么，以及在哪些地方什么也说明不了。

paragraphs.en: Two cautions first. These are descriptive averages over overlapping windows, not forecasts, and for each market the number of independent observations is far smaller than the number of days. All results are from daily closes, with no trading costs involved.
paragraphs.zh: 先说两点谨慎。这些是重叠窗口上的描述性平均值，不是预测，每个市场真正独立的观察数远小于天数。所有结果来自日线收盘价，不涉及交易成本。

heading.en: How regimes and outcomes are defined
heading.zh: 状态和结果是怎么定义的

paragraphs.en: The rules come from the dashboard code and use closes up to that day only. A day is "up" when the close is above its 200-day average and the 50-day average is above the 200-day, "down" when both are below, and "mixed" otherwise. Volatility is the standard deviation of the last 20 daily returns, annualised, ranked against the previous 756 observations (about three years of trading days) of the same market. At the 80th percentile or above it counts as high. That gives five regimes: steady up (up, not high), volatile up (up, high), mixed, down (down, not high) and stress (down, high).
paragraphs.zh: 规则来自仪表盘的代码，只用当天及之前的收盘价。收盘价在 200 日均线上方且 50 日均线在 200 日均线上方，算“上涨”；两者都在下方，算“下跌”；其余为“方向不明”。波动率是最近 20 个日收益的标准差（年化），与同一市场过去 756 个观察日（约三年的交易日）比较得到分位；达到第 80 百分位或更高就算高。由此得到五种状态：稳步上涨（上涨且不高）、震荡上涨（上涨且高）、方向不明、下跌（下跌且不高）和高压下跌（下跌且高）。

paragraphs.en: The outcome is the return from that day's close to the close 21 observations later. The first classified day needs 200 days of prices and a year of volatility history. Classified history therefore runs from 31 January 2011 for US stocks, gold, silver, oil, natural gas, broad commodities and agriculture (3,970 days, 15.8 years), from 17 January 2011 for EUR/USD (4,118 days), from 15 June 2015 for bitcoin (4,168 days, 11.4 years) and from 7 August 2018 for ether (3,019 days, 8.3 years). Bitcoin and ether trade every day, so their 21 observations are three calendar weeks.
paragraphs.zh: 结果是从当天收盘到之后第 21 个观察日收盘的收益。第一个能分类的日子需要 200 天的价格和一年的波动率历史，所以有分类的历史，美股、黄金、白银、原油、天然气、综合大宗商品和农产品从 2011 年 1 月 31 日开始（3,970 天，15.8 年），欧元/美元从 2011 年 1 月 17 日开始（4,118 天），比特币从 2015 年 6 月 15 日开始（4,168 天，11.4 年），以太坊从 2018 年 8 月 7 日开始（3,019 天，8.3 年）。比特币和以太坊每天都交易，所以它们的 21 个观察日是三个日历周。

paragraphs.en: US stocks are the clearest example. The average 21-day return over all classified days was +1.2% (median +1.6%, 68.4% of windows positive). By regime, with days in the regime and episodes:
paragraphs.zh: 美股是最清楚的例子。所有已分类日子的 21 日平均收益为 +1.2%（中位数 +1.6%，68.4% 的窗口为正）。分状态看，括号为该状态的天数和出现次数：

en: Steady up: 2,923 days, 28 episodes; mean +1.0%, median +1.5%, 68.8% up.
Volatile up: 238 days, 31 episodes; mean +0.6%, median +1.6%, 64.8% up.
Mixed: 373 days, 46 episodes; mean +1.5%, median +2.0%, 62.7% up.
Down: 109 days, 21 episodes; mean +0.3%, median +2.6%, 56.0% up.
Stress: 327 days, 19 episodes; mean +3.5%, median +4.3%, 78.0% up.

paragraphs.en: Stress, the high-volatility downtrend, was followed by the best month on average. But 327 days in 19 episodes is only about 15.6 non-overlapping 21-day windows, and the spread was wide (standard deviation 4.9%). The "down" regime has only 109 days and its mean and median disagree, so it supports no reading.
paragraphs.zh: 高压下跌，即高波动的下跌趋势，之后平均是最好的一个月。但 327 天分布在 19 次事件里，只相当于约 15.6 个互不重叠的 21 日窗口，而且离散度很大（标准差 4.9%）。“下跌”状态只有 109 天，均值与中位数不一致，不支持任何结论。

heading.en: High volatility against the average, ten markets
heading.zh: 高波动与平均水平，十个市场

paragraphs.en: Pooling the two high-volatility regimes (volatile up and stress) gives a larger sample. For each market, high-volatility days that had a 21-day outcome, the number of episodes (the two regimes counted separately), the mean outcome and its gap to the all-days mean:
paragraphs.zh: 把两种高波动状态（震荡上涨和高压下跌）合并，样本更大。对每个市场，列出有 21 日结果的高波动天数、出现次数（两种状态分别计数）、平均结果，以及与全部交易日均值的差距：

en: US stocks: 560 days, 50 episodes; +2.3% vs +1.2%, gap +1.11 points.
Gold: 864 days, 63 episodes; +0.5% vs +0.7%, gap -0.15.
Silver: 792 days, 56 episodes; +1.9% vs +0.7%, gap +1.21.
Oil: 855 days, 48 episodes; +1.0% vs +0.3%, gap +0.73.
Natural gas: 802 days, 61 episodes; -5.2% vs -1.3%, gap -3.90.
Broad commodities: 836 days, 65 episodes; +1.5% vs +0.3%, gap +1.22.
Agriculture: 617 days, 62 episodes; -0.5% vs 0.0%, gap -0.56.
EUR/USD: 649 days, 57 episodes; -0.5% vs -0.1%, gap -0.39.
Bitcoin: 623 days, 47 episodes; +8.4% vs +4.4%, gap +3.98.
Ether: 448 days, 39 episodes; +0.7% vs +3.6%, gap -2.85.

paragraphs.en: Five gaps are positive and five negative.
paragraphs.zh: 五个差距为正，五个为负。

heading.en: Where the pattern is real enough to mention

paragraphs.en: To judge size, I compared each gap with a standard error built from the market's 21-day return spread and the number of independent 21-day blocks (high-volatility days divided by 21). No market reaches a ratio of 2. The largest in absolute terms are natural gas (-1.80), broad commodities (+1.50), US stocks (+1.36) and bitcoin (+1.19). Natural gas is the clearest case of high volatility being followed by worse returns: -5.2% with 32.7% of windows positive against 42.6% for all days, with the same sign in both halves of the sample and in the median (-6.9% against -2.0%). Its stress regime alone (570 days, 42 episodes) averaged -5.5%.
paragraphs.zh: 为了判断大小，我把每个差距与一个标准误比较，标准误由该市场 21 日收益的离散度和独立的 21 日区块数（高波动天数除以 21）算出。没有一个市场的比值达到 2。绝对值最大的是天然气（-1.80）、综合大宗商品（+1.50）、美股（+1.36）和比特币（+1.19）。天然气是高波动之后收益更差的最清楚的例子：-5.2%，正收益窗口占 32.7%，全部交易日是 42.6%，样本前后两半符号一致，中位数也是（-6.9% 对 -2.0%）。仅它的高压下跌状态（570 天，42 次）平均就是 -5.5%。

paragraphs.en: The pattern that does repeat is dispersion. After high volatility, the standard deviation of 21-day returns was larger than the all-days figure in 9 of 10 markets: US stocks 5.1% against 4.2%, silver 13.6% against 9.4%, oil 15.4% against 10.9%, bitcoin 24.4% against 18.2%. Ether was the exception (18.7% against 21.5%). Whatever the average return, a wider range of outcomes followed.
paragraphs.zh: 真正重复出现的是离散度。高波动之后，21 日收益的标准差在 10 个市场中的 9 个大于全部日子的数字：美股 5.1% 对 4.2%，白银 13.6% 对 9.4%，原油 15.4% 对 10.9%，比特币 24.4% 对 18.2%。以太坊是例外（18.7% 对 21.5%）。无论平均收益如何，之后的结果范围都更宽。

paragraphs.en: In EUR/USD and agriculture, the stress regime was followed by a lower share of positive months (37.0% and 37.3%, against 48.3% and 48.0% for all days), with 513 and 276 days; the direction is consistent but the gaps are small.
paragraphs.zh: 在欧元/美元和农产品上，高压下跌之后上涨月份的占比更低（37.0% 和 37.3%，全部日子是 48.3% 和 48.0%），天数分别为 513 和 276；方向一致，但差距很小。

heading.en: Where the sample is too small or the pattern too weak
heading.zh: 样本太小或规律太弱的地方

paragraphs.en: Of the 50 market-and-regime cells, 5 have fewer than 200 days: US stocks "down" (109 days), silver stress (182), EUR/USD volatile up (136), bitcoin stress (154) and ether stress (199). Another 5 have fewer than 20 episodes: US stocks stress (19), oil volatile up (17), natural gas volatile up (19), bitcoin stress (15) and ether stress (16). Silver stress looks dramatic (+4.4% against +0.7% for all days, 66.1% positive) but rests on 182 days in 21 episodes, and oil's volatile-up regime (+5.5%, 71.8% positive) on 286 days in 17 episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 在 50 个“市场加状态”的格子里，5 个不足 200 天：美股“下跌”（109 天）、白银高压下跌（182）、欧元/美元震荡上涨（136）、比特币高压下跌（154）和以太坊高压下跌（199）。另外 5 个出现次数不到 20 次：美股高压下跌（19）、原油震荡上涨（17）、天然气震荡上涨（19）、比特币高压下跌（15）和以太坊高压下跌（16）。白银的高压下跌看上去很惊人（+4.4% 对全部日子的 +0.7%，66.1% 为正），但只有 182 天、21 次；原油的震荡上涨（+5.5%，71.8% 为正）只有 286 天、17 次。

paragraphs.en: Sign changes also argue for caution. The gap flips between the first and second half of the sample for oil (-0.27 then +1.64 points) and broad commodities (-0.15 then +2.11). Bitcoin's volatile-up regime averaged +9.8% over 469 days while ether's averaged -1.8% over 249, two similar assets with opposite results. Gold's pooled gap (-0.15 points on the mean, +0.04 on the median) is simply flat.
paragraphs.zh: 符号的翻转也提示谨慎。原油（先 -0.27，后 +1.64 个百分点）和综合大宗商品（先 -0.15，后 +2.11）的差距在样本前半段和后半段方向相反。比特币的震荡上涨状态平均 +9.8%（469 天），以太坊的则是 -1.8%（249 天），两个相似的资产结果相反。黄金合并后的差距（均值 -0.15 个百分点，中位数 +0.04）就是一条平线。

en: The only repeated finding is wider outcomes after high volatility: 9 of 10 markets. Direction is mixed: 5 better, 5 worse.
Natural gas is the clearest negative (-3.90 points, 802 days, 61 episodes), US stocks and broad commodities the clearest positives, but none of the ten differences is two standard errors from zero.
US stock stress was followed by +3.5% on average and 78.0% positive months, from just 19 episodes.
Cells with under 200 days or under 20 episodes, such as ether stress, say very little.
These are descriptions of history over 8 to 16 years, not forecasts.
zh: 唯一重复出现的发现是高波动之后结果更分散：10 个市场中的 9 个。方向则不一致：5 个更好，5 个更差。
天然气是最清楚的负面例子（-3.90 个百分点，802 天，61 次），美股和综合大宗商品是最清楚的正面例子，但十个差距没有一个距零达到两个标准误。
美股的高压下跌之后平均 +3.5%，上涨月份占 78.0%，但只有 19 次。
不足 200 天或不足 20 次的格子，例如以太坊高压下跌，几乎说明不了什么。
这些是对 8 到 16 年历史的描述，不是预测。
